Name: Draconic Resilience
Desc 1: Draconic Resilience is a Draconic Bloodline Sorcerer passive feature that raises the Sorcerer's base Armour Class to 13 when not wearing armour.
Desc 2: Dragon-like scales cover parts of your skin. When you aren't wearing armour, your base  Armour Class is 13.

Name: Dragonfire Fists
Desc 1: Dragonfire Fists is a passive feature that adds extra fire damage to the user's unarmed attacks.
Desc 2: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Fire.

Name: Dread Ambusher
Desc 1: Dread Ambusher is a Gloom Stalker Ranger passive feature that makes you deadly on the first turn of combat.
Desc 2: You specialise in taking out foes swiftly and ruthlessly. You gain a +3 bonus to Initiative. On the first turn of combat, your Movement Speed increases by  3 m / 10 ft, and you can also make an extra weapon attack that deals an additional  1d8 damage

Name: Dread Iron Ambush
Desc 1: Dread Iron Ambush is a passive feature that increases the damage of your weapon while you are hidden.
Desc 2: While its wielder is hidden, this weapon deals an extra 1d6⁠Necrotic.

Name: Dreadful Hewer
Desc 1: Dreadful Hewer is a passive feature that makes it difficult for enemies to resist your fearful abilities.
Desc 2: Your foes have  Disadvantage on Saving Throws to resist your spells or actions that inflict  Fear.

Name: Dreadful Word
Desc 1: Dreadful Word is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You learn how to cast Confusion.
Desc 2: You can cast  Confusion with a Warlock spell slot.

Name: Drow Weapon Training
Desc 1: Drow Weapon Training is a passive feature that grants Drow Proficiency with the Rapier, Shortsword, and Hand Crossbow.
Desc 2: You have Proficiency with  Rapiers,  Shortswords, and  Hand Crossbows.

Name: Drunken Performance
Desc 1: Drunken Performance is a Way of the Drunken Master monk passive feature that grants Performance proficiency.
Desc 2: You gain Proficiency in  Performance.

Name: Dual Wielder
Desc 1: Dual Wielder is a passive feature obtainable by the Dual Wielder Feat. It allows you to use Two-Weapon Fighting while wielding two non-Heavy weapons even if they aren't Light.
Desc 2: You can use Two-Weapon Fighting even if the weapons you are wielding aren't Light. You cannot dual-wield Two-Handed weapons.

Name: Dual Wielder: Bonus Armour Class
Desc 1: Dual Wielder: Bonus Armour Class is a passive feature obtainable by the Dual Wielder Feat. If you have a melee weapon equipped in both hands, gain +1  Armour Class
Desc 2: You have a +1 bonus to  Armour Class while wielding a melee weapon in each hand.

Name: Duelling
Desc 1: Duelling is a fighting style passive feature.
Desc 2: When you are wielding a melee weapon that is not Two-Handed in one hand, and no weapon in the other, you deal an additional 2 damage with that weapon. You can carry a shield in your free hand and still gain this bonus.

Name: Duelling Gloves
Desc 1: Duelling Gloves is a passive feature  that grants a bonus to single handed melee weapons.
Desc 2: While only holding one weapon in your main hand and nothing in your free hand, gain a +2 bonus to melee weapon Attack rolls.

Name: Duergar Resilience
Desc 1: Duergar Resilience is a passive feature available to all Duergar characters. It grants Advantage on Saving Throws against illusions and against being Charmed or Paralysed.
Desc 2: An affected creature has  Advantage on  Saving throws  against Illusions and against being Charmed or  Paralysed.

Name: Dungeon Delver: Perception
Desc 1: Dungeon Delver: Perception is a passive feature obtainable by the Dungeon Delver Feat. It gives you a bonus to your Perception when it comes to finding hidden objects.
Desc 2: You have  Advantage on Perception Checks made to detect hidden objects.

Name: Dungeon Delver: Resist Traps
Desc 1: Dungeon Delver: Resist Traps is a passive feature obtainable by the Dungeon Delver Feat. It makes the wearer more likely to avoid traps as well as resist the damage from them.
Desc 2: You have  Advantage on Saving Throws made to avoid traps and Resistance to trap damage.

Name: Durable
Desc 1: Durable is a Passive Feature obtainable by the Feat of the same name. You regain full HP every time you take a Short Rest
Desc 2: Regain full Hit Points every time you take a Short Rest.

Name: Dwarven Armour Training
Desc 1: Dwarven Armour Training is a passive feature that grants Shield Dwarves Proficiency with Light Armour and Medium Armour.
Desc 2: You have Armour Proficiency with  Light armour and  Medium armour.

Name: Dwarven Combat Training
Desc 1: Dwarven Combat Training is a passive feature that grants Dwarves Proficiency with the Battleaxe, Handaxe, Light Hammer, and Warhammers.
Desc 2: You have Proficiency with  Battleaxes,  Handaxes,  Light Hammers, and  Warhammers.

Name: Dwarven Resilience
Desc 1: Dwarven Resilience is a Dwarf passive feature that grants Advantage on Saving Throws against Poison and Resistance to Poison damage.
Desc 2: You have  Advantage on  Saving throws against being  Poisoned and you have Resistance against ⁠Poison damage.

Name: Dwarven Thrower
Desc 1: Dwarven Thrower is a passive feature that grants extra damage on oversized creatures, if the wielder is a Dwarf.
Desc 2: A Dwarf throwing this warhammer deals an extra 1d8⁠Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large, Huge or Gargantuan creature, the strike deals an additional 2d8⁠Bludgeoning damage.

Name: Dwarven Toughness
Desc 1: Dwarven Toughness is a passive feature that increases a creature's Hit Point maximum by 1, and again by 1 every time they gain a level. It is a Subrace Trait for all Gold Dwarf characters.
Desc 2: You have 1 extra maximum  Hit Point per level.

Name: Eagle Heart
Desc 1: Eagle Heart is a passive feature that grants a Wildheart Barbarian a special version of Rage and another ability.
Desc 2: While  Raging, you can use  Diving Strike. Foes also have  Disadvantage on  Opportunity Attacks against you, and you can use  Dash as a bonus action.

Name: Edge of Terror
Desc 1: Edge of Terror is a passive feature that applies  Bone Chilled to the target on every hit.
Desc 2: Each strike fills the target with a chilling dread that prevents it from regaining hit points. Undead creatures also get  Disadvantage on Attack rolls.

Name: Effective Transmitter
Desc 1: Effective Transmitter is a passive feature that grants hit bonuses against constructs and enemies wearing metal armour.
Desc 2: While imbued with  Lightning Charges, attacks against metal constructs and foes wearing metal armour gain  Advantage.

Name: Eight Legged Waltz
Desc 1: Eight Legged Waltz is a Beast Master Hunter's  Wolf Spider Companion passive feature that increases the speed of your Wolf Spider while on webs.
Desc 2: Whenever you start your turn on a web surface, you now gain extra Movement Speed and become Resistant to ⁠Poison.

Name: Eldritch Spear
Desc 1: Eldritch Spear is a passive feature that gives users a range boost on their Eldritch Blast cantrip.
Desc 2: The range of your  Eldritch Blast increases by half.

Name: Eldritch Strike
Desc 1: Eldritch Strike is an Eldritch Knight Fighter passive feature. This allows the Fighter to force a creature to have Disadvantage on its next Saving Throw by a mere weapon attack.
Desc 2: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it has  Disadvantage on its next  Saving throw against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

Name: Electric Blood
Desc 1: Electric Blood is a passive feature that that adds lightning charges when dealing damage.
Desc 2: When the wielder deals damage using this weapon, they gain 2  Lightning Charges.

Name: Electric Veins
Desc 1: Electric Veins is a passive feature that grants you a bonus when you deal damage with a spell or cantrip.
Desc 2: When the wielder deals damage with a spell or cantrip, they gain 2  Lightning Charges.

Name: Electrify Water
Desc 1: Electrify Water is a passive feature that turns water surfaces into electrified water surfaces.
Desc 2: When the wearer stands in  Water during combat, it becomes  Electrified Water.

Name: Electrocution Immunity
Desc 1: This passive protects its user from Electrocution.
Desc 2: Years of ambushing ships during lightning storms means that this creature cannot be  Electrocuted.

Name: Elegant Duellist
Desc 1: Elegant Duellist is a passive feature that increases your critical hit chance and reactivity.
Desc 2: While your off-hand is empty, you score a Critical Hit when rolling a 19. Moreover, you gain an additional  Reaction per turn.

Name: Elemental Adept: Acid
Desc 1: Elemental Adept: Acid is a passive feature obtainable by the Elemental Adept Feat. Your spells ignore Resistance to ⁠Acid. When you cast spells of that type, you cannot roll a 1.
Desc 2: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to ⁠Acid damage. In addition, when you deal Acid damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

Name: Elemental Adept: Cold
Desc 1: Elemental Adept: Cold is a passive feature obtainable by the Elemental Adept Feat. Your spells ignore Resistance to ⁠Cold. When you cast spells of that type, you cannot roll a 1.
Desc 2: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to ⁠Cold damage. In addition, when you deal Cold damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

Name: Elemental Adept: Fire
Desc 1: Elemental Adept: Fire is a passive feature obtainable by the Elemental Adept Feat. Your spells ignore Resistance to ⁠Fire. When you cast spells of that type, you cannot roll a 1.
Desc 2: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to ⁠Fire damage. In addition, when you deal Fire damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

Name: Elemental Adept: Lightning
Desc 1: Elemental Adept: Lightning is a passive feature obtainable by the Elemental Adept Feat. Your spells ignore Resistance to ⁠Lightning. When you cast spells of that type, you cannot roll a 1.
Desc 2: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to ⁠Lightning damage. In addition, when you deal Lightning damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

Name: Elemental Adept: Thunder
Desc 1: Elemental Adept: Thunder is a Passive Feature obtainable by the Elemental Adept Feat. Your spells ignore Resistance to ⁠Thunder. When you cast spells of that type, you cannot roll a 1.
Desc 2: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to ⁠Thunder damage. In addition, when you deal Thunder damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

Name: Elemental Affinity: Damage
Desc 1: Elemental Affinity: Damage is a Draconic Bloodline Sorcerer passive feature that adds extra damage based on your Charisma Modifier to every spell you cast so long as it is the same type as your bloodline.
Desc 2: When you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you add your Charisma Modifier to the damage.

Name: Elemental Augmentation
Desc 1: Elemental Augmentation is a passive feature which adds damage to the caster's elemental cantrips.
Desc 2: When one of your cantrips deals ⁠Acid, ⁠Cold, ⁠Fire, ⁠Lightning, or ⁠Thunder damage, add your Spellcasting Modifier to the damage dealt.

Name: Elemental Infusion
Desc 1: Elemental Infusion is a passive feature that adds elemental damage to the wearer's next weapon attack, after dealing elemental damage with a spell.
Desc 2: When you deal ⁠Acid, ⁠Cold, ⁠Fire, ⁠Lightning, or ⁠Thunder damage using a Spell or a Cantrip, that element infuses your weapon. Until the end of your next turn, you deal an additional   1d4 damage of that element on your first successful weapon attack.

Name: Elemental Momentum
Desc 1: Elemental Momentum is a passive feature that temporarily increases the wearer's speed after casting an elemental spell.
Desc 2: Whenever the wearer deals ⁠Acid, ⁠Cold, ⁠Fire, ⁠Lightning or ⁠Thunder damage with Spells or Cantrip, they gain  Momentum for 2 turns.

Name: Elemental Resonance
Condition: Resistant to Acid Damage,Resistant to Fire Damage,Resistant to Lightning Damage,Resistant to Necrotic Damage,Resistant to Radiant Damage
Desc 1: Elemental Resonance is a passive feature that grants you resistance to the same damage type you deal.
Desc 2: If the wielder deals ⁠Acid, ⁠Fire, ⁠Lightning, ⁠Radiant, or ⁠Necrotic damage, it becomes resistant to that damage type for 2 turns.

Name: Elemental Retort
Desc 1: Elemental Retort is a special passive feature that grants a special reaction when attacked.
Desc 2: When attacked, the affected entity can draw on  Siphoned magic to cast  Elemental Retort.

Name: Elemental Siphon
Desc 1: Elemental Siphon is a passive feature lets you draw power from nearby myrmidons.
Desc 2: The affected entity draws elemental power from any myrmidons within  Range: 30 m / 100 ft

Name: Elements of an Epoch
Desc 1: Elements of an Epoch is a passive feature that inflicts a condition based on the elemental damage done.
Desc 2: Depending on what kind of damage this weapon does, it also inflicts:  Acid condition,  Chilled condition, or  Burning condition.

Name: Elk Heart
Desc 1: Elk Heart is a passive feature that grants a Wildheart Barbarian a special version of Rage and another ability.
Desc 2: While  Raging, you can use  Primal Stampede, and your movement speed increases by  4.5 m / 15 ft.

Name: Elven Agility
Desc 1: Elven Agility is a passive feature that enhances the user's speed and agility.
Desc 2: The wearer has a +2 bonus to Initiative Rolls and  Advantage on Dexterity  Saving throws.

Name: Elven Chain
Desc 1: Elven Chain is a passive feature that lets anyone wear this armour.
Desc 2: You are considered Proficient with this armour while wearing it.

Name: Elven Weapon Training
Desc 1: Elven Weapon Training is a passive feature that grants Elves proficiency with the Longsword, Shortsword, Shortbow, and Longbow.
Desc 2: You have Proficiency with  Longswords,  Shortswords,  Longbows, and  Shortbows.

Name: Empowered Evocation
Desc 1: Empowered Evocation is an Evocation School Wizard passive feature which increases the damage of the caster's Evocation spells by their Intelligence modifier.
Desc 2: Your grasp of Evocation magic has tightened, and you can add your Intelligence Modifier to damage rolls with any Evocation spells.

Name: Endurance by Fire
Desc 1: Endurance by Fire is a passive feature that provides resistance to fire and better protection against certain abilities.
Desc 2: You have Resistance to ⁠Fire damage and a +2 bonus to  Saving throws.

Name: Enervating Suffusion
Desc 1: Enervating Suffusion is a passive feature that adds force damage to unarmed attacks.
Desc 2: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Force damage.

Name: Envenom
Desc 1: Envenom is a passive feature that inflicts  Poisoned on targets whenever the wearer deals poison type damage.
Desc 2: Whenever you deal ⁠Poison damage, the target needs to succeed a  Constitution saving throw or become  Poisoned.

Name: Escape the Horde
Desc 1: Escape the Horde is a Hunter Ranger passive feature that allow you to more safely escape the reach of an enemy.
Desc 2: Opportunity Attacks against you have  Disadvantage.

Name: Ethel's Twisted Blessing
Desc 1: Ethel's Twisted Blessing is a passive feature available to Ethel's Redcap servants that gives them additional health, strength and constitution scores, and damage to their attacks.
Desc 2: As one of Ethel's loyal servants, this redcap has an additional 40 hit points, their Strength and Constitution scores are increased +2, and their attacks deal an additional 1~12⁠Slashing damage.

Name: Ethereal
Desc 1: Ethereal is a passive feature that marks this entity as a ghost.
Desc 2: Affected entity is incorporeal and can't be  Shoved,  Thrown, or used as an  Improvised Melee Weapon

Name: Ethereal Escape
Desc 1: Ethereal Escape is a Passive feature/Reaction that grants the creature the ability to automatically disappear when damaged. It is similar to the effect of  Blink, except this effect is guaranteed.
Desc 2: When damaged, the Incubus escapes to the Ethereal Plane. He returns to the battlefield at the start of his next turn.

Name: Ethereal Form
Desc 1: Ethereal Form is a passive feature that reduces all incoming damage by 8.
Desc 2: All incoming damage is reduced by 8.

Name: Evasion
Desc 1: Evasion is a Monk and Rogue passive feature that lets them evade area of effect damage which require Dexterity Saving Throws[See Notes], reducing or entirely negating the damage.
Desc 2: Your agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain spells. When a spell or effect would deal half damage on a successful  Dexterity saving throw, it deals no damage if you succeed, and only half damage if you fail.

Name: Evasive Instinct
Desc 1: Evasive Instinct is a passive feature that increases your defenses so long as you're not wearing armor.
Desc 2: You have a +1 bonus to  Armour Class and  Saving throws as long as you are not wearing armour or holding a shield.

Name: Ever Vigilant
Desc 1: Ever Vigilant is a passive feature that grants extra hit points when the user end's their rage intentionally.
Desc 2: When the wearer chooses to  End their Rage, they gain  15 temporary hit points. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

Name: Exceptional Plate
Desc 1: Exceptional Plate is a passive feature that reduces physical damage significantly.
Desc 2: You take 2 less damage from ⁠Slashing, ⁠Piercing and ⁠Bludgeoning sources.

Name: Exceptional Training
Desc 1: Exceptional Training is a Beast Master Ranger passive feature that enhances your companion. They can now take several common actions as bonus actions.
Desc 2: Your summoned companions can now  Dash,  Disengage, and  Help as a  Bonus Action.

Name: Executioner
Desc 1: Executioner is a passive feature that lets the wearer critical hit the next target after getting a kill.
Desc 2: When you kill a creature, your next Attack roll will be a Critical Hit. Once spent, this effect refreshes after a Long Rest.

Name: Exoskeletal Endurance
Desc 1: Exoskeletal Endurance is a passive feature that decreases the damage you take and retaliates against melee attacks.
Desc 2: Reduce all incoming damage by 2. When the wearer is struck by a melee attack, the attacker takes Constitution modifier⁠Piercing damage.

Name: Exoskeletal Reinforcement
Desc 1: Exoskeletal Reinforcements is passive feature that grants the wearer the ability to pierce resistances to physical attacks.
Desc 2: Your attacks ignore Resistance to ⁠Slashing, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Bludgeoning damage.

Name: Exotic Material
Desc 1: Exotic Material is a passive feature that makes the armor more flexible, and prevents stealth penalties.
Desc 2: Add your full Dexterity Modifier to your  Armour Class. Additionally, this armour does not impose  Disadvantage on Stealth Ability Checks.

Name: Experienced And Deadly
Desc 1: Experienced And Deadly is a passive feature that boosts the wielder's unarmed strikes by using their wisdom.
Desc 2: The wearer deals additional damage equal to their  Wisdom Modifier with unarmed strikes.

Name: Experimental Alchemy
Desc 1: Experimental Alchemy is a Transmutation School Wizard passive feature that enhances your mastery over alchemy. Whenever you combine extracts, you can brew two solutions instead of one provided you succeed a Medicine check.
Desc 2: You brew two Alchemical Solutions instead of one when combining extracts, if you succeed a Difficulty Class 15 Medicine Check.

Name: Expert Divination
Desc 1: Expert Divination is a Divination School Wizard passive feature which grants an additional Portent Die and allows its user to fulfill prophecies to restore any spent Portent Dice each short rest. These prophecies typically entail casting a spell from a specific school or dealing a specific type of damage.
Desc 2: You gain an additional Portent Die. When taking a Short Rest you receive a set of Prophecies. Complete them to regain missing Portent Dice.

Name: Expertise
Desc 1: Expertise is a passive feature that allows a character to double their Proficiency bonus on a Skill.
Desc 2: Choose a Skill you are Proficient in. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any Ability Check you make in that Skill.

Name: Exploit Weakness
Desc 1: Exploit Weakness is a passive feature that makes targets vulnerable to being pierced.
Desc 2: Creatures hit with this weapon receive Vulnerability to ⁠Piercing damage.

Name: Exquisite Focus
Desc 1: Exquisite Focus is a passive feature that increases your AC as a precaution
Desc 2: While concentrating, you add your Spellcasting Modifier to your  Saving throws and gain a +1 bonus to your  Armour Class.

Name: External Digestion
Desc 1: External Digestion is a passive feature that allows its user to Devour certain enemies.
Desc 2: Can  Devour any creature that is  Restrained and steeping in its  Digestive Juices.

Name: Extinguishing Malice
Desc 1: Extinguishing Malice is a passive feature that plunges the surrounding area into darkness.
Desc 2: Nearby lights are extinguished in the presence of this creature's roiling darkness.

Name: Extra Attack
Desc 1: Extra Attack is a passive feature that allows you to make an additional attack when making an Attack Action.
Desc 2: You can make an additional free attack after making an unarmed or weapon attack.

Name: Eyes of the Dark
Desc 1: Eyes of the Dark is a passive feature that prevents  Disadvantage when attacking creatures in the dark within 24 m / 80 ft, double the distance of normal  Darkvision.
Desc 2: You can see in the dark up to 24 m / 80 ft.

Name: Faceless Masquerade
Desc 1: Faceless Masquerade is a passive feature that enhances the user's deception and persuasion ability.
Desc 2: You have  Advantage on  Deception Checks and  Persuasion Checks.

Name: Failsafe Protocol
Desc 1: Failsafe Protocol is a passive feature which grants a creature the ability to self-destruct in an explosion.
Desc 2: After losing a significant amount of Hit Points, this creature will begin a  Self-Detonation Protocol to eliminate all nearby threats. If it dies, it instantly  detonates.

Name: Faithwarden's Stride
Desc 1: Faithwarden's Stride is a passive feature that allows the wielder to move through vines unopposed.
Desc 2: Druidic vines cannot  Ensnare you and do not count as  difficult terrain.

Name: Fancy Footwork
Desc 1: Fancy Footwork is a passive feature available to Swashbuckler rogues which prevents the targets of their melee attacks from taking opportunity attacks against them.
Desc 2: If you make a melee attack against a target, that target can't make Opportunity Attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

Name: Fast Hands
Desc 1: Fast Hands is a Thief Rogue passive feature that grants an extra Bonus Action
Desc 2: You gain an extra  Bonus Action, which you can use with any of your existing Bonus Actions.

Name: Fast Movement
Desc 1: Fast Movement is a Barbarian passive feature that increases your Movement Speed by 3m / 10ft while not wearing Heavy Armour.
Desc 2: Your Movement Speed increases by 3 m / 10 ft while not wearing Heavy Armour.

Name: Favourable Beginnings
Desc 1: Favourable Beginnings is a passive feature and Illithid Power. This feature applies a character's Proficiency Bonus to the first Attack Roll or Ability Check made against a target.
Desc 2: The first Attack roll or  Ability check you make against any target gains a bonus equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Name: Favoured Weapon
Desc 1: Favoured Weapon is a passive feature that boosts the wielder's chance to hit and damage.
Desc 2: This weapon has a +1 bonus to damage and Attack rolls.

Name: Fear of Wolves
Desc 1: Fear of Wolves is one of Shadowheart's passive features. When approaching a lupine creature, she may become Frightened.
Desc 2: Shadowheart's scalp prickles with fear when she encounters wolves. If she steps within 9 m / 30 ft of a lupine creature, she must make a DC 15 Wisdom  Saving throw or become  Frightened.

Name: Feline Fall
Desc 1: Feline Fall is a passive feature in Baldur's Gate 3 that grants a creature the ability to resist falling damage.
Desc 2: Due to their natural feline grace, cats are Resistant to Falling damage.

Name: Feller of Monsters
Desc 1: Feller of Monsters is a passive feature that improves hit chance against Monstrosities.
Desc 2: You have  Advantage against Monstrosity type enemies.

Name: Feral Instinct
Desc 1: Feral Instinct is a Barbarian passive feature. The barbarian is always ready for battle and can't be caught off-guard.
Desc 2: You have honed your instincts to the utmost degree. You gain a +3 to Initiative and can't be Surprised.

Name: Fervent Flames
Desc 1: Fervent Flames is a passive feature that heats up the wearer whenever you take fire damage.
Desc 2: Whenever you take ⁠Fire damage dealt by another creature, you gain 2 turns of  Heat.

Name: Fey Ancestry
Desc 1: Fey Ancestry is a passive feature that grants immunity to  Sleep effects and Advantage against  Charm effects.
Desc 2: The Feywild casts a veil over your mind. You have  Advantage on  Saving throws against being  Charmed, and magic can't put you to  Sleep.

Name: Fey Life
Desc 1: Fey Life is a passive feature that makes the wearer more likely to survive unconsciousness.
Desc 2: Makes it easier for the wearer to succeed on death saving throws.

Name: Feywild Sparks
Desc 1: Feywild Sparks is a passive feature that always triggers a wild magic surge if Tides of Chaos is active.
Desc 2: While your sorcerous  Tides of Chaos feature is active, you will always trigger  Wild Magic when casting spells.

Name: Fiendish Blessing
Desc 1: Fiendish Blessing is a Cambion passive feature that grants them an increase to their Armour Class.
Desc 2: Protected by the blood of their fiendish ancestors, cambions have a +2 bonus to their Armour Class.

Name: Fiendish Fire
Desc 1: Fiendish Fire is a passive feature that can reveal enemies and make them easier to hit.
Desc 2: Once per turn, a creature hit by this weapon will possibly be afflicted with  Faerie Fire.

Name: Fiendish Vigour
Desc 1: Fiendish Vigour is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows the wearer protect themselves with extra Temporary Hit Points.
Desc 2: You can cast  False Life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, without expending a Spell Slot. False Life grants you  7 temporary hit points.

Name: Fiery Return
Desc 1: Fiery Return is a passive feature that grants extra bonus actions when you deal fire damage with a leveled spell.
Desc 2: When you deal ⁠Fire damage with a levelled spell, you  Burn yourself and gain an additional  Bonus Action this round.

Name: Fire Acuity
Desc 1: Fire Acuity is a passive feature that increases your spell power after dealing fire damage.
Desc 2: Whenever you deal ⁠Fire damage, you gain  Arcane Acuity for 2 turns.

Name: First Blood
Desc 1: First Blood is a passive feature that causes targets to bleed.
Desc 2: On a hit, inflict  Bleeding upon targets that have maximum Hit Points.

Name: Fishfolk Faithful
Desc 1: Fishfolk Faithful is a passive feature obtainable by the  Invigorating Fanaticism condition.
Desc 2: Chance to apply Bleeding to targets.

Name: Fit to Burst
Desc 1: Fit to Burst is a Passive Feature available only to Intellect Gluttons. It uses this ability to explode when it dies.
Desc 2: When the intellect glutton dies, it bursts in a  Morphic Brine Explosion.

Name: Flames of Avernus
Desc 1: Flames of Avernus is a passive feature that makes their targets vulnerable to Fire damage.
Desc 2: This merregon's attacks make a target  Flame-Feeble.

Name: Flaming Revenge
Desc 1: Flaming Revenge is a passive feature that raises combat abilities.
Desc 2: On a successful  Saving throw against a foe's spell, deal 1d4 + proficiency bonus⁠Fire damage to them.

Name: Flaming Shroud
Desc 1: Flaming Shroud is a passive feature that burns enemies that damage the wearer.
Desc 2: A creature that damages the wearer within  2 m / 7 ft receives  Burning.

Name: Flurry of Moths
Actions: Flurry of Moths: Attack, Flurry of Moths: Blinding Swarm, Flurry of Moths: Teleport
Desc 1: Flurry of Moths is passive feature available to Swarmkeepers. It turns the Gathered Swarm into moths that deal ⁠Psychic damage and can blind enemies. This feature can be switched out at level up.
Desc 2: You gain a swarm of moths that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional ⁠Psychic damage,  Blind your enemy, or teleport you to a safer location. At higher levels At level 11,  Mighty Swarm upgrades the swarm options to:

Name: Fly Trap
Desc 1: Fly Trap is a passive feature that attempts to prevent a target from moving.
Desc 2: Chance to  Ensnare target if it is not a plant or a beast.

Name: Flying Strike
Desc 1: Flying Strike is a passive feature that enhances the user's damage when they fly, if they are a githyanki.
Desc 2: When a githyanki casts  Fly, their next melee weapon attack deals an additional 1d4⁠Psychic damage.

Name: Focused Conjuration
Desc 1: Focused Conjuration is a Conjuration School Wizard passive feature prevents you from losing concentration on Conjuration spells.
Desc 2: Damage taken while you are Concentrating on a Conjuration spell will not break your  Concentration. Conjuration Wizard Spells that require Concentrating:

Name: Focused Stride
Desc 1: Focused Stride is a passive feature that prevents the wearer from being moved against their will, or being knocked prone.
Desc 2: When you cast a spell that requires  Concentration, you gain  Momentum for 1 turn. While you are concentrating, you cannot be knocked  Prone or moved against your will.

Name: Fond Caress
Desc 1: Fond Caress is a passive feature allowing the ring wearer to receive a defensive bonus.
Desc 2: One of a magical pair of rings, this allows the wearer to receive  Warding Bond from a creature wearing the  matching ring.

Name: Font of Inspiration
Desc 1: Font of Inspiration is a Bard passive feature that causes you to regain all of your  Bardic Inspiration Charges after a Long or Short Rest.
Desc 2: You regain all of your  Bardic Inspirations after a Long or Short Rest.

Name: Forbidden Knowledge
Skills: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
Desc 1: Forbidden Knowledge is a permanent passive feature granted by the Necromancy of Thay that increases a character's Wisdom Saving Throws and Ability checks by +1.
Desc 2: From partially deciphering the  Necromancy of Thay, you gain a +1 bonus to Wisdom Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

Name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Strength)
Desc 1: Auntie Ethel's Hair is a common item that can be used to permanently increase a character's Ability Score by 1. The player character must choose which ability score the hair will increase when receiving it.
Desc 2: Eating Ethel's airy scalp has granted you a permanent boost to Strength.

Name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Dexterity)
Desc 1: Auntie Ethel's Hair is a common item that can be used to permanently increase a character's Ability Score by 1. The player character must choose which ability score the hair will increase when receiving it.
Desc 2: Eating Ethel's airy scalp has granted you a permanent boost to Dexterity.

Name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Constitutionh)
Desc 1: Auntie Ethel's Hair is a common item that can be used to permanently increase a character's Ability Score by 1. The player character must choose which ability score the hair will increase when receiving it.
Desc 2: Eating Ethel's airy scalp has granted you a permanent boost to Constitution.

Desc 1: Auntie Ethel's Hair is a common item that can be used to permanently increase a character's Ability Score by 1. The player character must choose which ability score the hair will increase when receiving it.
Desc 2: Eating Ethel's airy scalp has granted you a permanent boost to Intelligence.

Name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Wisdom)
Desc 1: Auntie Ethel's Hair is a common item that can be used to permanently increase a character's Ability Score by 1. The player character must choose which ability score the hair will increase when receiving it.
Desc 2: Eating Ethel's airy scalp has granted you a permanent boost to Wisdom.

Name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Charisma)
Desc 1: Auntie Ethel's Hair is a common item that can be used to permanently increase a character's Ability Score by 1. The player character must choose which ability score the hair will increase when receiving it.
Desc 2: Eating Ethel's airy scalp has granted you a permanent boost to Charisma.

Name: Force Absorption
Desc 1: Force Absorption is a passive feature that increases your defenses as you get hit.
Desc 2: Gain 2 turns of  Force Conduit when taking ⁠Slashing, ⁠Piercing, or ⁠Bludgeoning damage.

Name: Forest I
Desc 1: Forest is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Barkskin and  Hold Person. At higher levels You can cast  Call Lightning and  Plant Growth. You can cast  Conjure Minor Elemental and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Mass Cure Wounds and  Contagion.

Name: Forest II
Desc 1: Forest is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Barkskin and  Hold Person. At higher levels You can cast  Call Lightning and  Plant Growth. You can cast  Conjure Minor Elemental and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Mass Cure Wounds and  Contagion.

Desc 1: Forest is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Barkskin and  Hold Person. At higher levels You can cast  Call Lightning and  Plant Growth. You can cast  Conjure Minor Elemental and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Mass Cure Wounds and  Contagion.

Name: Forest IV
Desc 1: Forest is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Barkskin and  Hold Person. At higher levels You can cast  Call Lightning and  Plant Growth. You can cast  Conjure Minor Elemental and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Mass Cure Wounds and  Contagion.

Name: Forest Aegis
Desc 1: Forest Aegis is a passive feature that grants the user  Barkskin, setting their AC to 16. It’s not active while in  Wild Shape.
Desc 2: You are invested with the power of the meadows and woods of the land, and have the effect of  Barkskin, increasing your  Armour Class to 16.

Name: Forever Indebted
Desc 1: Forever Indebted is a passive feature available to various debtors in the House of Hope. When damaged the user detonates, creating a big explosion and summoning a random fiendish creature.
Desc 2: A debt to Raphael must be paid - even in death. Upon dying, the debtor explodes in damaging flames and is reincarnated as a fiendish creature bound to Raphael.

Name: Formless Slaughter
Desc 1: Formless Slaughter is a passive feature that enhances the user's combat while the user is transformed.
Desc 2: You gain a +1 to Attack and Damage rolls while shapeshifting or disguised.

Name: Frantic Urgency
Desc 1: Frantic Urgency is a passive feature that grants increased movement when severely injured.
Desc 2: During combat, when the wearer starts their turn with 50% Hit Points or less, they gain  Momentum for 1 turn.

Name: Freecast
Desc 1: Freecast is a toggleable passive feature and a power available to Partial-Illithids. It allows them to bypass the normal expenditure of spell slots, charges or other similar resource costs for their next chosen  Action, once per Long Rest.
Desc 2: You have discovered a marvellous adaptability within yourself. Spell slots, charges, and similar resource costs for your next action or spell are removed. Refreshes after a Long Rest.

Name: Frightened Immunity
Desc 1: Frightened Immunity is a passive feature that keeps the wearer brave.
Desc 2: You can't be  Frightened

Name: Fungal Resistance
Desc 1: Fungal Resistance is a passive feature affecting Pearlspore Bell. It provides a passive buff to Auntie Ethel when alive.
Desc 2: A Pearlspore Bell grants the hag +5 bonus to all Saving Throws.

Name: Fury In The Marrow
Desc 1: Fury In The Marrow is a passive feature that damages enemies when you rage.
Desc 2: When you  Rage, hostile creatures in a  3 m / 10 ft radius must succeed a Weapon action DC  Wisdom saving throw or take 2d4⁠Psychic damage. The targets receive half damage on a save.

Name: Fury of the Small
Desc 1: Fury of the Small is a racial ability of Goblins. This ability allows a goblin to deal extra damage against an enemy larger than the goblin once per combat.
Desc 2: When you damage a creature larger than you, you can choose to deal 1d6⁠Physical extra. Limited to once per combat.

Name: Galvanic Currents
Desc 1: Galvanic Currents is a passive feature that adds lightning damage to each attack.
Desc 2: This weapon deals an additional 1d6⁠Lightning damage.

Name: Genial Strider
Desc 1: Genial Strider is a passive feature that makes difficult terrain easy to traverse.
Desc 2: The wearer's Movement Speed is unimpeded by  Difficult Terrain.

Name: Giantslayer
Desc 1: Giantslayer is a passive feature that does extra damage and has greater accuracy against oversized creatures.
Desc 2: On a hit, double the damage from your Strength modifier. This weapon grants you  Advantage on Attack rolls against Large, Huge or Gargantuan creatures.

Name: Githborn Psionic Resistance
Desc 1: Githborn Psionic Resistance is a passive feature available to githyanki that grants protection against mind based spells.
Desc 2: A githyanki holding this weapon has  Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma  Saving throws, resistance to Psychic damage, and cannot be Charmed.

Name: Githborn Psionic Weapon
Desc 1: Githborn Psionic Weapon is a passive feature granted by certain Githyanki weapons when wielded by a githyanki.
Desc 2: When wielded by a githyanki this weapon deals an additional 1d4⁠Psychic damage.

Name: Githborn Psionic Weapon (1d6)
Desc 1: Githborn Psionic Weapon is a passive feature granted by certain Githyanki weapons when wielded by a githyanki.
Desc 2: When wielded by a githyanki this weapon deals an additional 1d6⁠Psychic damage.

Name: Githyanki Parry
Desc 1: Githyanki Parry is an NPC-exclusive passive feature and reaction that allows githyanki warriors to parry attacks with their greatswords, reducing incoming damage by 10.
Desc 2: Parry unarmed and weapon attacks to reduce their damage by 10. You must be wielding a Greatsword and you can't be Incapacitated, Blinded[See Notes], or Restrained.

Name: Githyanki War Magic
Desc 1: Githyanki War Magic is a passive feature that allows a githyanki to make a follow up weapon attack after casting a spell or cantrip.
Desc 2: After the githyanki casts a spell or cantrip, they can make a weapon attack using a  Bonus Action.

Name: Gleamdance Dagger: Glowing
Desc 1: Gleamdance Dagger: Glowing is a toggleable passive feature that sheds light.
Desc 2: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of  6 m / 20 ft. Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

Name: Gleamdancer
Desc 1: Gleamdancer is a passive feature that increases your armour while wielded in the off-hand.
Desc 2: When this dagger is wielded in the off-hand, the wielder gains a +1 bonus to  Armour Class.

Name: Gloom Step
Desc 1: Gloom Step is a passive feature that increases the user's movement speed in darkness.
Desc 2: Movement is increased by 3 m / 10 ft when starting a turn in darkness.

Name: Glorious Pointy Hat
Desc 1: Glorious Pointy Hat is a passive feature that improves the wearer's persuasion using their intelligence.
Desc 2: You gain a bonus to your  Persuasion checks equal to your  Intelligence Modifier.

Name: Gnome Cunning
Desc 1: Gnome Cunning is a passive feature that grants  Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma  Saving throws. It is available to all Gnome characters.
Desc 2: You have  Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

Name: Goblin's Undoing
Desc 1: Goblin's Undoing is a passive feature that makes it difficult for goblin's to attack the user.
Desc 2: Goblins have  Disadvantage on Attack rolls against the wielder.

Name: Godswill
Desc 1: Godswill is a passive feature that boots the user's ability to channel their god's power.
Desc 2: You gain an additional use of  Channel Divinity Charge. Once used, it is restored upon taking a Long Rest[See: Bugs].

Name: Gold Plating
Desc 1: Gold Plating is a passive feature that grants increased Constitution, Armour Class, and Hit Points
Desc 2: This creature has been blessed by Mammon, giving them a second skin of gold that increases their Constitution to 20 and their base  Armour Class to 15, and grants an additional 66 hit points⁠hit points.

Name: Gontr Mael: Glowing
Desc 1: Gontr Mael: Glowing is a toggleable passive feature granted by  Gontr Mael. It causes the bow to emit a light around the equipped weapon.
Desc 2: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of  6 m / 20 ft. Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light. Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

Name: Grasp of the Forest
Desc 1: Grasp of the Forest is a passive feature that makes weapon attacks Entangle the target on hit.
Desc 2: Weapon attacks can  Entangle the target.

Name: Grassland I
Desc 1: Grassland is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Invisibility and  Pass Without Trace. At higher levels You can cast  Daylight and  Haste. You can cast  Freedom of Movement and  Polymorph. You can cast  Greater Restoration and  Insect Plague.

Name: Grassland II
Desc 1: Grassland is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Invisibility and  Pass Without Trace. At higher levels You can cast  Daylight and  Haste. You can cast  Freedom of Movement and  Polymorph. You can cast  Greater Restoration and  Insect Plague.

Desc 2: You can cast  Invisibility and  Pass Without Trace. At higher levels You can cast  Daylight and  Haste. You can cast  Freedom of Movement and  Polymorph. You can cast  Greater Restoration and  Insect Plague.

Desc 1: Grassland is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Invisibility and  Pass Without Trace. At higher levels You can cast  Daylight and  Haste. You can cast  Freedom of Movement and  Polymorph. You can cast  Greater Restoration and  Insect Plague.

Name: Grave Magic
Desc 1: Grave Magic is a passive feature available to Cult of the Absolute Necromancers. It gives them an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage to their spell attacks.
Desc 2: Whenever you deal damage with a spell, deal an additional 1d8⁠Necrotic damage.

Name: Great Weapon Fighting
Desc 1: Great Weapon Fighting is a Fighting Style passive feature.
Desc 2: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack with a Two-Handed melee weapon, that die is rerolled once.

Name: Great Weapon Master: All In
Desc 1: Great Weapon Master: All In is a toggleable passive feature provided by the Great Weapon Master Feat that allows Two-Handed or Versatile weapon users to deal extra damage at the cost of reduced accuracy.
Desc 2: When attacking with a melee weapon you are Proficient with and are wielding in both hands, Attack Rolls take a -5 penalty, but their damage increases by 10.

Name: Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack
Desc 1: Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack is a passive feature obtainable by the Great Weapon Master Feat. If you kill a target or land a Critical Hit with a melee weapon, you can use a Bonus Action to make another melee weapon attack.
Desc 2: When you land a Critical Hit or kill a target with a melee weapon attack, you can make another melee weapon attack as a  Bonus Action that turn.

Name: Great Wyrm's Scales
Desc 1: Great Wyrm's Scales is a passive feature that grants a creature damage reduction against all incoming attacks
Desc 2: All incoming damage is reduced by 2.

Name: Greater Kushigo Counter
Desc 1: Greater Kushigo Counter is a passive feature that lets users retaliate against melee attacks that miss.
Desc 2: The wearer can use a  Reaction to make an  Unarmed Strike against any attacker that misses.

Name: Greater Wyrm's Scales
Desc 1: Greater Wyrm's Scales is a passive feature that grants a creature damage reduction against all incoming attacks
Desc 2: All incoming damage is reduced by 4.

Name: Green Bed Regeneration
Desc 1: Green Bed Regeneration is a passive feature that heals the wearer while surrounded by plants.
Desc 2: When starting your turn on  Plant Growth or  Vines regain 1d4⁠hit points hit points.

Name: Gregarious Caster
Desc 1: Gregarious Caster is a passive feature that increases your cantrip damage significantly.
Desc 2: Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your Charisma Modifier.

Name: Grievous Retribution
Desc 1: Grievous Retribution is a passive feature that penalizes enemies that strike you.
Desc 2: When an enemy damages the wearer, the wearer gains  Wrath for 2 turns.

Name: Grim Harvest
Desc 1: Grim Harvest is a Necromancy School Wizard passive feature. It allows the caster to regain hit points every time they kill a creature with a spell. The amount regained is based on the spell slot level used, and is increased if a Necromancy spell is used.
Desc 2: Once per turn, if you kill a creature with a spell, you regain Hit Points equal to twice the Spell Slot level used - thrice if it's a Necromancy spell. Undead and Constructs are unaffected.

Name: Grim Irony
Desc 1: Grim Irony is a passive feature that can incapacitate both the target and user in fits of laughter.
Desc 2: Whenever this weapon lands a critical hit, both target and attacker must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw, or be affected by  fits of laughter.

Name: Grit
Desc 1: Grit is a passive feature that boosts the wearer's actions if they are severely injured.
Desc 2: When the wearer has 50% Hit Points or less, they have an additional  Bonus Action.

Name: Guardian of Faith
Desc 1: Guardian of Faith is a passive feature used by the summons of the same name. It allows them to automatically attack enemies entering their range with  Strike of the Guardian. This is the inverse of how Opportunity Attacks normally work.
Desc 2: When an enemy enters your attack range, you can strike them.

Name: Halfling Luck
Desc 1: Halfling Luck is a passive feature in Baldur's Gate 3 which allows all halflings to reroll any (d20) dice once when it lands on a 1 for an Attack Roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw.
Desc 2: When you roll a 1 for an Attack roll,  Ability check, or  Saving throw, you can reroll the dice and must use the new roll.

Name: Haroldish Doom
Desc 1: Haroldish Doom is a passive feature that diminishes a target's combat prowess whenever you deal damage to the target.
Desc 2: When dealing damage to a target with a ranged weapon, the target must succeed a Charisma  Saving throw or be  Baned for 2 turns.

Name: Harrowing Presence
Desc 1: Harrowing Presence is a passive feature that breaks the spirit of nearby creatures.

Name: Heart Ablaze
Desc 1: Heart Ablaze grants Karlach Immunity to  Charmed effects.
Desc 2: Infernal iron has anchored the war machine that is Karlach's heart. She can touch others without burning them, and can no longer be  Charmed.

Name: Heart of Ice
Desc 1: Heart of Ice is a passive feature that lets the wielder deal extra cold damage when dealing cold damage.
Desc 2: When dealing ⁠Cold damage, the wielder deals an additional 1⁠Cold. A Frostbitten creature that takes Cold damage will take an additional 1 Cold damage per turn of Frostbite remaining.

Name: Heart of Iron
Desc 1: Heart of Iron grants Karlach  Advantage on Saving Throws against  Charmed effects.
Desc 2: The infernal engine that is Karlach's heart is burning more evenly. She has  Advantage on Saving Throws against being  Charmed.

Name: Heart of the Storm
Actions: Heart of the Storm: Lightning, Heart of the Storm: Thunder
Desc 1: Heart of the Storm is a set of two Storm Sorcery Sorcerer passive features that create a storm that deals half your Sorcerer level, rounded down, when you cast a lightning or thunder spell.
Desc 2: When you cast a Spell of Level 1 or higher that deals Lightning or Thunder damage, you cause a small, local storm. All enemies within  6 m / 20 ft take (Sorcerer Level / 2)⁠Lightning or (Sorcerer Level / 2)⁠Thunder.

Name: Heart of the Storm: Resistance
Desc 1: Heart of the Storm: Resistance is a Storm Sorcery Sorcerer passive that gives you resistance to both Lightning and Thunder damage.
Desc 2: You are Resistant to ⁠Lightning and ⁠Thunder damage

Name: Heat Convergence
Desc 1: Heat Convergence is a toggleable passive feature available to entities with the  Heat condition. It allows them to consume all turns of  Heat to deal extra Fire damage on their next spell or attack.
Desc 2: Consume your  Heat to fuel a powerful attack. The next time you deal Fire damage, you deal an additional 1⁠Fire damage for every turn of  Heat remaining.

Name: Heavily Armoured
Desc 1: Heavily Armoured is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. You gain Proficiency with Heavy Armour and your Strength increases by 1.
Desc 2: You gain Proficiency with Heavy Armour and your Strength increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. You must have Medium Armour Proficiency before you can take this feat.

Name: Heavy Armour Master
Desc 1: Heavy Armour Master is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. Your mastery over heavy armour increases, granting you damage reduction of incoming non-magical damage by 3.
Desc 2: Your Strength increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. Incoming damage from non-magical attacks also decreases by 3 while you're wearing heavy armour. Requires Proficiency with Heavy Armour

Name: Heavy Hitter
Desc 1: Heavy Hitter is a passive feature that sends opponents reeling on every hit.
Desc 2: Your weapon hits hard enough to send your target  Reeling for 2 turns.

Name: Heightened Awareness
Desc 1: Heightened Awareness is a passive feature that increases the user's initiative and perception of their surroundings.
Desc 2: Gain a +3 bonus to Initiative rolls and  Advantage on  Perception checks.

Name: Heightened Manoeuvre
Desc 1: Heightened Manoeuvre is a passive feature that gives enemies disadvantage against battle master manoeuvre saves.
Desc 2: Targets have  Disadvantage on  Saving throws against your Manoeuvre and Weapon Actions.

Name: Heightened Necromancy
Desc 1: Heightened Necromancy is a passive feature that causes creatures to be more likely to fail against your necromancy spells.
Desc 2: Creatures have  Disadvantage on  Saving throws against your necromancy spells.

Name: Helldusk Armour
Desc 1: Helldusk Armour is a passive feature that enables this piece of equipment to be worn by everybody
Desc 2: You are considered Proficient with this armour while wearing it.

Name: Hellish Rebuke
Desc 1: Hellish Rebuke is a passive feature that allows using a reaction to retaliate against an enemy that damaged the user.
Desc 2: React to your next attacker with flames that deal 2d10⁠Fire. At higher levels Upcast: Deals an additional 1d10⁠Fire damage per level.

Name: Hellish Resistance
Desc 1: Hellish Resistance is a passive feature that grants Tieflings Resistance to ⁠Fire damage from magical and non-magical sources.
Desc 2: Your blood protects you from flame, abyssal or otherwise. Gain Resistance to ⁠Fire damage, taking only half damage from it.

Name: Hellstalker
Desc 1: Hellstalker is a passive feature that can set your targets on fire if you are hiding.
Desc 2: Possibly inflict  Burning when attacking while  Hiding or  Invisible.

Name: Helm's Protection
Desc 1: Helm's Protection is a passive feature that protects the user's targets after healing them.
Desc 2: When you heal another creature, it gains Resistance to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks for 2 turns.

Name: Hex Warrior
Weapon Proficiency: Flails, Morningstars, Rapiers, Scimitars, Shortswords, War Picks, Battleaxes, Longswords, Tridents, Warhammers, Glaives, Greataxes, Greatswords, Halberds, Mauls, Pikes, Hand Crossbows, Heavy Crossbows, Longbows
Desc 1: Hex Warrior is a passive feature granted to The Hexblade warlocks at level 1.
Desc 2: You gain proficiency with  Medium armour,  Shields, and  Martial weapons. You gain  Bind Hexed Weapon, which lets you use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity when attacking with weapons that you are proficient with.

Name: High Spellcasting (Infernal Rapier)
Desc 1: High Spellcasting is a passive feature that makes the wearers spells more potent and difficult to defend against.
Desc 2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC.

Name: High Spellcasting (+1)
Desc 1: High Spellcasting is a passive feature that makes the wearers spells more potent and difficult to defend against.
Desc 2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC.

Name: High Spellcasting (+2)
Desc 1: High Spellcasting is a passive feature that makes the wearers spells more potent and difficult to defend against.
Desc 2: You gain a +2 bonus to Spell Save DC.

Name: Hoarfrost Balance
Desc 1: Hoarfrost Balance is a passive feature that prevents the user from slipping on ice.
Desc 2: You cannot fall  Prone while traversing  Icy terrain.

Name: Homing Weapon
Desc 1: Homing Weapon is a passive feature that sends the weapon back to its owner after being thrown.
Desc 2: This weapon will return to its owner when thrown.

Name: Horde Breaker
Desc 1: Horde Breaker is a Hunter Ranger passive feature that grants you the ability to target two creatures next to each other.
Desc 2: Target two creatures standing close to each other, attacking them in quick succession.

Name: Human Versatility
Desc 1: Human Versatility is a passive feature that grants Humans Proficiency in a skill of their choice and Carrying Capacity is increased by a quarter.
Desc 2: Select an additional Skill to be Proficient in. Your carrying capacity is increased by a quarter.

Name: Hunter's Camouflage
Desc 1: This passive increases the user's defense after they receive damage, at the expense of their reaction.
Desc 2: After receiving damage, the creature immediately uses their reaction to  Blur

Name: Hunter's Eye
Desc 1: Hunter's Eye is a passive feature that increases the damage against creatures marked by certain spells.
Desc 2: You gain a +1d4 bonus to Attack rolls against creatures marked by Hunter's Mark,  True Strike,  Faerie Fire, or  Guiding Bolt.

Name: Ichorous Corrosion
Desc 1: Ichorous Corrosion is a passive feature that applies noxious fumes on the user's targets when the user deals acid damage to them.
Desc 2: When the wearer deals ⁠Acid damage, they also inflict  Noxious Fumes on the target(s).

Name: Illithid Euphoria
Desc 1: Illithid Euphoria is a passive feature that grants the user improved combat abilities after charming or frightening a creature.
Desc 2: Charm or Frighten a creature to gain a 1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and Saving throws.

Name: Illithid Expertise
Desc 1: Illithid Expertise is a passive feature and Illithid Power available to Partial-Illithids. This feature gives a character Expertise in Persuasion, Deception and Intimidation Checks.
Desc 2: You have deepened your sense of self, gaining Expertise in Persuasion, Deception, and Intimidation Checks.

Name: Illithid Persuasion
Desc 1: Illithid Persuasion is a unique illithid power which allows Origin characters, as well as  Minthara and  Minsc, to impose their will onto others with the Brand of the Absolute through conversation. This ability is unlocked automatically.
Desc 2: Impose your authority onto those with the Brand of the Absolute. Properties During certain conversations just before dialog choices come up, the Narrator states As the symbol glows

Name: Illithid Protection
Desc 1: Illithid Protection is a passive feature that provides a bit of mind protection but only if infested by a tadpole.
Desc 2: If the wearer is infested by a mind flayer tadpole, they gain +1 to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma  Saving throws.

Name: Illusion Quickening
Desc 1: Illusion Quickening is a passive feature that lets the wearer cast illusion or enchantment spells after making a weapon attack.
Desc 2: After hitting a creature with a weapon attack, you can cast illusion or enchantment spells as a  Bonus Action.

Name: Immune to Control Undead
Desc 1: Immune To Control Undead is a passive feature that prevents this Undead creature from being magically controlled by others. Most noticeable example is the Control Undead oath paladins might have.
Desc 2: This creature is so powerful, it simply cannot be controlled by the magical whim of others.

Name: Immutable Existence
Desc 1: Immutable Existence makes the user immune to effects like Polymorphed. Furthermore, the user cannot be removed from this plane of existence.
Desc 2: Spells that alter someone's form have no effect on the affected entity, and it cannot be removed from this plane of existence.

Name: Immutable Form
Desc 1: Immutable Form makes the wearer immune to effects like Polymorphed. Furthermore, gets a +5 bonus to saving throws against  Banishment.
Desc 2: Spells that alter someone's form have no effect on the affected entity, and it has a +5 bonus to  Saving throws against spells that would remove it from this plane.[See: Bugs]

Name: Impenetrable Shadow
Desc 1: Impenetrable Shadow is a passive feature available to Viconia DeVir on Honour Mode.
Desc 2: If Viconia ends her turn in darkness, she receives  Sanctuary of Loss. Viconia can use  Heartwrench and still keep this protection.

Name: Imperial Retaliation
Desc 1: Imperial Retaliation is a passive feature that retaliates against an attacker by stunning them.
Desc 2: When the wielder succeeds a  Saving throw, the foe that caused the throw needs to make an  Intelligence saving throw or be  Stunned for 1 turn.

Name: Improved Abjuration
Desc 1: Improved Abjuration is a passive feature of the Abjuration School Wizard. When you take a Short Rest, you can boost your Arcane Ward charges by your wizard level.
Desc 2: Each time you take a Short Rest, the intensity of your  Arcane Ward increases by an amount equal to your wizard level.

Name: Improved Bardic Inspiration
Desc 1: Improved Bardic Inspiration is a passive feature that improves the user's Bardic Inspiration.
Desc 2: The bonus gained from  Bardic Inspiration increases to  +1d8. At higher levels When the Bard reaches Level 10, the bonus increases to  +1d10.

Name: Improved Bardic Inspiration: Attack Roll or Ability Check
Desc 1: Improved Bardic Inspiration: Attack Roll or Ability Check is a passive feature that allows the user to improve the success of their next attack or ability roll.
Desc 2: Add a +1d12 bonus to your next Attack roll or Ability Check.

Name: Improved Bardic Inspiration: Saving Throw
Desc 1: Improved Bardic Inspiration: Saving Throw is a passive feature that allows the user to improve the chance of success on their next saving throw when active.
Desc 2: Add a +1d12 bonus to your next  Saving throw.

Name: Improved Combat Superiority
Desc 1: Improved Combat Superiority is a Battle Master Fighter passive feature that increases the strength of their Maneuvers.
Desc 2: The size of your  Superiority Die increases to a   d10

Name: Improved Critical
Desc 1: Improved Critical is a passive feature that increases the wielder's critical hit chance.
Desc 2: The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

Name: Improved Critical Hit
Desc 1: Improved Critical Hit is a Champion Fighter passive feature that reduces the number they need to roll for a critical hit by 1.
Desc 2: The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

Name: Improved Divine Smite
Desc 1: Improved Divine Smite is a passive feature available to Paladins that adds extra damage to all of their weapon strikes. This damage stacks with all other sources.
Desc 2: Your attacks are suffused with divine might.  Melee weapon attacks deal an additional 1d8⁠Radiant damage.

Name: Improved Elemental Casting
Desc 1: Improved Elemental Casting is a Way of the Four Elements Monk passive feature that improves the strength and damage of your Four Elements Spells.
Desc 2: Your affinity with elemental ki deepens. Several of your offensive Four Elements features deal an additional dice of damage, your  Clench of the North Wind can hold an additional creature, and your  Embrace of the Inferno fires an extra ray.

Name: Improved Extra Attack
Desc 1: Improved Extra Attack is a Fighter passive feature that allows you to make 2 additional attacks when making an Attack Action.
Desc 2: You can make two additional attacks after attacking with your main-hand weapon.

Name: Improved Minor Illusion
Desc 1: Improved Minor Illusion is a passive feature granted to Illusion School Wizards. It grants them an improved version of Minor Illusion.
Desc 2: You can cast  Minor Illusion as a bonus action.

Name: Improved Wild Strike
Desc 1: Improved Wild Strike is a Druid passive feature that lets you make further multiple unarmed attacks while Wildshaped.
Desc 2: You can make 2 additional attacks after making an unarmed or weapon strike while in wildshape.

Name: Impulse Blast
Desc 1: Impulse Blast is a passive feature that sends a shockwave when killing or landing critical hits.
Desc 2: Knocks nearby creatures  Prone after killing a target or landing a Critical Hit.

Name: Incorporeal Movement
Desc 1: Incorporeal Movement is a passive feature available to Poltergeists.
Desc 2: Opportunity attacks against you have Disadvantage.

Name: Inescapable Destruction
Desc 1: Inescapable Destruction is a Death Domain cleric passive feature. It allows ⁠Necrotic dealt by the cleric to bypass Resistance to ⁠Necrotic damage.
Desc 2: Damage you deal ignores Resistance to ⁠Necrotic damage.

Name: Inevitable Resolve
Desc 1: Inevitable Resolve is a unique  Raphael passive feature that prevents him from being controlled or incapacitated.
Desc 2: Effects that control or incapacitate creatures only last 1 turn against this being of pure infernal ambition.

Name: Infectious Greed
Desc 1: Infectious Greed is a passive feature used by Helsik that gives the user and its allies a boost in damage as long as they remain close by.
Desc 2: Tempted by the riches that Mammon offers to those most faithful to him, all allies in the presence of this creature are affected by  Infectious Greed

Name: Infectious Madness
Desc 1: Infectious Madness is a passive feature available to Cranium Rats, which causes attackers to become  Confused unless they pass an Intelligence  Saving throw.
Desc 2: After the cranium rat takes damage, the attacker must make an Intelligence Saving Throw or become Confused.

Name: Infernal Acuity
Desc 1: Infernal Acuity is a passive feature that grants a bonus to your spells.
Desc 2: You gain +1 bonus to Spell Attack Rolls and Spell Save DC.

Name: Infernal Evasion
Desc 1: Infernal Evasion is a passive feature that lets the user use a reaction to make a saving throw.
Desc 2: When you fail a  Saving throw, you may use your  Reaction to succeed instead.

Name: Infernal Legion
Desc 1: Infernal Legion is a passive feature that makes the wearer a part of the legion.
Desc 2: Grants the  Infernal Legion condition while worn.

Name: Infernal Retribution
Desc 1: Infernal Retribution is a passive feature that burns an attacker whenever the wearer succeeds a Saving Throw.
Desc 2: When you succeed a  Saving throw, the caster receives  Burning (Orthonic) for 3 turns.

Name: Infernal Sight
Desc 1: Infernal Sight is a passive feature that lets the wearer see in normal darkness, and provides immunity against blindness.
Desc 2: You can see in magical and ordinary darkness up to a range of  12 m / 40 ft. You cannot be  Blinded.

Name: Infernal Touch
Desc 1: Infernal Touch is a passive feature that adds fire damage to the wearer's weapon attacks or necrotic damage to unarmed attacks.
Desc 2: Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d6⁠Fire damage. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d6⁠Necrotic damage, and can possibly inflict  Bleeding.

Name: Infernal Weapon
Desc 1: Infernal Weapon is a passive feature that poisons your target an addition to your regular damage.
Desc 2: On a hit, this weapon deals an additional 3⁠Poison damage and can possibly  Poison its target.

Name: Infernal Weapon (merregon)
Desc 1: Infernal Weapon is a passive feature only available to Vengeful Merregons that constantly ignites their weapons in fire.
Desc 2: This creature's weapon will ignite at the start of its turns, dealing an additional 1d4⁠Fire.

Name: Infested
Desc 1: Infested is a passive feature available to ettercaps which lets them Infest nearby creatures.
Desc 2: Crawling with tiny spiders that deal 1~4⁠Piercing and 1~4⁠Poison each turn. When hit with a melee attack, the infestation spreads to the attacker. Upon death, the infestation spreads to all nearby creatures. Removed by fire or acid. Doesn't harm ettercaps or spiders.

Name: Innate Fortitude
Desc 1: Innate Fortitude is a passive feature that lets you reroll attacks and saing throws.
Desc 2: Once per Long Rest, you can use a  Reaction to make an Attack roll or  Saving throw with  Advantage. Grants:

Name: Innate Invisibility
Desc 1: Innate Invisibility is a passive feature that grants permanent invisibility.
Desc 2: Invisible by nature, this creature can only be seen through magical means.

Name: Insidious Cold
Desc 1: Insidious Cold is a passive feature that chills your targets whenever you deal cold damage.
Desc 2: Dealing Cold damage with a spell possibly inflicts  Chilled upon the target.

Name: Intense Adamantine Backlash
Desc 1: Intense Adamantine Backlash is a passive feature that can cause melee attackers to be sent  Reeling.
Desc 2: When a melee attack hits you, the Attacker is sent  Reeling for 3 turns. Reeling creatures have a -1 penalty to Attack Rolls for every turn remaining.

Name: Interplanar Slayer
Desc 1: Interplanar Slayer is a passive feature that increases damage against otherworldly creatures.
Desc 2: This weapon grants a +1d4 bonus to damage and Attack rolls against githyanki, aberrations, fiends, and elementals.

Name: Intimate Embrace
Desc 1: Intimate Embrace is a passive feature allowing the other ring wearer to receive a defensive bonus.
Desc 2: One of a magical pair of rings, this allows the wearer to cast  Warding Bond once per Long Rest on a creature wearing the  matching ring.

Name: Inured to Undeath
Desc 1: Inured to Undeath is a Necromancy School Wizard passive feature that enhances your mastery over death. You become resistant to Necrotic damage and cannot have your maximum hit points reduced.
Desc 2: You have steeped yourself so completely in death that you are Resistant to Necrotic damage, and moreover your hit point maximum cannot be reduced.

Name: Invisible Weapon
Desc 1: Invisible Weapon is a passive feature that prevents the wielder from being disarmed, until it becomes visible on a missed attack.
Desc 2: This weapon is  Invisible while equipped. It has  Advantage on Attack rolls. It loses this property for 2 rounds on a missed Attack roll. The weapon also scores a critical hit when rolling a 19.

Name: Iron Mind
Desc 1: Iron Mind is a Gloom Stalker Ranger passive feature that increases your defenses against certain mental attacks.
Desc 2: You gain Proficiency in Wisdom and Intelligence  Saving throws.

Name: Ironvine
Desc 1: Ironvine is a passive feature that automatically damages an attacker as long as you are using Shillelagh.
Desc 2: While the wielder is holding a weapon empowered with  Shillelagh, and when they are hit by a melee attack, the attacker takes ⁠Piercing Damage equal to the wielder's Wisdom modifier.

Name: Isolated Prey
Desc 1: Isolated Prey is passive feature gives a creature  Advantage on Attack Rolls against targets that do not have allies within 5m.
Desc 2: This creature has Advantage on Attack Rolls against targets that do not have allies within 5m.

Name: Jack of All Trades
Desc 1: Jack of All Trades is a Bard passive feature that makes you add half your Proficiency Bonus to Ability Checks that you aren't Proficient in.
Desc 2: Your vast experiences make you more likely to succeed in any undertaking. Add half of your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) to Ability Checks that you are not Proficient in.

Name: Keen Attack
Desc 1: Keen Attack is a passive feature that greatly increases their chance to hit.
Desc 2: The wielder doubles their Proficiency Bonus when rolling ranged attacks with this weapon, unless they have Disadvantage.

Name: Keen Senses
Desc 1: Keen Senses is a passive feature that grants Elves and Drow Proficiency in Perception.
Desc 2: You are Proficient in Perception.

Name: Keeper of the Veil
Desc 1: Keeper of the Veil is a Ranger passive feature of Favoured Enemy. You gain proficiency in Arcana and can cast the spell  Protection from Evil and Good once per long rest.
Desc 2: You specialise in hunting creatures from other planes of existence. You gain Proficiency in Arcana and can grant protection against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.

Name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
Desc 1: Ki-Empowered Strikes is a Monk passive feature that allows unarmed attacks to count as magical while attacking enemies with resistance to physical attacks. In effect, unarmed attacks will ignore resistance and immunity to ⁠Slashing, ⁠Piercing, ⁠Bludgeoning non magical damage of the corresponding type.
Desc 2: Your unarmed attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming enemies' Resistance and Immunity to non-magical damage.

Name: Knockdown Jaws
Desc 1: Knockdown Jaws is a passive feature that allows the user's bite attacks to knock targets Prone.
Desc 2: Bite attacks from this creature can possibly knock the target  Prone.

Name: Kushigo's Might
Desc 1: Uninhibited Kushigo is a passive feature that increases throwing and improvised weapon damage.
Desc 2: The wearer deals an additional   1d4 damage with  Throw Attacks and attacks made with  Improvised Weapons.

Name: Land's Stride: Advantage
Desc 1: Land's Stride: Advantage is a passive feature which grants advantage when resisting some to plant-based effects. It is an unlisted component of the Land's Stride feature.
Desc 2: You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness. You have  Advantage on  Saving throws against plants that are magically created to impede your movement.

Name: Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain
Desc 1: Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain is a passive feature that makes it so that you are not slowed when traversing Difficult Terrain. It is a component of Land's Stride.
Desc 2: You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness. Difficult Terrain no longer slows you down.

Name: Land's Stride: Plants
Desc 1: Land's Stride: Plants is a passive feature which confers immunity to many plant-based hazards. It is an unlisted component of the Land's Stride feature.
Desc 2: You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness. Plant-based surfaces with thorns, spines, or similar hazards no longer harm you.

Name: Last Hope
Desc 1: Last Hope is a passive feature that grants Hope Death Ward at the start of combat.
Desc 2: Hope always begins combat under the effects of  Death Ward.

Name: Last Stand
Desc 1: Last Stand is a passive feature that increases your damage when you are severely wounded.
Desc 2: During combat, when the wearer starts their turn with 50% Hit Points or less, they gain  Wrath for 2 turns.

Name: Lathander's Blessing
Desc 1: Lathander's Blessing is a passive feature that protects the wielder should they fall in combat.
Desc 2: Once per Long Rest, when your hit points are reduced to 0, you regain 2d6⁠hit points. Allies within 9 m / 30 ft also regain 1d6⁠hit points.

Name: Lathander's Light
Desc 1: Lathander's Light is a toggleable passive feature that sheds light and blinds enemies.
Desc 2: Sheds holy light in a  6 m / 20 ft radius. In combat, fiends and undead standing in the light are  Blinded if they fail a DC 14 Constitution throw.

Name: Lay Bare Their Weakness
Desc 1: Lay Bare Their Weakness is a passive feature that increases the difficulty to resist the wearer's spells.
Desc 2: After dealing damage with an unarmed attack, the wearer gains a +1 bonus to their spell save DC until the end of their turn.

Name: Leap to Your Feet
Desc 1: Leap to Your Feet is a Way of the Drunken Master monk passive feature that helps them get up quicker from being prone.
Desc 2: When you are  Prone, standing up uses only 1.5 m / 5 ft of your  Movement Speed speed.

Name: Legendary Action: Adamantine Reverberation
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Adamantine Reverberation is a legendary action passive feature available to Grym in Honour mode. Once per turn when struck by an attack, Grym reverberates, granting  10 temporary hit points and doubled movement speed until the temporary hit points are depleted.
Desc 2: Once per round, Grym can use its Legendary Action to  Reverberate when it is struck, doubling its movement and granting it 10 temporary hit points. Losing these temporary hit points triggers a shockwave that knocks targets back  4 m / 13 ft and deals 4d8⁠Thunder damage. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Beguiling Rebuke
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Beguiling Rebuke is a passive feature available to Raphael while he is not in his  Fiendish Ascension form. It lets him expend a legendary action to use Beguiling Rebuke, after he or his allies are attacked.
Desc 2: Raphael can spend a Legendary Action to immediately  Beguile a hostile creature and its allies after being attacked. Raphael may use this Legendary Action as many times per round as there are Soul Pillars standing at the start of the round. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Bhaal's Edict
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Bhaal's Edict is a passive feature available to the Boon of Bhaal during combat with Orin in Honour mode, provided she is not being duelled alone.
Desc 2: If Orin has not used her Legendary Action by the end of a round, and Orin is not duelling her opponent alone, the Dread Lord places a creature under  Bhaal's Edict. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Blinding Ambush
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Blinding Ambush is a passive feature available to Yurgir in Honour mode, that lets him use Blinding Ambush and Watchful Hunt.
Desc 2: Once per round, Yurgir can spend a Legendary Action to  Blinding Ambush a  Hunted creature when it attempts to attack or cast a spell. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Call Consort
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Call Consort is a passive feature available to the Owlbear mother in her nest in Honour mode. It gives her access to  Call Consort to call her  mate, who has the same base stats and can use  Vengeful Father.
Desc 2: Once per combat, the Owlbear mother can spend a Legendary Action to  summon her mate when she is attacked. Although Legendary Actions normally restore at the start of each round, this one may only be used once.

Name: Legendary Action: Devoted Galvanism
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Devoted Galvanism is a passive feature used by Dror Ragzlin in Honour mode that lets him use  Galvanise nearby allies when they are attacked.
Desc 2: Once per round when an enemy targets their ally with an ability, Dror Ragzlin can use a Legendary Action to  Galvanise Absolutists within  5 m / 17 ft, granting them  Action Surge. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Draconic Fury
Desc 1: This legendary action allows use of a dragon's breath weapon once per round as a free reaction.
Desc 2: The dragon can retaliate against an attacker with its breath weapon once per round.

Name: Legendary Action: Draconic Wrath
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Draconic Wrath is a passive feature available to Ansur, that lets him use a legendary action to react with his  Lightning Breath once per round after being attacked
Desc 2: The dragon can retaliate against an attacker with its breath weapon once per round.

Name: Legendary Action: Fanatic Retaliation
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Fanatic Retaliation is a passive feature available to Kar'niss in Honour mode, which lets him use the legendary action  Fanatic Retaliation immediately after one of his spindleweb fanatics is killed. He will target the killer.
Desc 2: Once per round when a  Spindleweb Fanatic is killed, Kar'niss can use a Legendary Action to possibly deal 6d10⁠Psychic and  Silence the attacker. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Gaze of the Dead
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Gaze of the Dead is a passive feature available to Apostle of Myrkul in Honour Mode that allows him to use a Legendary action to retaliate against an attacker.
Desc 2: Once per round, Myrkul's Apostle can spend a Legendary Action to cast  Gaze of the Dead on a creature when attacked. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Gossamer Tomb
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Gossamer Tomb is a passive feature available to the Phase Spider Matriarch in Honour mode, that lets her entomb in web a creature attacking one of her spiderlings.
Desc 2: Once per round if her offspring is attacked, the Phase Spider Matriarch can spend a Legendary Action to use  Gossamer Tomb. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Grasping Appendage
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Grasping Appendage is a legendary action passive feature available to Malus Thorm, that lets him pull an enemy towards him.
Desc 2: Once per round, Malus Thorm can use his Legendary Action to  Grasp a creature and pull it closer. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Heartwrench
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Heartwrench is a passive feature available to Viconia DeVir on Honour Mode.
Desc 2: Once per round, Viconia can use a Legendary Action to  Heartwrench a  Heartform Mapped creature after it strikes her or her allies. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Hordestrike
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Hordestrike is a passive feature available to Ketheric in Honour mode.
Desc 2: Once per round, Ketheric can spend a Legendary Action to  Hordestrike an enemy when it is attacked by one of his minions following  Deadly Orders. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Leaping Static
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Leaping Static is a passive feature available to Bernard in Honour mode. It lets Bernard use the legendary action Leaping Static as a reaction to being attacked.
Desc 2: Once per round, Bernard can spend a Legendary Action to immediately launch  Leaping Static at a foe after being attacked. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Mind-Claw of Tu'narath
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Mind-Claw of Tu'narath is a passive feature affecting Ch'r'ai W'wargaz on Honour mode. It allows him to use a Legendary action to summons a deadly psionic blade in response to the inquisitor or an ally being attacked.
Desc 2: Twice per round, Inquisitor W'wargaz can spend a Legendary Action to summon a Mind-Claw of Tu'narath after he or his allies are struck. When the claw strikes, W'wargaz may  Mindsteal Link with a target not already affected by this condition. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Murderous Retort
