Desc 1: Legendary Action: Murderous Retort is a passive feature that lets its user use the Legendary Action  Murderous Retort to strike back at attackers.
Desc 2: Once per round, Orin or Sarevok can use their Legendary Action to immediately strike back at their attacker. If  Deathbringer's Legacy is active, they use  Deathbringer's Assault (Sarevok) or  Deathbringer's Assault (Orin) instead. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Ocular Nightmare
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Ocular Nightmare is a passive feature available to the Spectator, that lets it use a legendary action to attack all creatures nearby with eye beams.
Desc 2: After accumulating five  Paranoid Dreams, the Spectator will spend a Legendary Action to cast  Ocular Nightmare.

Name: Legendary Action: Overflowing Brew
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Overflowing Brew is a passive feature used by Thisobald Thorm in Honour Mode, which lets him use his legendary action  Overflowing Brew.
Desc 2: Once per round, Thisobald Thorm can use his Legendary Action when his brew is changed by a foe's attack to make it overflow, dealing 3d6 of the corresponding damage type. The overflow also grants his allies +5 bonus to Strength or an additional +1d6 damage of the corresponding damage type. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Psionic Visage
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Psionic Visage is a legendary passive feature available to Nere in Honour mode. When attacked, Nere can cast Psionic Visage to protect himself from ⁠Physical damage with 3 psionic copies of himself.
Desc 2: Once per round, Nere can use his Legendary Action to cast  Psionic Visage on himself when attacked. When he is attacked, Nere's summoned visages will  Detonate. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Ptarian Dogma
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Ptarian Dogma is a passive feature available to Ptaris in Honour mode which lets him pacify a foe that strikes him.
Desc 2: Once per round, after being hit, Ptaris can spend a Legendary Action to surround his attacker in  Ptarian Pacifism.

Name: Legendary Action: Sanctuary of Loss
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Sanctuary of Loss is a passive feature available to Viconia DeVir on Honour Mode.
Desc 2: Once per round, Viconia can use a Legendary Action to cast  Sanctuary of Loss when an ally is struck. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Sanguine Lash
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Sanguine Lash is a passive feature available to Orin, that lets her use Sanguine Lash after being attacked, or places Bhaal's Edict on a creature if she does not. Although the in-game text does not mention it, Orin will only activate this attack against foes who hit her with melee attacks.
Desc 2: Once per round, Orin can use her Legendary Action to  Sanguine Lash after being attacked. If Orin does not use her Legendary Action in a round and is not dueling her opponent alone,  Bhaal's Edict is placed on a creature. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Shredding Scales
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Shredding Scales is a passive feature available to the Bulette in Honour Mode.
Desc 2: Once per turn, the Bulette can spend a Legendary Action to use  Shredding Scales after being hit if its  Diamond Scales are active. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Soul Ascension
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Soul Ascension is a passive feature available to Raphael while he is in his  Fiendish Ascension form. It lets him expend a legendary action to use Soul Ascension, after he or his allies are attacked.
Desc 2: Raphael can spend a Legendary Action to immediately cast  Soul Ascension when he or his allies are attacked. Raphael may use this Legendary Action as many times per round as there are Soul Pillars standing at the start of the round. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Soul Sacrifice
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Soul Sacrifice is a passive feature available to Ch'r'ai Tska'an in Honour mode, which lets her use the legendary action  Sacrifice Soul immediately after a humanoid has died.
Desc 2: Once per round when a humanoid dies, the Ch'r'ai can spend a legendary action to  Sacrifice its soul to  Vlaakith in return for great power. Once 3 souls have been sacrificed, the Ch'r'ai takes on  Vlaakith's Undying Aspect. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Spectral Aspect
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Spectral Aspect is a passive feature that can grant a special spectral form after being struck.
Desc 2: Once per round, Balthazar can use his Legendary Action to adopt a  Spectral Aspect after being struck. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Sublimation
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Sublimation is a passive feature used by Gerringothe Thorm on Honour Mode. After losing a piece of armour, Gerringothe can use a Legendary action to try to  Sublimate a foe. A creature that fails its save against this effect cannot move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions.
Desc 2: Once per round, if she loses a piece of armour, Gerringothe Thorm can spend a Legendary Action to try and turn her enemies into gold, incapacitating them for 4 turns. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: The Dead Wastes
Desc 1: Legendary Action: The Dead Wastes is a passive feature used by Balthazar that lets him use  The Dead Wastes to create a rift that heals undead and damages living creatures.
Desc 2: Once per round when a creature dies, Balthazar can use his Legendary Action to create a necrotic miasma where it fell that heals Undead 4d6⁠hit points and deals 4d6⁠Necrotic to living creatures at the start of their turns. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Torrential Undeath
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Torrential Undeath is a passive feature available to Mystic Carrion in Honour Mode.
Desc 2: Once per turn, Mystic Carrion can use his Legendary Action to release  Torrential Undeath at his foes when hit. This grants Undead  Guardian Wraiths while haunting other creatures with  Wrathful Spirits. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Tu'narath's Embrace
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Tu'narath's Embrace is a passive feature used by Har'rak in Honour mode that lets him use  Tu'narath's Embrace on nearby allies when they are attacked with an incapacitating condition.
Desc 2: Once per round, Ch'r'ai Har'rak can spend a Legendary Action to cast  Tu'narath's Embrace on an ally to prevent an Incapacitating Condition. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Tyrannical Branding
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Tyrannical Branding is a passive feature available to Enver Gortash in Honour Mode that lets him use a Legendary action to retaliate against his attacker.
Desc 2: Once per round, Gortash can use his Legendary Action to immediately  Brand his attacker after being struck. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Vampiric Swarm
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Vampiric Swarm is a passive feature available to Cazador on Honour Mode.
Desc 2: Once per round, Cazador can spend a Legendary Action to conjure a  Vampiric Swarm. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Vengeful Playmate
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Vengeful Playmate is a passive feature available to Oliver in Honour Mode.
Desc 2: Once per round, Oliver can spend a Legendary Action to summon  The Wasting Quiet in an area after a summoned shadow is slain. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Wail of Loss
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Wail of Loss is a passive feature available to Malus Thorm in Honour Mode.
Desc 2: Once per round, Malus Thorm can use his Legendary Action after being attacked to make every assistant cast  Wail of Loss simultaneously. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Weird Magic Surge
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Weird Magic Surge is a passive feature available to Ethel in Honour mode, which lets her use the legendary action  Weird Magic Surge immediately after a spell is cast. A higher level spell will produce more illusory duplicates.
Desc 2: Once per round, Auntie Ethel can spend a Legendary Action to summon more illusory duplicates and shuffle herself among them after a spell is cast. A higher level spell will result in more illusory duplicates being summoned. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Action: Wretched Growth
Desc 1: Legendary Action: Wretched Growth is a unique passive feature available to the Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound.
Desc 2: If a creature ends its turn within  5 m / 17 ft of the Shambling Mound, it will take 3d10⁠Necrotic and Shadow-Cursed Vines will grow at its feet, possibly  Entangling it. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

Name: Legendary Mobility
Desc 1: Legendary Mobililty is a passive feature that increases the wearer's movement
Desc 2: You gain  Freedom of Movement and  Longstrider.

Name: Legendary Persistence
Desc 1: Legendary Persistence is a passive feature that grants permanent resistance to physical damage and a bonus to saving throws.
Desc 2: You gain  Resistance and  Blade Ward.

Name: Legion of Bees
Actions: Legion of Bees: Attack, Legion of Bees: Knockback, Legion of Bees: Teleport
Desc 1: Legion of Bees is passive feature available to Swarmkeepers. It turns the Gathered Swarm into bees that deal ⁠Piercing damage and can push enemies away. This feature can be switched out at level up.
Desc 2: You gain a swarm of bees that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional ⁠Piercing damage, push the enemy away from you, or teleport you to a safer location. At higher levels At level 11,  Mighty Swarm upgrades the swarm options to:

Name: Lesser Infernal Retribution
Desc 1: Lesser Infernal Retribution is a passive feature that retaliates against enemies with a bit of fire.
Desc 2: When you are hit by a foe within  2 m / 7 ft, it might take 1d4⁠Fire damage.

Name: Lesser Infernal Touch
Desc 1: Lesser Infernal Touch is a passive feature that deals extra fire damage if armed or extra necrotic damage if unarmed.
Desc 2: Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Fire damage. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Necrotic damage, and can possibly inflict  Bleeding.

Name: Let The Undead Blanch With Fear
Desc 1: Let The Undead Blanch With Fear! is a passive feature that makes it difficult for undead to hit you or apply special effects on you.
Desc 2: Undead have  Disadvantage on attack rolls against you, and you have  Advantage on  Saving throws against their actions and spells.

Name: Lethal Weapon (Bludgeoning)
Desc 1: Lethal Weapon is a passive feature that bypasses defenses against bludgeoning damage.
Desc 2: This weapon ignores resistance to ⁠Bludgeoning damage.

Name: Lethal Weapon (Piercing)
Desc 1: Lethal Weapon is a passive feature that bypasses defenses against piercing damage.
Desc 2: This weapon ignores Resistance to ⁠Piercing damage.

Name: Lethal Weapon (Slashing)
Desc 1: Lethal Weapon is a passive feature that bypasses defenses against slashing damage.
Desc 2: This weapon ignores Resistance to ⁠Slashing damage.

Name: Liberated Spellcasting
Desc 1: Liberated Spellcasting is a toggleable passive feature that lets you cast a spell without using up a slot, after killing a creature.
Desc 2: When you kill a creature, you can cast a Level 1 spell without expending a spell slot.

Name: Lickspittle's Alertness
Desc 1: Lickspittle's Alertness is a passive feature that increases the wearer's speed at the start of combat.
Desc 2: At the start of combat, the wearer gains  Momentum equal to their  Charisma Modifier.

Name: Life Essence Harvest
Desc 1: Life Essence Harvest is a passive feature that causes creatures killed by spells to give the wielder Spell Slots. They can only be used for Necromancy Spells.
Desc 2: When the wielder kills a hostile creature with a spell, they greedily absorb its energy and gain  Life Essence until their next Long Rest.

Name: Life of the Party
Desc 1: Life of the Party is a Way of the Drunken Master monk passive feature that grants bonuses against Drunk targets.
Desc 2: Every time  Intoxicating Strike hits, the monk gains  Life of the Party, which increases Armour Class and Attack Rolls against  Drunk targets.

Name: Life Stealing Critical
Desc 1: Life Stealing Critical is a passive feature that deals extra damage on a critical hit and also gives you temporary hp.
Desc 2: On a Critical Hit, the target takes an extra 10⁠NecroticDRS damage as long as it isn't a construct or an undead. You also gain  10 temporary hit points. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

Name: Lifecharger
Desc 1: Lifecharger is a passive feature that gives you a bit of extra durability.
Desc 2: When the wearer gains  Lightning Charges, they also gain 3 Temporary Hit Points. The temporary hit points disappear if the wearer runs out of Lightning Charges. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

Name: Lifedrinker
Desc 1: Lifedrinker is an Eldritch Invocation passive feature from the Warlock class. It grants the user's melee attacks additional ⁠Necrotic damage equal to their Charisma modifier.
Desc 2: Attacks made with your melee weapon deal additional necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

Name: Light Sensitivity
Desc 1: Light Sensitivity is a passive feature that causes penalties while in bright light.
Desc 2: While in bright light, this creature has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Perception Checks that rely on sight.

Name: Lightly Armoured
Desc 1: Lightly Armoured is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. You gain Light Armour Proficiency if you didn't have it already, and +1 to Strength or Dexterity.
Desc 2: You gain Armour Proficiency with Light Armour and your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Name: Living Shadow
Desc 1: Living Shadow is a passive feature which gives a creature damage resistance while obscured.
Desc 2: While Lightly or Heavily Obscured, this character has Resistance to all damage except ⁠Force,  ⁠Psychic or ⁠Radiant.

Name: Loving Protection
Desc 1: Loving Protection is a passive feature that heals you a bit when your hit points get low.
Desc 2: Once per Short Rest, if you are below 50% Hit Points and take damage, you gain  8 temporary hit points. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

Name: Luck of the Far Realms
Desc 1: Luck of the Far Realms is a passive feature/reaction and Illithid Power. This feature allows a character to change a successful Attack Roll into a Critical Hit once per long rest.
Desc 2: Once per Long Rest, you can change a successful Attack Roll against a foe into a Critical Hit.

Name: Lucky
Actions: Lucky: Reroll with Advantage, Lucky: Reroll Attacker's Die
Desc 1: Lucky is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants the user 3 Luck Points, which can be can be used to manipulate either their rolls, or an enemy's rolls.
Desc 2: You gain 3  Luck Points, which you can use to gain  Advantage on Attack rolls,  Ability checks, or  Saving throws, or to make an enemy reroll their Attack rolls.

Name: Lunar Bestial Fortitude
Desc 1: Lunar Bestial Fortitude is a passive feature granted by  Armour of Moonbasking.
Desc 2: You have a +2 bonus to  Armour Class. You also have  Advantage on  Saving throws against spells. This effect persists while using your druidic  Wild Shape ability.

Name: Lunar Bestial Vitality
Desc 1: Lunar Bestial Vitality is a passive feature that boosts a druid's wildshape.
Desc 2: You gain  22 temporary hit points after casting  Wild Shape. While those temporary hit points are active reduce all incoming damage by 1. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

Name: Mage Breaker
Desc 1: Mage Breaker is a Ranger passive effect of Favoured Enemy. You gain proficiency in Arcana and gain the  True Strike cantrip.
Desc 2: You have a history of battling spellcasters. You gain Proficiency in Arcana and can cast  True Strike.

Name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
Desc 1: Mage Hand Legerdemain is an Arcane Trickster Rogue passive feature. This ability enhances your  Mage Hand, allowing it to remain permanently and granting it invisibility.
Desc 2: When you cast Mage Hand, the spectral hand is invisible and permanent.

Name: Mage Slayer: Attack Caster
Desc 1: Mage Slayer: Attack Caster is a passive feature provided by the Mage Slayer Feat. When a creature casts a spell near you, you can attack the caster as a Reaction.
Desc 2: When a creature casts a spell within melee range of you, you can use a  Reaction to immediately make an attack against the caster.

Name: Mage Slayer: Break Concentration
Desc 1: Mage Slayer: Break Concentration is a Passive Feature provided by the Mage Slayer Feat. When you attack a creature, they have Disadvantage on any Concentration Saving Throws they make that turn.
Desc 2: Enemies you hit have  Disadvantage on Concentration Saving Throws.

Name: Mage Slayer: Saving Throw Advantage
Desc 1: Mage Slayer: Saving Throw Advantage is a passive feature provided by the Mage Slayer Feat. When a creature casts a spell near you, you have  Advantage on any Saving Throws against it.
Desc 2: When a creature casts a spell within melee range of you, you have  Advantage on any Saving Throws against it.

Name: Magic Arrow
Desc 1: Magic Arrow is an Arcane Archer fighter passive feature that makes their arrows considered magical.
Desc 2: All of your ranged attacks are considered magical to overcome Resistance.

Name: Magic Club
Desc 1: Magic Club is a passive feature applied to Twisting Branches clubs carried by Wood Woads. It causes the clubs to become magical weapons and deal extra damage.
Desc 2: In the Wood Woad's hand, a common club becomes magical and deals 3d4⁠Bludgeoning damage extra.

Name: Magic Initiate: Bard
Desc 1: Magic Initiate: Bard is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants you spells and cantrips from that particular class.
Desc 2: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Bard spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Modifier for all 3 spells is  Charisma.

Name: Magic Initiate: Cleric
Desc 1: Magic Initiate: Cleric is a Passive Feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants you spells and cantrips from that particular class.
Desc 2: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Cleric spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Modifier for all 3 spells is  Wisdom.

Name: Magic Initiate: Druid
Desc 1: Magic Initiate: Druid is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants you spells and cantrips from that particular class.
Desc 2: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Druid spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Modifier for all 3 spells is  Wisdom.

Name: Magic Initiate: Sorcerer
Desc 1: Magic Initiate: Sorcerer is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants you spells and cantrips from that particular class.
Desc 2: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Sorcerer spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Modifier for all 3 spells is  Charisma.

Name: Magic Initiate: Warlock
Desc 1: Magic Initiate: Warlock is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants you spells and cantrips from that particular class.
Desc 2: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Warlock spell list. These spells cannot be upcast. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Modifier for all 3 spells is  Charisma.

Name: Magic Initiate: Wizard
Desc 1: Magic Initiate: Wizard is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants you spells and cantrips from that particular class.
Desc 2: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Wizard spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Modifier for all 3 spells is  Intelligence.

Name: Magic Resistance
Desc 1: Magic Resistance is a passive feature that grants a creature advantage on saving throws against magical effects.
Desc 2: Has  Advantage on Saving Throws against Spells and other magical effects.

Name: Magical Ambush
Desc 1: Magical Ambush is a togglable passive gained by Arcane Tricksters at Level 9. Magical Ambush allows the Rogue to circumvent their target's defenses when casting spells while hidden.
Desc 2: While you are  Hiding, your targets have  Disadvantage on  Saving throws against your Spells.

Name: Magical Durability (+1)
Desc 1: Magical Durability is a passive feature that increases the user's defenses against spells.
Desc 2: The wielder has a +1 bonus to  Saving throws against spells.

Name: Magical Durability (Sword of the Emperor)
Desc 1: Magical Durability is a passive feature that increases the user's defenses against spells.
Desc 2: The wielder has a +2 bonus to  Saving throws against spells.

Name: Magical Durability (Flawed Helldusk Helmet)
Desc 1: Magical Durability is a passive feature that increases the user's defenses against spells.
Desc 2: The wielder has a +2 bonus to  Saving throws against spells.

Name: Magical Durability (Helldusk Helmet)
Desc 1: Magical Durability is a passive feature that increases the user's defenses against spells.
Desc 2: The wielder has a +2 bonus to  Saving throws against spells.

Name: Magical Plate (-1)
Desc 1: Magical Plate is a passive feature that reduces incoming damage by 1.
Desc 2: All incoming damage is reduced by 1

Name: Magical Plate (-2)
Desc 1: Magical Plate is a passive feature that reduces incoming damage by 2.
Desc 2: All incoming damage is reduced by 2.

Name: Malefic Excretion
Desc 1: Malefic Excretion is a passive feature that adds acid damage to the wearer's weapon attacks.
Desc 2: Your weapon attacks also deal 2⁠Acid damage.

Name: Malefic Funghi
Desc 1: Malefic Funghi is a passive feature that boosts a druid's spells and damage.
Desc 2: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and when dealing ⁠Necrotic damage, they deal an additional 1⁠Necrotic Damage.

Name: Man's Best Friend
Desc 1: Man's Best Friend is a passive feature which boosts the offence and defence of a hunting dog, according to the proficiency bonus of their master.
Desc 2: This hunting dog's Armour Class and damage increase by an amount equal to the Proficiency Bonus of its houndmaster.

Name: Manifestation of Body
Desc 1: Manifestation of Body is a togglable passive feature unique to Way of the Open Hand Monks at Level 6, that adds extra ⁠Necrotic damage based on your Wisdom Modifier to unarmed attacks.
Desc 2: Your hands sap the ki from your enemies' bodies. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 + Wisdom Modifier⁠Necrotic damage. Can't be used at the same time as  Manifestation of Mind or  Manifestation of Soul.

Name: Manifestation of Mind
Desc 1: Manifestation of Mind is a togglable passive feature unique to Way of the Open Hand Monks at Level 6, that adds extra ⁠Psychic damage based on your Wisdom Modifier to unarmed attacks.
Desc 2: Your hands sap the ki from your enemies' bodies. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 + Wisdom Modifier⁠Psychic damage. Can't be used at the same time as  Manifestation of Body or  Manifestation of Soul.

Name: Manifestation of Soul
Desc 1: Manifestation of Soul is a togglable passive feature unique to Way of the Open Hand Monks at Level 6, that adds extra ⁠Radiant damage based on your Wisdom Modifier to unarmed attacks.
Desc 2: Your hands sap the ki from your enemies' bodies. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 + Wisdom Modifier⁠Radiant damage. Can't be used at the same time as  Manifestation of Body or  Manifestation of Mind.

Name: Marksmanship
Desc 1: Marksmanship is a passive feature that increases the hit chance of ranged attacks.
Desc 2: You gain a +1 bonus to Ranged Attack rolls and Thrown Attack Rolls.

Name: Martial Adept
Desc 1: Martial Adept is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. You learn two manoeuvres and gain a Superiority Die to use them.
Desc 2: Learn two manoeuvres from the Battle Master Fighter subclass and receive 1 (additional)  Superiority Die to fuel them. You regain expended Superiority Dice after a Short or Long Rest.

Name: Martial Advantage
Desc 1: Martial Advantage is a passive feature available to Hobgoblins.
Desc 2: Once per turn, the Hobgoblin can deal an extra 2d6⁠Physical damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack. The hobgoblin must have an ally who is within 2 m / 7 ft of the target and isn't  Incapacitated.

Name: Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike
Desc 1: Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike is a Monk passive feature that grants a single follow-up  Unarmed Strike (Monk) using a  Bonus Action. The initial attack must be unarmed or use a Monk Weapon.
Desc 2: After making an attack with a Monk weapon or while unarmed, you can make another unarmed attack as a bonus action.

Name: Martial Arts: Deft Strikes
Desc 1: Martial Arts: Deft Strikes is a Monk passive feature that raises the minimum damage dealt with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks to 1d4⁠Bludgeoning.
Desc 2: Attacks with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks deal 1d4⁠Bludgeoning damage, unless their normal damage is higher. At Monk Level 3, the damage increases to 1d6⁠ Bludgeoning. At Monk Level 9, the damage increases to 1d8⁠ Bludgeoning.

Name: Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks
Desc 1: Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks is a Monk passive which makes attacks with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks scale with Dexterity instead of Strength, if the user's  Dexterity is higher.
Desc 2: Attacks with Monk weapons and unarmed attacks scale with your Dexterity instead of your Strength if your Dexterity is higher.

Name: Martial Bravery
Desc 1: Martial Bravery is a passive feature that grants the wearer increased damage when surrounded by 2 or more enemies.
Desc 2: Your weapon and unarmed attacks deal an additional 2 damage while surrounded by 2 or more foes.

Name: Martial Prodigy
Desc 1: Martial Prodigy is a passive feature that grants Githyanki Proficiency with the Light Armour, Medium Armour, Shortswords, Longswords, and Greatswords.
Desc 2: A lifetime of relentless training gave you Armour proficiency with  Light armour and  Medium armour, as well as Proficiency with  Shortswords,  Longswords, and  Greatswords.

Name: Mask of Many Faces
Desc 1: Mask of Many Faces is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows the wearer to repeatedly disguise themselves at will.
Desc 2: You can cast  Disguise Self on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot.

Name: Medium Armour Master
Desc 1: Medium Armour Master is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. Your mastery over Medium Armour increases, granting you increased  Armour Class and the ability to Stealth without  Disadvantage from the Medium Armour.
Desc 2: When you wear medium armour, it doesn't impose  Disadvantage on Stealth checks. The bonus to  Armour Class you can gain from your Dexterity modifier also becomes +3 instead of +2. You must have Proficiency in Medium Armour to take this feat

Name: Melee Caster
Desc 1: Melee Caster is a passive feature that allows a magic user to use its casting ability to attack targets more accurately.
Desc 2: Instead of its Dexterity Modifier, the affected entity add its Spellcasting Ability Modifier to Attack rolls.

Name: Mental Inhibition
Desc 1: Mental Inhibition is a passive feature that tires out the wearer's target's mind.
Desc 2: When a foe fails a  Saving throw against one of your spells or actions, they gain  Mental Fatigue for 2 turns.

Name: Mental Interference
Desc 1: Mental Interference is a passive feature that tires out the user's targets when dealing psychic damage to them.
Desc 2: When you deal ⁠Psychic damage, you also inflict  Mental Fatigue for 2 turns.

Name: Merry Revelry
Desc 1: Merry Revelry is a passive feature available to Ethel's Redcap servants, that reduces the effect of their  Bloodlust when attacking characters with  Alcohol in their blood.
Desc 2: This Redcap's Bloodlust is subdued when there are traces of alcohol in a target's blood, which means they will primarily target creatures who are sober.

Name: Metamagic: Careful Spell
Desc 1: Metamagic: Careful Spell is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This Metamagic ability allows Sorcerers to prevent harmful Spell effects affecting their allies.
Desc 2: Allies automatically succeed Saving Throws against spells that required them.

Name: Metamagic: Distant Spell
Desc 1: Metamagic: Distant Spell is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This Metamagic ability allows Sorcerers to increase the range of their Spells.
Desc 2: Increases the range of the spell by 50%. Melee spells are increased to  Range: 9 m / 30 ft.

Name: Metamagic: Extended Spell
Desc 1: Metamagic: Extended Spell  is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This Metamagic ability allows Sorcerers to extend the duration of magical effects caused by their Spells.
Desc 2: Double the duration of conditions, summons, and surfaces caused by spells.

Name: Metamagic: Heightened Spell
Desc 1: Metamagic: Heightened Spell is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This Metamagic ability allows Sorcerers to empower the magical effects of their Spells, making it harder for targeted creatures to resist the spell.
Desc 2: Targets of spells that require Saving Throws have  Disadvantage on their first Saving Throw.

Name: Metamagic: Quickened Spell
Desc 1: Metamagic: Quickened Spell is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This Metamagic ability allows Sorcerers to cast multiple Spells in a turn.
Desc 2: Spells that take an  Action take a  Bonus Action instead.

Name: Metamagic: Subtle Spell
Desc 1: Metamagic: Subtle Spell is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This Metamagic ability allows Sorcerers to cast Spells without chanting or hand movements and allows them to ignore the  Silenced condition. However, spells cast with Subtle Spell can still be countered by enemy casters using Counterspell.
Desc 2: You can cast spells while  Silenced.

Name: Metamagic: Twinned Spell
Desc 1: Metamagic: Twinned Spell is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This ability allows Sorcerers to target two creatures with certain Spells.
Desc 2: Spells that only target 1 creature can target an additional creature. Costs 1  Sorcery Point per Spell Slot level used. Cantrips also cost 1  Sorcery Point. For spells that don't shoot a projectile, the targets need to be close enough together.

Name: Mighty Swarm
Desc 1: Mighty Swarm is a Swarmkeeper ranger passive feature that increases the power of their swarm.
Desc 2: Your swarm has grown stronger. The swarm's regular attack now deals 1d8 damage, its special attack has one additional feature, and teleporting with your swarm now also increases your  Armour Class for the rest of the round.

Name: Mindless Rage
Desc 1: Mindless Rage is a Berserker Barbarian passive feature. While raging, these barbarians cannot be Charmed or Frightened.
Desc 2: Your rage becomes all-consuming, repelling outside influence. While  Frenzied, you can't be  Charmed or  Frightened, and  Calm Emotions no longer ends your rage.

Name: Mindreader
Desc 1: Mindreader is a passive feature that gives Ranged Attacks against the creature  Disadvantage.
Desc 2: Ranged attacks have  Disadvantage against this creature.

Name: Minions of Chaos
Desc 1: Minions of Chaos is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You learn how to cast Conjure Elemental.
Desc 2: You can cast  Conjure Elemental with a Warlock spell slot.

Name: Mire the Mind
Desc 1: Mire the Mind is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You learn how to cast Slow on enemies.
Desc 2: You can cast  Slow with a Warlock spell slot.

Name: Misty Presence
Desc 1: Misty Presence is a passive feature that protects the user by turning invisible.
Desc 2: After taking damage this character may turn  Invisible.

Name: Mobile
Desc 1: Mobile is a passive feature given by the feat of the same name, which grants an additional 3m of Movement Speed.
Desc 2: Your movement speed increases by 3m.

Name: Mobile: Evade Difficult Terrain
Desc 1: Mobile: Evade Difficult Terrain is a passive feature that allows a character to ignore Difficult Terrain after Dashing.
Desc 2: When you Dash,  Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down.

Name: Mobile: Evade Opportunity Attack
Desc 1: Mobile: Evade Opportunity Attack is a passive feature that lets a creature move away from a target without provoking Opportunity Attacks, after they have made a melee attack.
Desc 2: If you move after making a melee attack, you don't provoke Opportunity Attacks from your target. The effect still works if your attack misses.

Name: Moderately Armoured
Desc 1: Moderately Armoured is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. You gain Proficiency with Medium Armour and your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1.
Desc 2: You gain Proficiency with Medium Armour and Shields, and your  Strength or  Dexterity increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. You must have Light Armour Proficiency before you can take this feat.

Name: Monsterslayer
Desc 1: Monsterslayer is a passive feature that increases attack rolls and your weapon's damage against monsters.
Desc 2: This weapon deals an additional   1d4 damage against Monstrosity type foes.

Name: Moonlight Glaive: Glowing
Desc 1: Moonlight Glaive: Glowing is a toggleable passive feature that causes this object to glow.
Desc 2: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of  6 m / 20 ft. Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

Name: Morphic Ambush
Desc 1: Morphic Ambush is a passive feature available to Dolor, which gives him automatic critical hits against  Ambushed enemies.
Desc 2: Any successful Attack Roll against a creature that has been Ambushed by a Doppelganger is a Critical Hit.

Name: Morphic Evasion
Desc 1: Morphic Evasion is a passive feature that significantly prevents attacks and damage from ambushes.
Desc 2: Whenever you fail a  Saving throw against an attack from a non-hostile creature, you may succeed instead. If any damage is inflicted from succeeding a Dexterity  Saving throw, the damage is nullified.

Name: Mortal Reminder
Desc 1: Mortal Reminder is a passive feature unique to The Great Old One Warlock subclass that Frightens creatures upon a critical hit.
Desc 2: When you land a Critical Hit against a creature, that creature and any nearby enemies must succeed a  Wisdom saving throw or become  Frightened until the end of their next turn.

Name: Mountain I
Desc 1: Mountain is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Mirror Image and  Spike Growth. At higher levels You can cast  Lightning Bolt and  Grant Flight. You can cast  Stoneskin and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Wall of Stone and  Conjure Elemental.

Name: Mountain II
Desc 1: Mountain is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Mirror Image and  Spike Growth. At higher levels You can cast  Lightning Bolt and  Grant Flight. You can cast  Stoneskin and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Wall of Stone and  Conjure Elemental.

Name: Mountain III
Desc 1: Mountain is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Mirror Image and  Spike Growth. At higher levels You can cast  Lightning Bolt and  Grant Flight. You can cast  Stoneskin and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Wall of Stone and  Conjure Elemental.

Name: Mountain IV
Desc 1: Mountain is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Mirror Image and  Spike Growth. At higher levels You can cast  Lightning Bolt and  Grant Flight. You can cast  Stoneskin and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Wall of Stone and  Conjure Elemental.

Name: Mountainous Poise
Desc 1: Mountainous Poise is a passive feature that increases a monk's defenses
Desc 2: While using  Patient Defence, you also benefit from the effect of  Blade Ward.

Name: Multiattack (Cloaker)
Desc 1: Multiattack is a passive feature of the Cloaker that lets them attack multiple times if the target is Frightened.
Desc 2: Can  Multiattack if the target is  Frightened.

Name: Multiattack (Giant Eagle)
Desc 1: Multiattack is a passive feature of the Giant Eagle's that lets them attack a target multiple times if it is Prone or Restrained.
Desc 2: The giant eagle can  Multiattack if its target is  Prone or  Restrained.

Name: Multiattack Defence
Desc 1: Multiattack Defence is a Hunter Ranger passive feature which strengthens its user's defenses against enemies that attack them more than once per turn.
Desc 2: When a enemy attacks you, they suffer -4 penalty to additional Attack Rolls against you until the start of their next turn.

Name: Multiattack: Bloodlust
Desc 1: Multiattack: Bloodlust is a passive feature of Redcap's that lets them attack multiple times with one  Action if affected by the Bloodlust condition.
Desc 2: The redcap can make a  Multiattack while under the effects of  Bloodlust.

Name: Multiattack: Enraged
Desc 1: Multiattack: Enraged is a passive feature of Owlbears that lets them attack multiple times while raging.
Desc 2: The owlbear can make a  Multiattack while under the effects of  Owlbear's Rage

Name: Multiattack: Enwebbed
Desc 1: Multiattack: Enwebbed is a passive feature that lets creatures Multiattack an  Enwebbed enemy.
Desc 2: The ettercap can make a  Multiattack if the target is  Enwebbed.

Name: Multiattack: Frightened
Desc 1: Multiattack: Frightened is a passive feature that lets them attack a Frightened enemy.
Desc 2: The Mummy can  Multiattack if the target is  Frightened.

Name: Multiattack: Last Resort
Desc 1: Multiattack: Last Resort is a passive feature available to Raphael while he is  ascended.
Desc 2: Raphael can Multiattack in his Ascended Fiend form if all of his Soul Pillars have been destroyed and he has no Soul Charges.

Name: Multiattack: Lured
Desc 1: Multiattack: Lured is a passive feature of the Harpy that lets them attack multiple times with one  Action if their targets are  Lured.
Desc 2: The harpy can make a  Multiattack if the target is  Lured.

Name: Multiattack: Morphic Ambush
Desc 1: Multiattack: Morphic Ambush is a passive feature of Doppelgangers that lets them attack multiple times with one  Action if a target is Ambushed.
Desc 2: Can  Multiattack if the target is  Ambushed.

Name: Multiattack: Muddy
Desc 1: Multiattack: Muddy is a passive feature that allows an Earth Elemental to attack more than once when using their attack action against a muddy enemy.
Desc 2: Can  Multiattack if the target is  Muddy or is standing in Mud.

Name: Multiattack: Prone (Glut)
Desc 1: Multiattack: Prone is a passive feature that allows a creature to attack more than once when attacking an enemy that is Prone.
Desc 2: Sovereign Glut can use  Multiattack against a target that's  Prone.

Name: Multiattack: Prone (Hook Horror)
Desc 1: Multiattack: Prone is a passive feature that allows a Hook Horror to make two attacks against a prone target with a single action.
Desc 2: The hook horror can make a  Multiattack if the target is  Prone.

Name: Multiattack: Prone Restrained or Maimed
Desc 1: Multiattack: Prone, Restrained, or Maimed is a passive feature of the Steel Watcher Titan that lets them attack a target multiple times if they have the Prone, Restrained, or Maimed conditions.
Desc 2: This Steel Watcher can  Multiattack any  Prone,  Maimed, or  Restrained creature.

Name: Multiattack: Spores
Desc 1: Multiattack: Spores is a passive feature that allows a Sovereign Spaw to attack more than once when attacking an enemy that is Prone.
Desc 2: The sovereign myconid can use  Multiattack against a target that's  Befuddled or under the influence of either  Noxious Fumes or  Haste Spores.

Name: Multiattack: Static Discharge
Desc 1: Multiattack: Static Discharge is a passive feature that lets creatures Multiattack a creature that's under a  Static Discharge Aura.
Desc 2: Benard can  Multiattack while under the effects of his  Static Discharge Aura.

Name: Multiattack: Wounded (Malus Thorm)
Desc 1: Multiattack: Wounded is a passive feature of Malus Thorm that lets him attack twice with a single  Action once he drops to 40% hit points or below.
Desc 2: Malus Thorm can  Multiattack if his hit points are at 40% or less.[Needs Verification]

Name: Multiattack: Wounded (Werewolf)
Desc 1: Multiattack: Wounded is a passive feature of a Werewolf that lets them attack multiple times if its target is Prone or hit points are less than 60%.
Desc 2: Can  Multiattack if the target is  Prone or if its hit points are at 60% or less.

Name: Multiattack: Wounded Target
Desc 1: Multiattack: Wounded Target is a passive feature that allows a Drider to attack more than once when using their attack action against a wounded enemy.
Desc 2: The drider can  Multiattack if its target has fewer than all of its hit points.

Name: Multitasking
Desc 1: Multitasking is a passive feature that improves the wearer's ability to hold onto concentrating on a spell.
Desc 2: You gain  Advantage on  Concentration  Saving throws.

Name: Murder Hungry
Desc 1: Murder Hungry is a passive feature related to the condition  Unstoppable. Each time a creature with this feature kills another creature, they gain another charge of Unstoppable.
Desc 2: Each time you kill a creature, gain 1 charge of Unstoppable.

Name: Murderous Sight
Desc 1: Murderous Sight is a passive feature that lets the wearer see in the dark and move earlier during combat.
Desc 2: You can see in the dark up to  3 m / 10 ft. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus to  Initiative.

Name: Muscular
Desc 1: Muscular is a passive feature that grants Advantage when using Athletics.
Desc 2: This creature is very strong. It has  Advantage on Ability Checks and Saving Throws using Athletics.

Name: Mystra's Blessing
Desc 1: Mystra's Blessing is a passive feature which boosts the wielder's  Bless spell.
Desc 2: Creatures you  Bless also gain Mystra's Blessing for an additional 1d4 bonus to spell attack rolls.

Name: Natural Pugilist
Desc 1: Natural Pugilist is a passive feature that increases the user's Unarmed Attack Rolls and damage.
Desc 2: You gain a +1 bonus to Unarmed Attack rolls and damage.

Name: Naturally Stealthy
Desc 1: Naturally Stealthy is a passive feature available to all Lightfoot Halflings.
Desc 2: Your nimble nature makes you skilled at concealment. You have  Advantage on  Stealth Checks.

Name: Nature's Embrace
Desc 1: Nature's Embrace is a passive feature that increase's a druid's ability to wild shape.
Desc 2: Increase your  Wild Shape Charge by 1. This additional charge is restored upon taking a Long Rest.

Name: Nature's Step
Desc 1: Nature's Step is a Dryad toggleable passive feature. You and your allies near the Dryad are protected from Difficult Terrain and Poison, and can't be Restrained or Paralysed.
Desc 2: Alter the terrain around you, allowing nearby allies in the area to travel with ease. You and your allies within 4 m / 13 ft of range aren't affected by  Difficult Terrain, can't be  Restrained or  Paralysed, and gain Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.

Name: Nature's Vengeance
Desc 1: Nature's Vengeance is a passive feature that inflicts extra conditions based on the type of surface the wearer is standing on.
Desc 2: When the wearer stands in certain surfaces and casts a spell that deals damage, the target also suffers the surface's effects. Affected surfaces are  Fire,  Acid,  Caustic Brine, and  Simple Toxin.

Name: Nature's Ward
Desc 1: Nature's Ward is a Circle of the Land Druid passive feature that grants immunity to Charm and Frighten effects from elementals and fey creatures. The Druid also becomes immune to Disease and Poison.
Desc 2: You can't be  Charmed or  Frightened by elementals and fey. Disease and poison also no longer affect you.

Name: Necrotic Claws
Desc 1: Necrotic Claws is a passive feature available to Crawling Claws. It allows their attacks to deal an additional 1d6⁠Necrotic damage.
Desc 2: Your attacks deal an extra 1d6⁠Necrotic damage.

Name: Needle Burst
Desc 1: Needle Burst is a Passive Feature that makes a creature explode on death.
Desc 2: Explode in a  Needle Burst upon dying.

Name: Night Walker
Desc 1: Night Walker is a passive feature that allows the user freedom of movement without any common restrictions.
Desc 2: The affected creature cannot be  Enwebbed,  Entangled, or  Ensnared and cannot slip on  Grease or  Ice.

Name: Nightsinger's Reply
Desc 1: Nightsinger's Reply is a passive feature that retaliates against enemies that hit the user with a melee attack.
Desc 2: While Obscured by shadow, the wearer deals 1d4⁠Necrotic to attackers that hit them with a melee attack.

Name: Nimble Alchemist
Desc 1: Nimble Alchemist is a passive feature only found on Dolor
Desc 2: A potions master, Dolor can throw or drink potions as a free action.

Name: Nimble As a Cat
Desc 1: Nimble as a Cat is a passive feature that enhances your dexteriy as well as your jump distance.
Desc 2: You gain a +1 bonus to your Dexterity  Saving throws and also increase your  Jump distance by  1.5 m / 5 ft.

Name: Nimble Attack
Desc 1: Nimble Attack is a passive feature that increases the movement speed of the user after hitting a target.
Desc 2: When the wielder hits an enemy with this weapon, they gain  Momentum for 2 turns.

Name: Nimblefinger
Desc 1: Nimblefinger is a passive feature that grants bonuses to small size races.
Desc 2: Gnomes are granted +2 to Dexterity. Halflings and Dwarves gain +1 Dexterity.

Name: Nyrulna: Glowing
Desc 1: Nyrulna: Glowing is a toggleable passive feature that controls whether or not this weapon glows with light.
Desc 2: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of  6 m / 20 ft. Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

Name: Oath of Devotion Tenets
Desc 1: Oath of Devotion Tenets is a passive feature that describes the tenets that Oath of Devotion paladins must adhere to.
Desc 2: Oath of Devotion paladins abide by the following tenets: Compassion. Show clemency when prudent, and lend your arm to those in need. Failure to abide by their tenets will result in a paladin forsaking their Oath, and becoming something very different.

Name: Oath of the Ancients Tenets
Desc 1: Oath of the Ancients Tenets is a passive feature that describes the tenets that Oath of the Ancients paladins must adhere to.
Desc 2: Oath of the Ancients paladins abide by the following tenets: Shelter the Light. Where there is good, beauty, love, and laughter in the world, stand against the wickedness that would swallow it. Where life flourishes, stand against the forces that would render it barren. Preserve Your Own Light. Delight in song and laughter, in beauty and art. If you allow the light to die in your own heart, you can’t preserve it in the world.  Failure to abide by their tenets will result in a paladin forsaking their Oath, and becoming something very different.

Name: Oath of the Crown Tenets
Desc 1: Oath of the Crown Tenets is a passive feature that describes the tenets that Oath of the Crown paladins must adhere to.
Desc 2: Oath of the Crown paladins abide by the following tenets: Loyalty. Your word is your bond; without loyalty, oaths and laws are meaningless. Failure to abide by their tenets will result in a paladin forsaking their Oath, and becoming something very different.

Name: Oath of Vengeance Tenets
Desc 1: Oath of Vengeance Tenets is a passive feature that describes the tenets that Oath of Vengeance paladins must adhere to.
Desc 2: Oath of Vengeance paladins abide by the following tenets: Fight the Greater Evil. Exerting your wisdom, identify the higher morality in any given instance, and fight for it. No Mercy for the Wicked. Chasten those who dole out their villainy by wiping their blight from the world forever. Failure to abide by their tenets will result in a paladin forsaking their Oath, and becoming something very different.

Name: Odd Gift
Desc 1: Odd Gift is a passive feature that prevents Jaheira from being cursed.
Desc 2: While wearing Khalid's Gift, Jaheira cannot be Cursed.

Name: Ogre's Mark
Desc 1: Ogre's Mark is a passive feature available to Ogres that grants an additional 1d6⁠Bludgeoning damage.
Desc 2: Damage is increased by 1d6.

Name: One with Shadows
Desc 1: One with Shadows is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows you to vanish into the darkness and become  Invisible.
Desc 2: You learn how to cast  One with Shadows.

Name: Opportune Predator
Desc 1: Opportune Predator is a passive feature that allows a displacer beast illusion to pre-emptively attack enemies that move near them.
Desc 2: When an entity enters your attack range, you can strike them.

Name: Opportunity Attack
Desc 1: Opportunity Attack or Attack of Opportunity is a common Passive feature /  Reaction. This ability allows a creature to make a melee Attack roll against enemies when they move out of the creature's melee range.
Desc 2: Automatically attack an enemy moving out of your reach.

Name: Order of Nature
Desc 1: Order of Nature is a passive feature that retaliates against undead and beast creatures that hit the wearer.
Desc 2: Undead creatures that hit the wearer receive 1d6⁠Radiant. Beasts that hit the wearer deal an additional 1d6⁠Radiant.

Name: Organ Rearranger
Desc 1: Organ Rearranger is a passive feature that makes its wielder more deadly.
Desc 2: Reduce the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking by 1. This effect can stack. When you roll 2 damage or less, reroll the dice, taking the highest result.

Name: Otherworldly Leap
Desc 1: Otherworldly Leap is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows a character to cast the Enhance Leap spell without expending a warlock spell slot. [note 1]
Desc 2: You can cast the  Enhance Leap spell without expending a spell slot.

Name: Overcharge
Desc 1: Overcharge is a passive feature that is intended to be used by a construct.
Desc 2: Chance to  Stun the wielder, unless it is a Construct.

Name: Pack Tactics
Desc 1: Pack Tactics is a passive feature that grants Advantage to attacks when an ally is close to the target.
Desc 2: When an ally is within 3 m / 10 ft of your target and is not  Incapacitated, your Attack rolls against the target have  Advantage.

Name: Pact Boon
Desc 1: Pact Boon is a passive feature that grants you abilities depending on your choice of Boon.
Desc 2: Your otherworldly patron bestows a gift upon you for your loyal service. You gain one of the following features of your choice: Gain the service of a familiar, a fey spirit that takes a form you choose. This can be an animal, imp, or quasit. You can Summon a pact weapon, or Bind the one you are wielding, making it magical. Pact weapons use the wielder's Spellcasting Ability Modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity. Your patron grants you a grimoire called 'The Book of Shadows', which allows you to cast several spells.

Name: Pact of the Blade
Actions: Pact of the Blade, Bind Pact Weapon
Desc 1: Pact of the Blade is a Pact Boon granted by the Warlock class. It allows a Warlock to specialise in melee combat by using a special Pact Weapon, granting two actions for this purpose.
Desc 2: You can  Summon a pact weapon, or  Bind the one you are wielding as one, making it magical. Pact weapons use the wielder's Charisma modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity. At higher levels At level 5, Warlocks gain  Deepened Pact which grants an  Extra Attack with your pact weapon.

Name: Pact of the Chain
Spells: Find Familiar, Find Familiar: Imp, Find Familiar: Quasit
Desc 1: Pact of the Chain is a Pact Boon from the Warlock class.
Desc 2: Gain the service of a familiar, a fey spirit that takes a form of your choosing. This can be an animal, imp, or quasit. At higher levels At level 5, Warlocks gain  Deepened Pact which grants an  Extra Attack to your familiars.

Name: Pact of the Tome
Desc 1: Pact of the Tome is a Pact Boon from the Warlock class. You receive a book that allows you to cast several spells.
Desc 2: Your patron grants you a grimoire called The Book of Shadows"

Name: Paragon of Charisma
Desc 1: Paragon of Charisma is a passive feature unique to the Charismatic Sentinel which gives them boosts to their Charisma Saving Throws and Spell Attack Rolls.
Desc 2: This Dark Justiciar was anointed by Shar as a sentinel of Charisma, representing one of her most valued attributes in a follower. They have  Advantage on all  Charisma saving throws and Spell Attack rolls.

Name: Paragon of Intelligence
Desc 1: Paragon of Intelligence is a passive feature unique to the Intelligent Sentinel which gives them boosts to their Intelligence Saving Throws and Spell Attack Rolls.
Desc 2: This Dark Justiciar was anointed by Shar as a sentinel of Intelligence, representing one of her most valued attributes in a follower. They have  Advantage on all  Intelligence saving throws and Spell Attack rolls.

Name: Paragon of Wisdom
Desc 1: Paragon of Wisdom is a passive feature unique to the Wise Sentinel which gives them boosts to their Wisdom Saving Throws and Spell Attack Rolls.
Desc 2: This Dark Justiciar was anointed by Shar as a sentinel of Wisdom, representing one of her most valued attributes in a follower. They have  Advantage on all  Wisdom saving throws and Spell Attack rolls.

Name: Paralysing Critical
Desc 2: Properties Technical details

Name: Parry
Desc 1: Parry is a toggleable passive feature that lets you automatically reduce the damage of the next melee attack.
Desc 2: Parry the next melee attack that hits you by 1d8+Dexterity Modifier.

Name: Part of the Flock
Desc 1: Part of the Flock is a passive feature granted while wearing a Whispering Mask that can turn the wearer into Auntie Ethel's Pawn.
Desc 2: Auntie Ethel welcomes you, dearie.

Name: Partial Ceremorphosis
Desc 1: Partial Ceremorphosis is a special passive feature gained after consuming the  Astral-Touched Tadpole.
Desc 2: You are in the early stages of transformation - gaining access to more aberrant powers as you evolve your illithid potential.

Name: Perfect Sentry
Desc 1: Perfect Sentry is a passive feature that makes it impossible to be surprised.
Desc 2: You can't be  Surprised.

Name: Performer
Desc 1: Performer is a passive feature that grants proficiency with musical instruments.
Desc 2: You gain Musical Instrument Proficiency, and your Charisma increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Name: Permanent Mind Sanctuary
Desc 1: Permanent Mind Sanctuary is a passive feature and Illithid Power. This passive lets the creature use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.
Desc 2: You can use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.

Name: Permanently Armed
Desc 1: Permanently Armed is a passive feature that prevents the user from being disarmed.
Desc 2: Creature can't be disarmed.

Name: Personal Space
Desc 1: Personal Space is a passive feature that improves the wearer's Armor Class after shoving.
Desc 2: After shoving an enemy, the wearer gains a +1 to their  Armour Class until their next turn.

Name: Phalanx Formation
Desc 1: Phalanx Formation is a passive feature that grants bonuses if next to a Shield using ally.
Desc 2: Has  Advantage on Attack Rolls if within  3 m / 10 ft of an ally that carries a shield and isn't Incapacitated.

Name: Poison Trails
Desc 1: Poison Trails is a passive feature that boosts the damage of your poison spells.
Desc 2: When the wearer casts a spell that deals ⁠Poison damage, it deals an additional 1d4⁠Poison damage.

Name: Poisonous Synergy
Desc 1: Poisonous Synergy is a passive feature that increases your damage while focusing on a spell.
Desc 2: While concentrating, your melee weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Poison.

Name: Polearm Master: Bonus Attack
Desc 1: Polearm Master: Bonus Attack is a passive feature provided by the Polearm Master Feat. When attacking with a polearm, you can make an additional weaker attack with the butt of the polearm using a  Bonus Action.
Desc 2: When attacking with a  Glaive,  Halberd,  Pike,  Quarterstaff, or  Spear, you can use a Bonus Action to attack with the butt of your weapon.

Name: Polearm Master: Opportunity Attack
Desc 1: Polearm Master: Opportunity Attack is a passive feature provided by the Polearm Master Feat. When an enemy approaches your melee range, you can spend a  Reaction to make an attack.
Desc 2: When wielding a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear, you can make an  Opportunity Attack when a target comes within range. Prerequisite: Must be wielding a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear.

Name: Portent
Desc 1: Portent is a Divination School Wizard passive feature which offers the user glimpses into the future. They gain two random Portent Dice which they can use as a  Reaction to substitute into Attack Rolls and Saving Throws rolled in range.
Desc 2: Your dreams grant you glimpses that let you influence the future. After each Long Rest, the user gains two random Portent Dice. During the day, they can use their reaction to change the die of an Attack Roll or Saving Throw rolled near them to one of their Portent Dice. Each Portent Die can only be used once; unused Portent Dice are lost at the end of the day.

Name: Potent Cantrip
Desc 1: Potent Cantrip is an Evocation School Wizard passive feature increases the reliability of your damaging Cantrips such that even a miss hurts your target.
Desc 2: Your cantrips become harder to evade entirely. When a creature succeeds its  Saving throw against one of your cantrips, it still takes half the cantrip's damage, but suffers no additional effects.

Name: Potent Healing
Desc 1: Potent Healing is a passive feature that maximises healing.
Desc 2: Whenever you are healed, you restore the maximum number of possible hit points.

Name: Potent Spellcasting
Desc 1: Potent Spellcasting is a Light Domain and Knowledge Domain Cleric passive feature that adds the Cleric's Wisdom Modifier to the damage of Cleric Cantrips.
Desc 2: Your god grants you even more intense power. You can add your Wisdom Modifier to the damage you deal with Cleric cantrips.

Name: Prey Decelerator
Desc 1: Prey Decelerator is a passive feature that slows down targets you critically hit.
Desc 2: When this weapon lands a Critical Hit, it also  Slows the target creature.

Name: Prey Upon the Weak
Desc 1: Prey Upon the Weak is a passive feature that deals more damage to severely injured targets.
Desc 2: This weapon deals an additional 1d4⁠Piercing damage against targets with 50% of their hit points or fewer.

Name: Prey's Scent
Desc 1: Prey's Scent is a passive feature only found on Beast Master Hunter's  Summon Companion.
Desc 2: You deal an additional 1d6⁠Physical damage to creatures marked by your Ranger's  Hunter's Mark.

Name: Prey's Scent (Swarmkeeper)
Desc 1: Prey's Scent is passive feature available to Swarmkeepers which lets their swarms benefit from  Hunter's Mark.
Desc 2: Your swarm deals additional damage to creatures marked by  Hunter's Mark

Name: Primal Strike
Desc 1: Primal Strike is a Circle of the Moon Druid passive feature that makes their beast form attacks count as magical damage.
Desc 2: While in beast form, your attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming Resistance and Immunity to non-magical damage.

Name: Prime Aegis of Fire
Desc 1: Prime Aegis of Fire is a passive feature that raises your resistances and prevents you from burning.
Desc 2: You have Resistance to ⁠Fire damage and cannot be  Burned. You take 3 less damage from all sources.

Name: Promised Victory
Desc 1: Promised Victory is a passive feature that highlights enemies you hit.
Desc 2: On a hit, possibly inflict  Guiding Bolt upon the target.

Name: Propelling Strike
Desc 1: Propelling Strike is a passive feature which pushes targets  4.5 m / 15 ft away on a hit.
Desc 2: On a hit, push the target  4.5 m / 15 ft away from you.

Name: Protection
Desc 1: Protection is a Fighting Style reaction/passive feature. Users can interfere with an enemy targetting one of your nearby allies.
Desc 2: When you have a Shield, impose  Disadvantage on an enemy who attacks one of your allies when you are within  1.5 m / 5 ft. You must be able to see the enemy.

Name: Psionic Backlash
Desc 1: Psionic Backlash is a passive feature and Illithid Power. This feature allows a character to, when a nearby enemy casts a spell, use their  Reaction to deal 1d4⁠Psychic damage for every level of that spell.
Desc 2: When a nearby enemy casts a spell, you use your reaction to deal 1d4⁠Psychic damage for every level of that spell.

Name: Psionic Dominance
Desc 1: Psionic Dominance is a passive feature and Illithid Power. This feature allows a character to use a reaction to nullify a spell of lower or equal level to their Proficiency Bonus when targeted by an enemy within 18m.
Desc 2: When an enemy within  18 m / 60 ft targets you with a spell of a Level that is lower than or equal to your Proficiency Bonus, you can use your reaction to nullify the spell.

Name: Psionic Empowerment
Desc 1: Psionic Empowerment is a passive feature that grants an extra 1d6 Psychic damage on attacks.
Desc 2: Your attacks deal an extra 1d6⁠Psychic damage - the scars of illithid enslavement run deep.

Name: Psionic Retribution
Desc 1: Psionic Retribution is a toggleable passive feature available to the Netherbrain that lets it release a  Retributive Brainquake as a reaction to taking damage.
Desc 2: The Netherbrain permits no interference - as a reaction to taking damage, it releases Brainquakes.

Name: Psionic Revenge
Desc 1: Psionic Revenge is a passive feature that retaliates against an enemy that made the wearer make a saving throw.
Desc 2: When you succeed a  Saving throw, the foe that caused the throw takes 1d4⁠Psychic. Githyanki also gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma  Saving throws.

Name: Psionic Skin
Desc 1: Psionic Skin is a passive feature that automatically removes all conditions.
Desc 2: Removes all conditions at the start of its turns.

Name: Psionic Ward
Desc 1: Psionic Ward is a passive feature that protects its user by dealing psychic damage and healing.
Desc 2: If the item detects that the wearer is gith, they have Resistance to ⁠Psychic damage. Whenever the wearer succeeds on a  Saving throw against a spell, they regain 1d4⁠hit points.

Name: Psychic Leech
Desc 1: Psychic Leech is a passive feature that heals the wearer whenever an enemy succumbs to one of your spells targetting their mind.
Desc 2: When an enemy fails a  Charisma,  Intelligence, or  Wisdom  Saving throw against one of your spells or cantrips, you regain 1d4⁠hit points.

Name: Psychic Missiles
Desc 1: Psychic Missiles is a passive feature that enhances magic missile.
Desc 2: Shoot an additional dart whenever you cast  Magic Missile.

Name: Psychic Steel Virtuoso
Desc 1: Psychic Steel Virtuoso is a passive feature that increases damage if you attack with advantage.
Desc 2: When the wielder attacks with  Advantage, they deal an additional 1d8⁠Psychic.

Name: Purity of Body
Desc 1: Purity of Body is a Monk passive feature that gives immunity to ⁠Poison damage and to being  Poisoned, and makes disease have no effect.
Desc 2: You are Immune to Poison damage and can't be Poisoned or affected by disease thanks to the purifying ki flowing through your meridians.

Name: Quickened Mage Hand
Desc 1: Quickened Mage Hand is a passive feature that modifies the cantrip Mage Hand to cost a bonus action instead of a regular action.
Desc 2: You can cast  Mage Hand as a  Bonus Action.

Name: Quickspell Flinger
Desc 1: Quickspell Flinger is a toggleable passive feature that allows the wearer to cast a cantrip as a bonus action.
Desc 2: Cantrips that cost an  Action cost a  Bonus Action instead. This effect can be used once per Short Rest.

Name: Radiant Strike
Desc 1: Radiant Strike is a passive feature that lights up enemies struck with this weapon.
Desc 2: On a hit, inflict 1 turn of  Radiating Orb upon the target.

Name: Radiating Orb Gloves
Desc 1: Radiating Orb Gloves is a passive feature that surrounds targets with globes of light every time the user deals radiant damage to them.
Desc 2: When the wearer deals ⁠Radiant damage, the target receives 2 turn of  Radiating Orb.

Name: Radiating Shockwave
Desc 1: Radiating Shockwave is a passive feature that causes small explosions when dealing radiant damage.
Desc 2: When the wearer deals ⁠Radiant damage, they cause a  Radiant Shockwave.

Name: Rage Becomes Frenzy
Actions: Frenzy, Frenzied Strike, Enraged Throw, Improvised Melee Weapon (Bonus Action)
Desc 1: Rage Becomes Frenzy is a passive feature that changes Rage into Frenzy.
Desc 2: Your bloodthirst transforms your rage, making it stronger.

Name: Rakish Audacity
Desc 1: Rakish Audacity is a passive feature available to Swashbuckler rogues which grants a scaling bonus to initiative and relaxes some of the requirements for triggering Sneak Attack.
Desc 2: You gain a +2 bonus to initiative rolls. This scales with your rogue level. You no longer need  Advantage to trigger Sneak Attack as long as you are within 1.5 m / 5 ft of the target and don't have  Disadvantage.[See: Bugs] At higher levels

Name: Rampage
Desc 1: Rampage is a passive feature available to some Gnolls that gives them the ability to quickly move and bite a foe after downing a creature.
Desc 2: When a Gnoll  Downs a creature with a melee attack, the gnoll can use a Bonus Action to move up to half its Movement Speed and make a bite attack.

Name: Ranger Knight
Desc 1: Ranger Knight is a Ranger passive feature of Favoured Enemy. You gain proficiency with History and Heavy Armour as a result of your history with nations.
Desc 2: You have sworn to serve a crown or nation and seek to bring its foes to ruin. Gain Proficiency with History and Proficiency with Heavy Armour.

Name: Rapid Caster
Desc 1: Rapid Caster is a passive feature that grants bonuses to spellcasting every time the wearer dashes.
Desc 2: Each time they  Dash, the wearer gains  Arcane Charge for 2 turns.

Name: Rat Catcher
Desc 1: Rat Catcher is a passive feature that makes this weapon adept at killing beasts.
Desc 2: Attack Rolls against beasts have  Advantage.

Name: Raven Sight
Desc 1: Raven Sight is a passive feature gained by the  Dire Raven Companion at level 11 that makes them immune to being blinded.
Desc 2: The raven cannot be  Blinded.

Name: Reaper
Desc 1: Reaper is a Death Domain cleric passive feature that allows the cleric to target two creatures with Necromancy cantrips.
Desc 2: Your Necromancy cantrips that only target 1 creature can target an additional creature.

Name: Reaper's Rigidity
Desc 1: Reaper's Rigidity is a toggleable passive feature that controls whether or not you can be moved against your will by any spell or action.
Desc 2: When activated, you can't be moved against your will by any spell or action, but have  Disadvantage on Dexterity  Saving throws.

Name: Rebuke of the Mighty
Desc 1: Rebuke of the Mighty is a passive feature that allows you to strike back at an enemy that hits you, dealing ⁠Force damage and knocking them  Prone.
Desc 2: When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction, dealing 2d4⁠Force damage and knock it  Prone unless they succeed a  Dexterity saving throw.

Name: Redirect Attack
Desc 1: Redirect Attack is a Way of the Drunken Master monk reaction/passive feature that allows the monk to make an unarmed attack against the attacker.
Desc 2: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can spend 1  Ki Point as a reaction to make an unarmed attack against the attacker.

Name: Redvein Savagery
Desc 1: Redvein Savagery is a passive feature that deals more damage to targets.
Desc 2: When you make an attack with  Advantage, the target takes an additional 7⁠PiercingDRS damage.

Name: Refined Vaulting (Monster Slayer Glaive)
Desc 1: Refined Vaulting is a passive feature that increases your jump distance.
Desc 2: Jump distance is increased by  1.5 m / 5 ft.

Name: Refined Vaulting (Bonespike Boots)
Desc 1: Refined Vaulting is a passive feature that increases your jump distance.
Desc 2: Jump distance is increased by  1.5 m / 5 ft.

Name: Refined Vaulting (Swiresy Shoes)
Desc 1: Refined Vaulting is a passive feature that increases your jump distance.
Desc 2: Jump distance is increased by  1.5 m / 5 ft.

Name: Regeneration
Desc 1: Regeneration is a toggleable passive feature that helps the Wood Woad regain HP.
Desc 2: The wood woad regains 10 hit points if it walks through a vine surface, unless it recently took ⁠Fire damage.

Name: Relentless Avenger
Desc 1: Relentless Avenger is an Oath of Vengeance Paladin passive feature. This ability allows a Paladin to pursue fleeing enemies.
Desc 2: If you hit an enemy with an Opportunity Attack, your movement speed increases by 4.5 m / 15 ft on your next turn.

Name: Relentless Endurance
Desc 1: Relentless Endurance is a passive feature available to Half-Orc characters. Once per Long Rest, when they are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, they can drop to 1 Hit Point instead.
Desc 2: If you reach 0 hit points, you regain 1⁠hit points instead of becoming  Downed.

Name: Relentless Rage
Desc 1: Relentless Rage is a Barbarian passive feature. While raging, the barbarian is harder to defeat.
Desc 2: Once per Short Rest, if you drop to 0 hit points while  Enraged, you regain 1⁠hit points instead of being  Downed.

Name: Relentless Revenge
Desc 1: Relentless Revenge is a passive feature that increases the wielder's damage whenever they are severely injured.
Desc 2: When the wielder has 50%  hit points or less, they deal an additional 1d4⁠Slashing damage.

Name: Reliable Talent
Desc 1: Reliable Talent is a passive feature gained by Rogues at level 11. It treats any roll under 10 as a 10.
Desc 2: When you make an Ability Check with a Skill you are Proficient with, the lowest result you can roll on the die is 10.

Name: Remarkable Athlete: Jump
Desc 1: Remarkable Athlete: Jump is a Champion Fighter passive feature that increases their jump distance by  3 m / 10 ft.
Desc 2: You're a master of your own body, your athletic prowess extended beyond the usual. Your Jump distance is increased by  3 m / 10 ft.

Name: Remarkable Athlete: Proficiency
Desc 1: Remarkable Athlete: Proficiency is a Champion Fighter passive feature that adds half of their Proficiency Bonus to any Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution Checks they are not Proficient in.
Desc 2: You're a master of your own body, your athletic prowess extended beyond the usual. You can add half of your Proficiency Bonus to any Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution Checks that you are not Proficient in.

Name: Remedial Rhymes
Desc 1: Remedial Rhymes is a passive feature that grants a bit of extra health when you inspire an ally.
Desc 2: When you inspire an ally using  Bardic Inspiration, you gain  4 temporary hit points. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

Name: Rend With White Lightning
Desc 1: This passive feature empowers its user with extra lightning damage.
Desc 2: Successful weapon attacks deal an additional 1d8⁠Lightning.

Name: Repelling Blast
Desc 1: Repelling Blast is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows you to push creatures around with Eldritch Blast
Desc 2: When you hit a creature with  Eldritch Blast, you can push the creature up to  4.5 m / 15 ft away from you.

Name: Resilient: Charisma
Desc 1: Resilient: Charisma is a passive feature provided by the Resilient Feat. You gain a +1 to your Charisma and can add your proficiency bonus to your Charisma Saving Throws.

Name: Resilient: Constitution
Desc 1: Resilient: Constitution is a passive feature provided by the Resilient Feat. You gain a +1 to your Constitution and can add your proficiency bonus to your Constitution Saving Throws.

Name: Resilient: Dexterity
Desc 1: Resilient: Dexterity is a passive feature provided by the Resilient Feat. You gain a +1 to your Dexterity and can add your proficiency bonus to your Dexterity Saving Throws.

Name: Resilient: Intelligence
Desc 1: Resilient: Intelligence is a passive feature provided by the Resilient Feat. You gain a +1 to your Intelligence and can add your proficiency bonus to your Intelligence Saving Throws.

Name: Resilient: Strength
Desc 1: Resilient: Strength is a passive feature provided by the Resilient Feat. You gain a +1 to your Strength and can add your proficiency bonus to your Strength Saving Throws.

Name: Resilient: Wisdom
Desc 1: Resilient: Wisdom is a passive feature provided by the Resilient Feat. You gain a +1 to your Wisdom and can add your proficiency bonus to your Wisdom Saving Throws.

Name: Retaliation
Desc 1: Retaliation is a passive feature that allows the creature being attacked to immediately strike back.
Desc 2: Strike back at the next enemy that attacks you.

Name: Revenant Scourge
Desc 1: Revenant Scourge is a passive feature that grants a bonus to attacks and damage on undead creatures.
Desc 2: When used against undead creatures this weapon has +1d4 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls.

Name: Revenant's Ire
Desc 1: Revenant's Ire is a passive feature that increases the damage of their weapon attacks.
Desc 2: This profane entity's weapon attacks deal an additional 4d8⁠Necrotic damage.

Name: Ring of Veracity
Desc 1: Ring of Veracity is a passive feature that helps the wearer discern lies.
Desc 2: You gain an  Advantage on Insight Checks.

Name: Riposte
Desc 1: Riposte is a Battle Master Fighter passive feature and reaction. This ability allows the Battle Master to counterattack with their melee weapon when an enemy misses them with a melee attack.
Desc 2: When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, expend a superiority die to retaliate with a powerful strike that deals an additional  Superiority Die damage.

Name: Risky Attack
Desc 1: Risky Attack is a passive feature that trades disadvantage on saving throws for advantage on attack rolls.
Desc 2: You gain  Advantage on Attack rolls and receive  Disadvantage on  Saving throws.

Name: Ritual Caster: Free Spells
Desc 1: Ritual Caster: Free Spells is a passive feature provided by the Ritual Caster Feat. You learn 2 Ritual spells, which you can cast at any time outside of combat.
Desc 2: You learn two  Ritual Spells of your choice from the following:

Name: Ruintamer Heart
Desc 1: Ruintamer Heart is a passive feature that enhances your rage.
Desc 2: While  Raging, the wearer generates 2 turns of  Wrath.[See: Bugs]

Name: Running Jump
Desc 1: Running Jump is a passive feature that lets the user jump for free after they dash.
Desc 2: Once per turn, after the wearer  Dashes or takes a similar action, they can  Jump without using a  Bonus Action.

Name: Rupturing
Desc 1: Rupturing is a passive feature that causes a target to take damage whenever they move.
Desc 2: On a hit, the target becomes  Ruptured for 3 turns.

Name: Sanctified Stalker
Desc 1: Sanctified Stalker is a Ranger passive feature of Favoured Enemy. You gain proficiency with Religion and can cast  Sacred Flame as a result of your religious training.
Desc 2: You swore to hunt the enemies of a holy or druidic order. You gain Proficiency in Religion and can cast  Sacred Flame.

Name: Sanctified Weapon
Desc 1: Sanctified Weapon is a passive feature that causes undead creatures to flee.
Desc 2: Undead creatures struck by this weapon are possibly  Turned.

Name: Savage Attacker
Desc 1: Savage Attacker is a passive feature provided by the feat of the same name. Your attacks become more fierce, and you deal damage at a higher level than usual when dealing melee weapon damage.
Desc 2: When making melee weapon attacks, you roll your damage dice twice and use the highest result.

Name: Savage Attacks
Desc 1: Savage Attacks is a passive feature available to half-orcs. When they score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, they can roll one of the weapon’s damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.
Desc 2: When you land a Critical Hit with a melee weapon attack, you deal an extra dice of weapon damage.

Name: Saviour's Allure
Desc 1: Saviour's Allure is a passive feature that increases the wearer's healing.
Desc 2: You restore an additional 2⁠hit points every time you heal another creature.

Name: Scar of Dark Thirst
Desc 1: Scar of Dark Thirst is a passive feature that applies bleeding on hit if character is below %90 HP.
Desc 2: This character's attacks may apply Bleeding if its HP are less than 90%.

Name: Scar of Fury
Desc 1: Scar of Fury is a passive feature that grants a creature a Critical Hit when their health is below 40%.
Desc 2: Score a Critical Hit when you health is lower than 40%.

Name: Scar of Mirages
Desc 1: Scar of Mirages is a passive feature that may apply  Confused to their attacks.
Desc 2: This character's attacks may apply Confused if its hit points are less than 90%.

Name: Scar of the Agave
Desc 1: Scar of the Agave is a passive feature found only on Gur clerics.
Desc 2: When this character is struck by a melee attack while at less than 60% of their hit points, the attacker takes 2d8⁠Piercing damage.

Name: Scar of the Dunes
Desc 1: Scar of the Dunes is a passive feature found only on Tactician difficulty.
Desc 2: This character's movement speed is doubled and it cannot be targeted by attacks of opportunity, if its hit points are lower than 90%.

Name: Scar of the Sand Eclipse
Desc 1: Scar of the Sand Eclipse is a passive feature that grants attacks an extra 4d8 slashing damage when a creatures Hit Points are at 20% or lower.
Desc 2: Your attacks deal an additional 4d8⁠Slashing damage when your hit points are at 20% or lower.

Name: Scar of the Sirocco
Desc 1: Scar of the Sirocco is a passive feature grants a character's attack the potential to apply Prone when their Hit Points are less than 90%.
Desc 2: This character's attacks may apply Prone if its hit points are less that 90%.

Name: Scarlet Remittance
Desc 1: Scarlet Remittance is a passive feature that increases your attack potency.
Desc 2: Gain a +1 bonus to Attack rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC for every foe you slay, up to a maximum of +3.

Name: Scenting Blood
Desc 1: Scenting Blood is a Sahuagin passive feature. This ability triggers the sahuagin to become Blood Frenzied when it sees blood.
Desc 2: If the sahuagin sees a wounded creature, it becomes  Blood Frenzied.

Name: Scintillating
Desc 1: Scintillating is a passive feature that grants bonuses to Charisma abilities.
Desc 2: You gain a +1 bonus to Charisma  Ability checks and  Saving throws.

Name: Scourge of Pests
Desc 1: Scourge of Pests is a passive feature found on the  Exterminator's Axe.
Desc 2: Deals an additional 1d6⁠Fire damage to Plants, Myconids[See: Bugs], and Small creatures.

Name: Sculpt Spells
Desc 1: Sculpt Spells is an Evocation School passive feature prevents your allies from taking damage from some of your spells.
