Desc 2: Create pockets of safety within your Evocation spells. Allies automatically succeed their  Saving throws against these spells and take no damage from them.

Name: Sculptor of Flesh
Desc 1: Sculptor of Flesh is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You learn how to cast Polymorph.
Desc 2: You can cast  Polymorph with a Warlock spell slot.

Name: Second-Story Work
Desc 1: Second-Story Work is a Thief Rogue passive feature that grants Resistance against falling damage.
Desc 2: You've mastered the art of falling and gain Resistance to Falling damage.

Name: Seeking Blood
Desc 1: Seeking Blood is a passive feature that makes the wearer more likely to hit a damaged target.
Desc 2: You gain a +2 bonus to Attack rolls when attacking creatures that have already taken damage.

Name: Seeking Spell
Desc 1: Seeking Spell is a toggleable passive feature that grants the ability to use a sorcery point to get advantage on a spell attack roll.
Desc 2: When you make a Spell Attack Roll, you can spend a  Sorcery Point to gain  Advantage. This costs 1 Sorcery Point per spell slot Level. Cantrips cost 1 Sorcery Point.

Name: Seldom Caught Unawares (Bow of Awareness)
Desc 1: Seldom Caught Unawares is a passive feature that grants a bonus to initiative rolls.
Desc 2: You gain a +1 bonus to  Initiative rolls.

Name: Seldom Caught Unawares (Fistbreaker Helm)
Desc 1: Seldom Caught Unawares is a passive feature that grants a bonus to initiative rolls.
Desc 2: You gain a +1 bonus to  Initiative rolls.

Name: Seldom Caught Unawares (Stalker Gloves)
Desc 1: Seldom Caught Unawares is a passive feature that grants a bonus to initiative rolls.
Desc 2: You gain a +1 bonus to  Initiative rolls.

Name: Seldom Caught Unawares (+2)
Desc 1: Seldom Caught Unawares is a passive feature that grants a bonus to initiative rolls.
Desc 2: You gain a +2 bonus to  Initiative rolls.

Name: Selûne's Blessing
Desc 1: Selûne's Blessing is a passive feature that grants the wielder enhanced wisdom and eyesight.
Desc 2: You gain  Advantage on Wisdom  Saving throws and Perception Checks.

Name: Selûne's Ire
Desc 1: Selûne's Ire is a passive feature available to Moonlight Slivers, that lets them immediately deal Radiant damage to an attacker with  Selûne's Ire.
Desc 2: The Sliver can immediately deal 12d12⁠Radiant damage to an attacker. It can use Selûne's Ire again after its next turn.

Name: Selûne's Protection
Desc 1: Selûne's Protection is a passive feature that increases your defenses against spells.
Desc 2: While the wearer has  Mage Armour, each successful  Saving throw causes the source of the Saving Throw to take 1-4⁠Radiant damage.

Name: Semblance of Fey
Desc 1: Semblance of Fey is a passive feature that increases the wearer's defenses against attacks against their mind.
Desc 2: You have  Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma  Saving throws.

Name: Sentinel Weapon
Desc 1: Sentinel Weapon is a passive feature that lets the wielder move earlier and pay closer attention to their surroundings.
Desc 2: Gain a +1 bonus to Initiative rolls and  Advantage on Perception Ability Checks.

Name: Sentinel: Opportunity Advantage
Desc 1: Sentinel: Opportunity Advantage is a passive feature obtainable by the Sentinel Feat. Users of this feature gain  Advantage on Opportunity Attacks.
Desc 2: You gain  Advantage on Opportunity Attacks.

Name: Sentinel: Snare
Desc 1: Sentinel: Snare is a passive feature obtainable by the Sentinel Feat. Users of this feature are able to stop enemies in their tracks if you hit them with an Opportunity Attack.
Desc 2: When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, it can no longer move for the rest of its turn.

Name: Sentinel: Vengeance
Desc 1: Sentintel: Vengeance is a passive feature obtainable by the Sentinel Feat. Users of this feature can attack enemies who attacks an ally within your melee range.
Desc 2: When an enemy in melee range attacks an ally, you can use a Reaction to make a weapon attack against that enemy. Target ally must not have the Sentinel feat.

Name: Shadeclinger
Desc 1: Shadeclinger is a passive feature that improves survivability while in shadow.
Desc 2: While Obscured, the wearer has  Advantage on  Saving throws.

Name: Shadespell
Desc 1: Shadespell is a passive feature that enhances your spells while in shadow.
Desc 2: While the wearer is obscured in shadow, their spells gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC, making them more likely to succeed.

Name: Shadow Ambush
Desc 1: Shadow Ambush is a passive feature that allows this creature to deal 4d8⁠Necrotic damage when attacking from the shadows.
Desc 2: This creature deals an additional 4d8⁠Necrotic damage when attacking from the shadows.

Name: Shadow Blade
Desc 1: Shadow Blade is a passive feature that makes it easier to hit a target in shadow.
Desc 2: You have  Advantage on Attack rolls against Lightly or Heavily Obscured targets when using this blade.

Name: Shadow Stealth
Desc 1: Shadow Stealth is a passive feature that allows its user to avoid  Opportunity Attacks when obscured.
Desc 2: While Lightly or Heavily Obscured, this creature does not provoke opportunity attacks when they move away from a foe.

Name: Shadow Veil
Desc 1: Shadow Veil is a Shadow Mastiff passive feature granting  Shadow Veil while obscured.
Desc 2: While Lightly or Heavily Obscured, the shadow mastiff is Resistant to non-magical ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage.

Name: Shadow-Blinding
Desc 1: Shadow-Blinding is a passive feature that lets you blind your target.
Desc 2: If you attack with  Advantage, you have a chance to  Blind your target.[See: Bugs]

Name: Shadowblend
Desc 1: Shadowblend is a passive feature that allows the user to automatically become Invisible while obscured by darkness.
Desc 2: While Lightly or Heavily Obscured, this creature gains the ability to blend with shadows and become  Invisible.

Name: Shadowthief
Desc 1: Shadowthief is a passive feature that grants extra damage against obscured targets.
Desc 2: The wearer's weapon and unarmed attacks deal an additional   1d4 damage against  Lightly or  Heavily Obscured creatures, and creatures made of shadow.

Name: Shapechanger
Desc 1: Shapechanger lets a Transmutation wizard transform into a Blue Jay at will.
Desc 2: You can cast the  Polymorph spell without expending a spell slot.

Name: Shapeshifter Slayer
Desc 1: Shapeshifter Slayer is a passive feature that increases damage against shapeshifted creatures.
Desc 2: This weapon deals an additional   1d4 damage against shapeshifters or polymorphed creatures.

Name: Shapeshifter's Boon
Desc 1: Shapeshifter's Boon is a passive feature granted by  Shapeshifter's Boon Ring.
Desc 2: While shapeshifting or disguising yourself, gain a +1d4 bonus to all  Ability checks.

Name: Shar's Blessing
Desc 1: Shar's Blessing is a special passive feature granted to this weapon.
Desc 2: If Shar allows it, use this spear to kill Nightsong.

Name: Shar's Blessing (Shar's Spear of Evening)
Desc 1: Shar's Blessing is a passive feature that protects the wielder from all harmful effects while obscured.
Desc 2: You gain  Advantage on  Saving throws while Lightly or Heavily Obscured. This weapon deals an additional 1d6 damage to creatures that are Lightly or Heavily Obscured.

Name: Shar's Protection
Desc 1: Shar's Protection is a passive feature that further enhances Shield of Faith.
Desc 2: While the wearer has  Shield of Faith active, reduce all incoming damage by 2 and reflect damage received back at the attacker, who takes 1d4⁠Necrotic.

Name: Shar's Rules
Desc 1: Shar's Rules is a passive feature that reduces Ability Scores by 1 if player attacks different reflection.
Desc 2: Damaging a Reflection that is not your own causes Shar to intervene, reducing all Ability Scores by 1 until your next Long Rest. This reduction can stack up to 4 times.

Name: Shar's Sight
Desc 1: Shar's Sight is a passive feature that grants immunity to Blinded.
Desc 2: The Justiciar can't be  Blinded.

Name: Shar's Umbrae
Desc 1: Shar's Umbrae is a passive feature that helps the wearer stay undetected.
Desc 2: While obscured, the wearer has  Advantage on Stealth Checks.

Name: Sharp Caster
Desc 1: Sharp Caster is a passive feature that rerolls low damage die, once.
Desc 2: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die(s) for a Spell Attack, that die(s) is rerolled once.

Name: Sharpened Snare
Desc 1: Sharpened Snare is a passive feature that makes enemies more susceptible to damage.
Desc 2: Creatures have  Disadvantage on  Saving throws when resisting your attacks and spells that inflict  Restrained.

Name: Sharpshooter: All In
Desc 1: Sharpshooter: All In is a toggleable passive feature obtainable by the Sharpshooter Feat. Users of this feature are able to deal great damage at the cost of accuracy.
Desc 2: Ranged weapon attacks with weapons you are Proficient with have a -5 penalty to their Attack roll, but deal an additional 10 damage.

Name: Sharpshooter: Low Ground
Desc 1: Sharpshooter: Low Ground is a passive feature obtainable by the Sharpshooter Feat. Users of this feature don't receive any penalty when attacking from below their target.
Desc 2: Your ranged weapon attacks are not penalized for High Ground Rules.

Name: Sharran Veil
Desc 1: Sharran Veil is a passive feature that enhances one of your existing spells.
Desc 2: Shield of Faith also grants you a +2 to all  Saving throws.

Name: Shelter
Desc 1: Shelter is a passive feature that increases defenses against being charmed.
Desc 2: You have  Advantage on  Saving throws against  Charmed.

Name: Shield Bash
Desc 1: Shield Bash is a passive feature granted by many Shields that allows you to strike back at an enemy that hits you, knocking them  Prone.
Desc 2: When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to knock it  Prone unless they succeed a  Dexterity saving throw.

Name: Shield Conduit
Desc 1: Shield Conduit is a passive feature that reduces physical damage taken.
Desc 2: The shield shrouds the wearer with  Force Conduit at the start of its turn in combat.

Name: Shield Master
Desc 1: Shield Master is a passive feature obtainable by the Shield Master Feat. Users of this feature gain bonuses to their  Dexterity saving throw while wielding a Shield.
Desc 2: Gain a +2 bonus to  Dexterity  Saving throws when wielding a Shield.

Name: Shield Master: Block
Desc 2: If a spell forces you to make a  Dexterity saving throw, you can use your Reaction to shield yourself and diminish the effect's damage. Properties Technical details

Name: Shocking Sting
Desc 1: Shocking Sting is a passive feature that lets the weapon shock your target.
Desc 2: On a hit, possibly  Shock[See: Bugs] your target.

Name: Shockwave
Desc 1: Shockwave is a toggleable passive feature that causes a shockwave after you jump.
Desc 2: When the wearer  Jumps, they deal 1d4⁠Thunder damage in a  3 m / 10 ft radius upon landing.

Name: Shoe Slinger
Desc 1: Shoe Slinger is a passive feature that allows the shoes to be thrown at an enemy.
Desc 2: Returns to its owner when thrown. On a hit deal an additional 2d4⁠Psychic damage.

Name: Shortened Stride
Desc 1: Shortened Stride is a passive feature that shortens a creature's movement speed.
Desc 2: Your movement speed is  7.5 m / 25 ft.

Name: Shunt Through Space
Desc 1: Shunt Through Space is a passive feature unique to Ptaris that lets him teleport after being damaged.
Desc 2: Using a  Reaction after being damaged, Ptaris teleports as far as he can from the attacker.

Name: Sign of Ill Omen
Desc 1: Sign of Ill Omen is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You learn how to cast Bestow Curse.
Desc 2: You can cast  Bestow Curse with a Warlock Spell Slot.

Name: Silent
Desc 1: Silent is a Passive Feature that prevent a creature from casting spells.
Desc 2: This creature can't speak or cast spells that have a verbal component

Name: Skilled
Desc 1: Skilled is a passive feature obtainable by a Feat of the same name. You gain Proficiency in 3 Skills of your choice.
Desc 2: You gain Proficiency in 3 Skills of your choice.

Name: Skinburster Force
Desc 1: Skinburster Force is a passive feature.
Desc 2: When the wielder deals melee damage with this weapon, they gain 2 turns of  Force Conduit.

Name: Skittish
Desc 1: Skittish is a passive feature of Owlbear Cubs that lets them flee for 2 turns when badly injured
Desc 2: Will flee for 2 turns when badly hurt.

Name: Skullduggery Attack
Desc 1: Skullduggery Attack is a passive feature that adds force damage to a rogue's sneak attack.
Desc 2: Your  Sneak Attack deals an additional 1d4⁠ForceDRS damage.

Name: Slabjaw Determination
Desc 1: Slabjaw Determination is a passive feature that increases your health while you rage.
Desc 2: You gain  15 temporary hit points whenever you  Rage.

Name: Slay the Wicked
Desc 1: Slay the Wicked is a passive feature that increases damage against Fiends and Undead.
Desc 2: This weapon deals an additional 1d6⁠Slashing damage against Fiends and Undead.

Name: Slay the Wicked (Bludgeoning)
Desc 1: Slay the Wicked is a passive feature that increases damage against Fiends and Undead.
Desc 2: This weapon deals an additional 1d6⁠Bludgeoning damage against Fiends and Undead.

Name: Slayer Knowledge
Desc 1: Slayer Knowledge is a special passive feature granted to you by a book from Volo.
Desc 2: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against being  Frightened by a Bhaalspawn Slayer - the tome Volo found was very informative.

Name: Slayer's Extra Attack
Desc 1: Slayer's Extra Attack is a passive feature available to the Slayer, granting it two additional attacks.
Desc 2: You can make one additional attack after attacking with your main-hand weapon.

Name: Slayer's Improved Extra Attack
Desc 1: Slayer's Improved Extra Attack is a passive feature available to the Slayer, granting it two additional attacks.
Desc 2: You can make two additional attacks after attacking with your main-hand weapon.

Name: Slow Fall
Desc 1: Slow Fall is a toggleable passive feature gained by Monks at Level 4. Slow Fall allows the Monk to gain Resistance to falling damage.
Desc 2: When you fall, you can use your reaction to gain Resistance to Falling damage.

Name: Slow: Actions
Desc 1: Slow: Actions is a passive feature applied to a target afflicted with  Slowed and is a component of the Slow effect.
Desc 2: You can't take both an action and a bonus action. If you take an action, you lose a bonus action, and vice versa. You also can't make more than 1 attack per turn.

Name: Slow: Casting
Desc 1: Slow: Casting is a passive feature applied to a target afflicted with  Slowed and is a component of the Slow effect.
Desc 2: If you cast a spell that costs 1  Action, roll a d20. On 11 or higher, you hang in prepare phase and skip turn. On your next turn you must spend an action point and finish casting. If you don't have an action point, the spell is cancelled.

Name: Smite the Graceless
Desc 1: Smite the Graceless is a passive feature that retaliates against attackers with radiant damage.
Desc 2: Creatures who miss their Attack rolls against the wearer must make a DC 14  Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4⁠Radiant damage.

Name: Smooth Start
Desc 1: Smooth Start is a passive feature that allows the wearer to move quickly at the start of combat.
Desc 2: At the start of combat, the wearer gains  Momentum for 3 turns.

Name: Sneaky Riposte
Desc 1: Sneaky Riposte is a passive feature that lets a character make a reaction which deals Sneak Attack damage if they have  Advantage
Desc 2: Strike a foe that just missed you with an attack, inflicting Sneak Attack damage if you have Advantage.

Name: Snowburst
Desc 1: Snowburst is a passive feature that creates ice surfaces wherever the wearer deals cold damage.
Desc 2: When the wearer deals ⁠Cold damage, they also create a  4.5 m / 15 ft circle of  Ice around the target(s).

Name: Snowy Liver
Desc 1: Snowy Liver is a passive feature that grants enahnced constitution damage and resistance.
Desc 2: While  Drunk you have  Advantage on Constitution  Saving throws, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution Modifier at the start of your turn.

Name: Song of Defence
Desc 1: Song of Defence is a passive feature/reaction available to Bladesinging wizards which lets them expend spell slots to reduce incoming damage.
Desc 2: When you take damage during your  Bladesong, you can expend a spell slot to subtract 5 damage per spell slot.

Name: Soothing Songs
Desc 1: Soothing Songs is a passive feature that adds healing every time they inspire an ally.
Desc 2: When you inspire an ally using  Bardic Inspiration, they also regain 1d6⁠hit points.

Name: Soul Catching
Actions: Soul Catching Boon, Soul Catching Prowess, Soul Snare: Heal
Desc 1: Soul Catching is a passive feature granted to the wearer of the  Gloves of Soul Catching. After landing an unarmed or throwing attack, the wearer can heal 10 hit points or gain a +5 bonus to a single attack roll or saving throw. Only one of these options can be used each turn.
Desc 2: Once per turn, on an unarmed hit, you regain 10⁠hit points. Alternatively, you may forego healing to gain a +5 bonus on an Attack roll or  Saving throw until the end of your next turn.[See: Bugs]

Name: Soul Fist
Desc 1: Soul Fist is a passive feature that adds force damage to their wearer's arsenal.
Desc 2: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d10⁠Force damage.

Name: Soul Perception
Desc 1: Soul Perception is a passive feature that gives the wearer bonuses to their hit chance, initiative and perception.
Desc 2: Gain a +2 bonus to Attack rolls,  Initiative Rolls, and Perception Checks.

Name: Soul Pillar Proximity
Desc 1: Soul Pillar Proximity is a unique Raphael passive feature that grants him bonuses for being close to his Soul Pillars.
Desc 2: For each remaining Soul Pillar, Raphael's attacks deal an additional 1d12⁠Fire damage and he has a +3 bonus to his Dexterity Checks and Saving Throws.

Name: Soul Reaper
Desc 1: Soul Reaper is a unique Raphael passive feature makes him extra deadly when he Downs a creature.
Desc 2: When Raphael reduces an enemy's hit points to 0, he  Severs the soul from their body.

Name: Spark Blocker
Desc 1: Spark Blocker is a passive feature that prevents the wearer from being electrocutted.
Desc 2: The wearer can't be  Electrocuted.

Name: Sparkswall Armour
Desc 1: Sparkswall Armour is a passive feature that boosts the benefits of having lightning charges.
Desc 2: The wearer has +1 to  Armour Class and  Saving throws as long as they have  Lightning Charges.

Name: Speedy Sparks
Desc 1: Speedy Sparks is a passive feature that grants lightning charges to the wearer when they dash.
Desc 2: When the wearer  Dashes or takes a similar action in combat, they gain 3  Lightning Charges

Name: Spell Amplification
Desc 1: Spell Amplification is a passive feature that grants extra spells.
Desc 2: You gain an additional  Level 2 Spell Slot.

Name: Spell Resistance
Desc 1: Spell Resistance is a passive feature that grants the wielder resistance against magical spells.
Desc 2: You have  Advantage on  Saving throws against spells.

Name: Spell Sniper
Desc 1: Spell Sniper is a passive feature obtainable by a Feat of the same name. Users with this feature have learned an additional cantrip, and are more likely to critical hit with a spell.
Desc 2: You learn a cantrip, and the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking with a Spell is reduced by 1. This effect can stack. The cantrip must be one of:

Name: Spellguard
Desc 1: Spellguard is a passive feature that offers excellent protection against spells.
Desc 2: You gain  Advantage on  Saving throws against spells. Spell Attack Rolls against you have  Disadvantage.

Name: Spellmight
Desc 1: Spellmight is a toggleable passive feature that allows a caster to steady their hand, dealing excellent damage if it hits,
Desc 2: When casting a spell that requires an Attack roll, you can take a -5 penalty to the roll to deal an additional   1d8 damage.

Name: Spider Fall
Desc 1: Spider Fall is a passive feature available to druids using the  Giant Spider wild shape.
Desc 2: A network of spider silk slows the spider's fall, making it Resistant to Falling damage.

Name: Spider Step
Desc 1: Spider Step is a passive feature that prevents the user from being affected by web surfaces.
Desc 2: Immune to being  Enwebbed. Your Movement Speed is not affected by  Web surfaces.

Name: Spiteful Thunder
Desc 1: Spiteful Thunder is a passive feature that can daze the wearer's reverberating targets.
Desc 2: When the wearer deals ⁠Thunder damage to a  Reverberating creature, it becomes  Dazed unless it succeeds a  Constitution saving throw.

Name: Splinters of a Giant's Might
Desc 1: Splinters of a Giant's Might is a passive feature that increases the user's Strength, up to a minimum of 19.
Desc 2: Increases Strength to 19.

Name: Split Enchantment
Desc 1: Split Enchantment is an Enchantment School Wizard toggleable passive feature that enables you to target 2 creatures when casting an Enchantment school spell that normally only targets 1.
Desc 2: You know your enchantments inside and out. You can target 2 creatures with Enchantment spells that would normally only target 1 creature. Single target Enchantment Wizard Spells:

Name: Spore Sacks
Desc 1: Spore Sacks is a passive feature that grants extra spore druid abilities.
Desc 2: While imbued with  Symbiotic Entity, you can spread  Bibberbang Spores,  Timmask Spores, and  Haste Spores.

Name: Spreading Spores
Desc 1: Spreading Spores is a Circle of the Spores Druid passive feature that allows you to attack an area with a cloud of Spreading Spores
Desc 2: While  Symbiotic Entity is active, you can create a cloud of  Spreading Spores.

Name: Sprouting Necrosis
Desc 1: Sprouting Necrosis is a passive feature found on a couple Shadow-Cursed Blight creatures.
Desc 2: At the end of its turns, Shadow-Cursed Vines will sprout at this creature's feet.

Name: Staff of the Ram
Desc 1: Staff of the Ram is a passive feature that knocks back and stuns targets.
Desc 2: Once per turn, the blow possibly knocks a foe back  2 m / 7 ft and  Stuns them. This has no effect on dragons or Huge creatures.

Name: Stalker's Flurry
Desc 1: Stalker's Flurry is a Gloom Stalker Ranger passive feature that lets you continue attacking when you miss.
Desc 2: When you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another one for free.

Name: Starry Form
Actions: Starry Form: Archer, Starry Form: Chalice, Starry Form: Dragon
Desc 1: Starry Form is a passive feature that grants starry forms to Circle of the Stars druids.
Desc 2: You can expend a  Wild Shape Charge to take on a Starry Form rather than transforming into a beast. You can take on  Starry Form: Archer,  Starry Form: Chalice, or  Starry Form: Dragon.

Name: Steadfast
Desc 1: Steadfast is a passive feature that prevents the wearer from being forcibly moved. Also ignores difficult terrain.
Desc 2: You cannot be forcibly moved by a foe's spells or actions, and you ignore the effects of  Difficult Terrain.

Name: Stealthier
Desc 1: Stealthier is a passive feature that helps the wearer hide and move undetected while in shadow.
Desc 2: While Obscured, the wearer gains +3 bonus to Stealth Checks

Name: Stealthy
Desc 1: Stealthy is a passive feature that improves the wielders ability to sneak around undetected.
Desc 2: Gain a +1 bonus to Stealth Checks.

Name: Stealthy Critical
Desc 1: Stealthy Critical is a passive feature that increases the wearer's critical chance when hiding.
Desc 2: While  Hiding, the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

Name: Steel Physiology
Desc 1: Steel Physiology is a passive feature that reduces incoming physical damage
Desc 2: Reduce incoming ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage by 1.

Name: Steel Will
Desc 1: Steel Will is a Hunter Ranger passive feature that strengthens your mind against fear.
Desc 2: Advantage on  Saving throws against being  Frightened.

Name: Steeped in Slaughter
Desc 1: Steeped in Slaughter is a passive feature of Redcap's that lets them attacks at advantage against Bleeding foes.
Desc 2: Has  Advantage on Attack Rolls made against  Bleeding foes.

Name: Stillness of Mind
Desc 1: Stillness of Mind is a Monk passive feature that automatically calms the user if they are Charmed or Frightened.
Desc 2: If you are  Charmed or  Frightened, you automatically cast  Stillness of Mind to remove the condition.

Name: Sting The Helpless
Desc 1: Sting The Helpless is a passive feature that allows a creature to inflict additional poison damage to a restrained enemy.
Desc 2: A Drow wielding this weapon deals an additional 1d4⁠Poison against  Restrained targets.

Name: Stirring Execution
Desc 1: Stirring Execution is a passive feature which grants allies temporary hit points based on their respective Charisma modifiers when the wielder of  Duke Ravengard's Longsword kills an enemy.
Desc 2: When you kill an enemy, allies within  9 m / 30 ft gain temporary hit points equal to your[See: Bugs] Charisma Modifier (minimum 1).

Name: Stone Camouflage
Desc 1: Stone Camouflage is a passive feature available to Deep Gnome characters that grants them Advantage on Stealth checks.
Desc 2: You have  Advantage on  Stealth checks.

Name: Strange Conduit
Desc 1: Strange Conduit Ring is a passive feature that adds psychic damage to weapon attacks while concentrating on a spell.
Desc 2: When Concentrating on a spell, the wearer's weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Psychic damage.

Name: Strength of the Grave
Desc 1: Strength of the Grave is a passive feature that prevents the first death.
Desc 2: After reaching 0 Hit Points, you regain 1 instead of becoming downed.

Name: Strider Movement
Desc 1: Strider Movement is a passive feature that increases the user's movement speed.
Desc 2: You gain  Longstrider.

Name: Strongheart Resilience
Desc 1: Strongheart Resilience is a passive feature available to all Strongheart Halflings. It grants them Advantage against poison saving throws and Resistance against poison damage.
Desc 2: You have  Advantage on Saving Throws against being  Poisoned and Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.

Name: Stun Immunity
Desc 1: Stun Immunity is a passive feature that prevents the wielder from being stunned.
Desc 2: You can't be  Stunned.

Name: Stygian Empowerment
Desc 1: Stygian Empowerment is a passive feature available to Vengeful Cambions, that lets them deal additional damage while in proximity of Raphael.
Desc 2: Affected entity's weapon attacks deal an additional 3~18 ⁠Piercing damage while within 18m of Raphael

Name: Subtle Swap
Desc 1: Subtle Swap is a passive feature that improves throwing ability and potentially swaps position with the target.
Desc 2: You gain a +1 bonus to Attack rolls when throwing, and may swap positions with the target if they fail a  Dexterity saving throw.

Name: Sun Sickness
Desc 1: Sun Sickness is a passive feature available to certain myconid creatures.
Desc 2: While in sunlight, has  Disadvantage on Ability Checks, Attack Rolls, and Saving Throws.

Name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
Desc 1: Sunlight Hypersensitivity is a passive feature that causes a creature to take ⁠Radiant damage, and have attack roll and ability check disadvantage while in sunlight.
Desc 2: This creature takes 20⁠Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While sunlit, it has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and  Ability checks.

Name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Desc 1: Sunlight Sensitivity is a passive feature that imposes penalties when in sunlight.
Desc 2: While in sunlight, this creature has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Perception checks that rely on sight.

Name: Sunlight Weakness
Desc 1: Sunlight Weakness is a passive feature that imposes strong penalties when in sunlight.
Desc 2: While in sunlight, this creature has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

Name: Sunwalker's Gift
Desc 1: Sunwalker's Gift is a passive feature that grants darkvision.
Desc 2: The wearer can see in the dark up to  12 m / 40 ft.

Name: Superior Darkvision
Desc 1: Superior Darkvision is a passive feature that prevents  Disadvantage when attacking creatures in the dark within 24 m / 80 ft, double the distance of normal  Darkvision.
Desc 2: Can see in the dark up to 24 m / 80 ft.

Name: Superior Material (-1)
Desc 1: Superior Material is a passive feature that reduces damage from slashing attacks.
Desc 2: You take 1 less ⁠Slashing damage.

Name: Superior Material (-2)
Desc 1: Superior Material is a passive feature that provides some damage reduction.
Desc 2: You take 2 less ⁠Slashing damage.

Name: Superior Padding (-1)
Desc 1: Superior Padding is a passive feature that lets the owner take less bludgeoning damage.
Desc 2: You take 1 less ⁠Bludgeoning damage.

Name: Superior Padding (-2)
Desc 1: Superior Padding is a passive feature that lets the owner take less bludgeoning damage.
Desc 2: You take 2 less ⁠Bludgeoning damage.

Name: Superior Plate (-1)
Desc 1: Superior Plate is a passive feature that lets the owner take less piercing damage.
Desc 2: You take 1 less ⁠Piercing damage.

Name: Superior Plate (-2)
Desc 1: Superior Plate is a passive feature that lets the owner take less piercing damage.
Desc 2: You take 2 less ⁠Piercing damage.

Name: Supreme Githyanki Parry
Desc 1: Supreme Githyanki Parry is an NPC-exclusive passive feature and reaction that allows githyanki warriors to parry attacks with their greatswords, reducing incoming damage by 20.
Desc 2: Parry unarmed and weapon attacks to reduce their damage by 20. You must be wielding a Greatsword and you can't be Incapacitated, Blinded[See Notes], or Restrained.

Name: Surge Accuracy
Desc 1: Surge Accuracy is a passive feature that makes you more likely to hit after you action surge.
Desc 2: When you use  Action Surge, gain a   +1d4 bonus to Attack rolls for the rest of your turn.

Name: Swamp I
Desc 1: Swamp is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Melf's Acid Arrow and  Darkness. At higher levels You can cast  Stinking Cloud and  Vampiric Touch. You can cast  Blight and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

Name: Swamp II
Desc 1: Swamp is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Melf's Acid Arrow and  Darkness. At higher levels You can cast  Stinking Cloud and  Vampiric Touch. You can cast  Blight and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

Name: Swamp III
Desc 1: Swamp is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Melf's Acid Arrow and  Darkness. At higher levels You can cast  Stinking Cloud and  Vampiric Touch. You can cast  Blight and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

Name: Swamp IV
Desc 1: Swamp is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Melf's Acid Arrow and  Darkness. At higher levels You can cast  Stinking Cloud and  Vampiric Touch. You can cast  Blight and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

Name: Swathed in Shadow
Desc 1: Swathed in Shadow is a passive feature that allows the wearer to resist spells better, while in shadow.
Desc 2: While Obscured by shadow, the wearer gains +1 to  Saving throws when attacked.[See: Bugs]

Name: Sweet Bloodletting
Desc 1: Sweet Bloodletting is a passive feature that causes targets to bleed when attacked while hidden.
Desc 2: Possibly inflict  Bleeding when hitting a creature with this weapon while  Hiding or  Invisible.

Name: Swift Strides
Desc 1: Swift Strides is a passive feature that increases the user's movement speed whenever they dash.
Desc 2: When the wearer  Dashes or takes a similar action during combat, they gain  Momentum for 3 turns.

Name: Sword Mastery
Desc 1: Sword Mastery is a passive feature that grants the wearer proficiency in a number of swords.
Desc 2: You gain Proficiency with  shortswords,  longswords, and  greatswords. In addition, you gain a +1 bonus to melee Attack rolls.

Name: Synergetic Cantrips
Desc 1: Synergetic Cantrips is a passive feature that applies when dealing damage with a cantrip.
Desc 2: When you deal damage with a Cantrip, you gain  Arcane Synergy for 2 turns.

Name: Synergetic Moments
Desc 1: Synergetic Moments is a passive feature that adds damage equal to your spellcasting ability after inflicting a condition.
Desc 2: When you inflict a condition, gain  Arcane Synergy for 2 turns.[See: Bugs]

Name: Tactical Discipline
Desc 1: Tactical Discipline is a passive feature that grants the user advantage on all ability checks and saving throws during combat.
Desc 2: You are an expert in mustering self-control to gain an edge over your foes. You gain  Advantage on all Ability Checks and  Saving throws during combat.

Name: Talkative
Desc 1: Talkative is a Passive Feature that allows a creature to cast spells.
Desc 2: Despite its lack of lips this creature can cast spells that have a verbal component.

Name: Tanglevine Form
Desc 1: Tanglevine Form is a passive feature that allows its user to defend itself by entangling enemies.
Desc 2: Any creature making a melee attack against this mess of writhing vines may become  Entangled

Name: Tavern Brawler
Desc 1: Tavern Brawler is a passive feature obtainable by the Feat of the same name. Users of this feature excel at improvised and unarmed fighting and deal more damage more often.
Desc 2: Increase your  Strength or  Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you make an unarmed attack, use an improvised weapon, or throw something, your Strength Modifier is added to the damage and Attack rolls an additional time.

Name: Temperature Adjustment
Desc 1: Temperature Adjustment is a passive feature that lets the user resist fire and cold damage.
Desc 2: You have Resistance to ⁠Fire and ⁠Cold Damage.

Name: Tempestuous Magic
Desc 1: Tempestuous Magic is a Storm Sorcery Sorcerer passive feature that enables you to safely disengage from enemies after casting a leveled spell.
Desc 2: After you cast a Level 1 Spell or higher you can  Fly as a Bonus Action up to  9 m / 30 ft until the end of your turn without receiving Opportunity Attacks.

Name: Tenacity
Desc 1: Tenacity is a feature that allows the user to apply damage, even on a miss.
Desc 2: When you miss an attack, you deal Strength Modifier⁠Bludgeoning damage (minimum of 1) anyway.

Name: Territorial
Desc 1: Territorial is a passive feature available to Bulette creatures.
Desc 2: The Bulette will attack other monstrosities before going after smaller prey.

Name: The Blade of Frontiers
Desc 1: The Blade of Frontiers is a passive feature that grants Wyll proficiency with Rapiers.
Desc 2: The Champion of the Sword Coast, renowned for his heroic deeds and unusual stone eye.

Name: The Comeback
Desc 1: The Comeback is a passive feature that grants a creature temporary HP when you heal them.
Desc 2: When the wearer heals a target, it gains an additional  3 temporary hit points. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

Name: The Pain Maiden's Blessing
Desc 1: The Pain Maiden's Blessing is a passive feature that blesses the wielder after a successful attack.
Desc 2: After a successful attack with this dagger, the wielder receives a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws until the end of their next turn[See: Bugs].

Name: The Scourge Mistress' Bane
Desc 1: The Scourge Mistress' Bane is a passive feature that can apply  Bane but will hurt the wielder if they are too healthy.
Desc 2: Chance to inflict upon the target a 1d4 penalty to Attack rolls and  Saving throws. If the attacker still has 50% or more hit points, they take 1d6⁠Piercing themselves. A Baned creature receives a 1d4 penalty to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

Name: The Shadow Itself
Desc 1: The Shadow Itself is a passive feature that cloaks the wearer in invisibility whenever they kill an enemy.
Desc 2: Once per turn when you kill an enemy, shroud yourself in primeval darkness to become  Invisible for 2 turns.

Name: The Tharchiate Codex: Blessing
Desc 1: The Tharciate Codex: Blessing is a passive feature granted after lifting the  Tharchiate Withering curse.
Desc 2: Once per Long Rest, gain  20 temporary hit points.

Name: The Water Caller
Desc 1: The Water Caller is a passive feature that produces water on hit with this weapon, soaking the target.
Desc 2: On a hit, inflict  Wet and create a  2 m / 7 ft  Water surface centred around the target.

Name: Thermodynamo
Desc 1: Thermodynamo is a passive feature that grants Heat when you deal damage.
Desc 2: Whenever you deal damage with this weapon, you gain 2 turns of  Heat.

Name: Thief of Five Fates
Desc 1: Thief of Five Fates is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows you to cast Bane (spell) once per Long Rest.
Desc 2: Once per Long Rest, you can cast  Bane using a Warlock Spell Slot. Bane targets up to 3 creatures. They receive a 1d4 penalty to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

Name: Thought Shield: Psychic Reflection
Desc 1: Thought Shield: Psychic Reflection is a passive feature unique to The Great Old One Warlock subclass that damages attackers with the same damage when damaged with Psychic damage.
Desc 2: Your patron doesn't appreciate attempts to attack your mind. When you take ⁠Psychic damage, your attacker takes the same damage.

Name: Thought Shield: Psychic Resistance
Desc 1: Thought Shield: Psychic Resistance is a passive feature unique to The Great Old One Warlock subclass that grants Resistance to Psychic damage.
Desc 2: An elder being shields your brain. You gain Resistance to ⁠Psychic damage.

Name: Throw Damage Immunity
Desc 1: Throw Damage Immunity is a passive feature exclusive to  Boo which prevents him from receiving any damage when thrown.
Desc 2: Creature is immune to being damaged by being thrown.

Name: Throwing Boost
Desc 1: Throwing Boost is a passive feature that increases the wearer's throwing damage.
Desc 2: The wearer gains a   1d4 bonus to  Throw damage.

Name: Throwing: Lightning Damage
Desc 1: Throwing: Lightning Damage is a passive feature that increases the damage dealt when thrown.
Desc 2: When launched at a target, deal an additional 1d4⁠Lightning damage.

Name: Thunderbolt Strike
Desc 1: Thunderbolt Strike is a Tempest Domain cleric passive feature that pushes Large or smaller creatures 3 m / 10 ft that are dealt ⁠Thunder or ⁠Lightning damage from the cleric.
Desc 2: When you deal ⁠Thunder or ⁠Lightning damage to a creature that is Large or smaller, you can also push it up to 3 m / 10 ft.

Name: Thunderous Acuity
Desc 1: Thunderous Acuity is a passive feature that improves the wearer's spell power after dealing thunder damage.
Desc 2: Whenever the wearer deals ⁠Thunder damage, they gain  Arcane Acuity.

Name: Thunderous Conversion
Desc 1: Thunderous Conversion is a passive feature that disorients the user's target whenever they deal thunder, lightning or radiant damage.
Desc 2: When the wearer deals ⁠Thunder, ⁠Lightning, or ⁠Radiant damage, inflict 2 turns of  Reverberation upon the target(s).

Name: Tides of Chaos
Desc 1: Tides of Chaos is a toggleable passive feature which grants Advantage on the user's next Ability Check and increases their chance of a Wild Magic surge afterwards to 50% (normally 5%).
Desc 2: Activate to gain  Advantage on your next Attack roll,  Ability check, or  Saving throw. Increased chance of  Wild Magic surge afterwards.

Name: Tiger Heart
Desc 1: Tiger Heart is a passive feature that grants a Wildheart Barbarian a special version of Rage and another ability.
Desc 2: While  Raging, you can use  Tiger's Bloodlust, and your jump distance increases by  4.5 m / 15 ft.

Name: Time Thoroughly Bided
Desc 1: Time Thoroughly Bided is a passive feature that enhances the user's damage.
Desc 2: The wearer gains  Arcane Charge whenever they are hit by a melee attack.

Name: Tippler's Rage
Desc 1: Tippler's Rage is a passive feature that enhances your chance to hit and causes a blast with extra damage but only while drunk.
Desc 2: While you are  Drunk, you have  Advantage on Attack rolls. You also create a blast with each attack, dealing 1d4⁠Thunder for  3 m / 10 ft.

Name: Titan Weapon
Desc 1: Titan Weapon is a passive feature that adds your Strength modifier to your ranged weapon attacks.
Desc 2: This weapon deals additional damage equal to your Strength Modifier. The weapon only adds the modifier if it improves your chance to hit.

Name: Toggle Non-Lethal Attacks
Desc 1: Toggle Non-Lethal Attacks is a common toggleable passive feature that allows users to knock targets out instead of killing them. Toggling on/off will apply to the entire party of playable characters, but not to summons such as familiars. While this passive is turned on, when an Unarmed Strike or melee weapon attack reduces a creatures hit points to zero or one, it becomes  Knocked Out or  Knocked Out (Temporary).
Desc 2: Knock someone  Unconscious instead of killing them. Must be unarmed or using a melee weapon. Doesn't work on undead or constructs.

Name: Torturous Edges
Desc 1: Torturous Edges is a passive feature that tortures its targets.
Desc 2: Tortured creatures may receive  Disadvantage on Constitution  Saving throws.

Name: Tough
Desc 1: Tough is a passive feature obtainable by a Feat of the same name. Users of this feature have extra Hit Points per character level.
Desc 2: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 2 for every level you have gained.

Name: Toxic Secretions
Desc 1: Toxic Secretions is a passive feature which can cause Madness in an enemy making a melee attack against the user.
Desc 2: When an enemy makes a melee attack against the frog, they need to succeed a Constitution Saving Throw, or succumb to  Madness for two turns. Mad creatures lose control of themselves and become hostile to everyone around them.

Name: Training in War and Song
Weapon Proficiency: Daggers, Longswords, Rapiers, Scimitars, Shortswords, Sickles
Desc 1: Training in War and Song is a passive feature of Bladesinging Wizards which grants them proficiencies in light armour and one-handed blade weapons.
Desc 2: You gain proficiency with  Light armour and in the Performance skill. You also gain proficiency with  Daggers,  Longswords,  Rapiers,  Scimitars,  Shortswords, and  Sickles.

Name: Tranquillity
Desc 1: Tranquillity is a Way of the Open Hand Monk passive feature that prevents enemies from directly harming the monk until the first time they attack each day (effectively a free use of Sanctuary).
Desc 2: Long Rests surround you with an aura of peace, granting you  Sanctuary permanently until you attack.

Name: Transmuter's Stone
Desc 1: Transmuter's Stone lets a Transmutation wizard create Transmuter Stones.
Desc 2: You can create  Transmuter's Stones. Once you have created a stone, you need to cast a Transmutation spell of Level 1 or higher or take a Long Rest before you can create another one.

Name: Treader by Twilight
Desc 1: Treader by Twilight is a passive feature that increases your armour while obscured.
Desc 2: You gain a +1 bonus to  Armour Class while obscured.

Name: Troubadour's Wonder
Desc 1: Troubadour's Wonder is a passive feature that boosts a bard's ability to inspire.
Desc 2: Your  Armour Class increases by 1. In addition, if you have  Bardic Inspiration, you gain 1 more use of it.

Name: True Strike Riposte
Desc 1: True Strike Riposte is a passive feature that lets the wielder retaliate against a missed attack.
Desc 2: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may retaliate and gain  True Strike.

Name: Turn Resistance
Desc 1: Turn Resistance gives Advantage on Saving Throws against any effect that turns undead.
Desc 2: Turn Resistance gives  Advantage on  Saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

Name: Twinkling Constellations
Desc 1: Twinkling Constellations is a passive feature that improves the starry forms of Circle of the Stars druids.
Desc 2: Your Starry Forms are improved. The Archer's damage and the Chalice's healing are each increased by 1d8, and the Dragon gains the ability to hover and to  Fly at a movement speed of 6 m / 20 ft. Once per turn, you can switch to a different Starry Form as a free action.

Name: Twist of Fortune
Desc 1: Twist of Fortune is a passive feature that increases the consistency of your weapon's damage.
Desc 2: When you roll 2 or less with this weapon's damage die, reroll it and take the new result.

Name: Two-Weapon Fighting
Desc 1: Two-Weapon Fighting is a Fighting style passive feature.
Desc 2: When you make an offhand attack, you can add your Ability Score Modifier to the damage of the attack.

Name: Umbral Attack
Desc 1: Umbral Attack is a passive feature that adds necrotic damage to the user's weapon attacks.
Desc 2: Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Necrotic damage.

Name: Unarmoured Defence (Barbarian)
Desc 1: Unarmoured Defence is a Barbarian passive feature that adds your Constitution modifier to your Armour Class in addition to your Dexterity modifier when not wearing armour.
Desc 2: Your body is as resilient as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Constitution Modifier to your  Armour Class. Wearing Heavy Armour impedes all positive effects of your Rage. This effect does not stack with Mage Armour.

Name: Unarmoured Defence (Monk)
Desc 1: Unarmoured Defence is a Monk passive feature that adds your Wisdom modifier to your  Armour Class when not wearing armour or shields.
Desc 2: Your reflexes are as effective as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Wisdom Modifier to your  Armour Class. This effect does not stack with Mage Armour.

Name: Unarmoured Movement
Desc 1: Unarmoured Movement is a Monk passive feature that increases movement distance by  3 m / 10 ft while not wearing armour or using a shield.
Desc 2: Your movement speed increases by  3 m / 10 ft while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

Name: Uncanny Dodge
Desc 1: Uncanny Dodge is a togglable passive gained by Rogues at Level 5. Uncanny Dodge allows the Rogue to reduce incoming damage once per round.
Desc 2: Use your lightning-quick reflexes to protect yourself. When an attack hits you, you only take half the usual damage.

Name: Undead Bane
Desc 1: Undead Bane is a passive feature that enhances combat against undead creatures.
Desc 2: Attack rolls with this weapon have  Advantage against Undead.

Name: Undead Fortitude
Desc 1: Undead Fortitude is a passive feature that prevents the user from being killed, unless hit with a Critical Hit or ⁠Radiant damage.
Desc 2: If the killing blow wasn't a critical hit and wasn't radiant damage, this undead comes back to life with 1 hit point.

Name: Undead Thralls: Additional Undead
Desc 1: Undead Thralls: Additional Undead is a Necromancy School Wizard passive feature that allows you to raise additional undead when you cast the Animate Dead spell.
Desc 2: When you use  Animate Dead, you can raise an additional corpse.

Name: Undead Thralls: Animate Dead
Desc 1: Undead Thralls: Animate Dead is a Necromancy School Wizard passive feature that grants you the spell  Animate Dead.
Desc 2: You gain the  Animate Dead spell, if you didn't have it already

Name: Undead Thralls: Better Summons
Desc 1: Undead Thralls: Better Summons is a Necromancy School Wizard passive feature that enhances the undead you raise with Animate Dead. They gain additional hit points and extra damage.
Desc 2: Creatures created with  Animate Dead have additional hit points equal to your wizard level, and your Proficiency Bonus is added to their damage.

Name: Undead Ward
Desc 1: Undead Ward is a passive feature that makes the wearer's allied undead resistant to physical damage.
Desc 2: Allied undead within  6 m / 20 ft are Resistant to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Slashing, and ⁠Piercing damage.[See: Bugs]

Name: Underdark I
Desc 1: Underdark is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Web and  Misty Step. At higher levels You can cast  Gaseous Form and  Stinking Cloud. You can cast  Greater Invisibility and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

Name: Underdark II
Desc 1: Underdark is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Web and  Misty Step. At higher levels You can cast  Gaseous Form and  Stinking Cloud. You can cast  Greater Invisibility and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

Name: Underdark III
Desc 1: Underdark is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Web and  Misty Step. At higher levels You can cast  Gaseous Form and  Stinking Cloud. You can cast  Greater Invisibility and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

Name: Underdark IV
Desc 1: Underdark is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
Desc 2: You can cast  Web and  Misty Step. At higher levels You can cast  Gaseous Form and  Stinking Cloud. You can cast  Greater Invisibility and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

Name: Underdog's Bravery
Desc 1: Underdog's Bravery is a passive feature that improves the user's attacks while surrounded.
Desc 2: The wearer gains  Advantage on melee Attack rolls while surrounded by 2 or more foes.

Name: Unearthly
Desc 1: Unearthly is a passive feature available to Poltergeists that protects them from falling damage.
Desc 2: This creature is Immune to Falling damage.

Name: Unflinching Protection
Desc 1: Unflinching Protection is a passive feature/reaction granted by the  Unflinching Protector Amulet. The wearer can use this reaction to cause an attack targeting an ally to miss. This cannot be used against attacks targetting the wearer, only allies.
Desc 2: When a nearby ally is targeted by an attack of any kind, you can use your  Reaction to make that attack automatically miss. This effect can only be used once per Short Rest.

Name: Unhampered Resistance
Desc 1: Unhampered Resistance is a passive feature that increases the user's Saving Throws while not wearing armour.
Desc 2: While the wielder is not wearing armour, they receive a +2 bonus to  Saving throw.

Name: Unnatural Growth
Desc 1: Unnatural Growth is a passive feature unique to Ptaris that lets him act quickly.
Desc 2: Take 2  Actions per round.

Name: Unstable Blood
Desc 1: Unstable Blood is a permanent passive feature which causes a creature's blood to explode when in contact with fire.
Desc 2: Your blood is now highly flammable and will explode when in contact with fire.

Name: Unwavering
Desc 1: Unwavering is a passive feature that prevents the wearer's movement speed from being affected.
Desc 2: You ignore the effects of  Difficult Terrain, and cannot be  Paralysed or  Restrained.

Name: Unwavering Bull
Desc 1: Unwavering Bull is a passive feature that makes the wielder difficult to move or restrain.
Desc 2: You cannot be pushed against your will and you have an  Advantage on  Saving throws against being  Restrained.

Name: Urban Tracker
Desc 1: Urban Tracker is a Ranger passive feature of Natural Explorer. Grants you proficiency in Sleight of Hand, as you are an expert in navigating cities.
Desc 2: An expert at navigating the wild within the city, you gain Sleight of Hand Proficiency.

Name: Valiant Roll
Desc 1: Valiant Roll is a toggleable passive feature granted by having a Combat Inspiration.
Desc 2: Add a   +1d6 bonus to your next Ability Check. You expend your  Combat Inspiration when the effect triggers.

Name: Vampire Ascendant
Desc 1: Vampire Ascendant is a passive feature available to Astarion if he completed his quest by ascending. It gives Astarion the two class actions Ascendant Bite and Misty Escape (Vampire Ascendant), as well as a bonus 1d10⁠Necrotic damage to weapon and unarmed attacks.
Desc 2: Behold, the Vampire Ascendant! Thousands of souls have bought you power, granting you  Ascendant Bite and  Gaseous Form. You also have a +1d10⁠Necrotic damage bonus to weapon and unarmed attacks.

Name: Vampire Regeneration
Desc 1: Vampire Regeneration is a passive feature that allows a Vampire to regenerate 10 hit points at the start of its turn.
Desc 2: The vampire regains 10⁠hit points at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight, or has taken ⁠Radiant damage or damage from Holy Water, in which case this trait doesn't function until the start of its next turn.

Name: Vaprak's Greed
Desc 1: Vaprak's Greed is a Giant barbarian passive feature that increases carry weight.
Desc 2: Your carrying capacity is increased by a quarter.

Name: Veil of the Wind
Desc 1: Veil of the Wind is a passive feature that makes you immune to falling damage and increases your movement.
Desc 2: You gain a + 3 m / 10 ft bonus to movement speed and jump distance. Equipping this weapon gives you Immunity to falling damage.

Name: Vengeful
Desc 1: Vengeful is a passive feature that grants an extra reaction and allows use of the  Vengeful Strike reaction attack.
Desc 2: Creature gains an extra reaction. When attacked, the creature can use a reaction to counterattack with Vengeful Strike, dealing Weapon Damage and 4-14 Psychic Damage.

Name: Vengeful Father
Desc 1: Vengeful Father is a passive feature available to the Owlbear Mate summoned by  Call Consort in Honour mode.
Desc 2: At low health or the death of a family member, this Owlbear becomes  Enraged.

Name: Vengeful Guardian
Desc 1: Vengeful Guardian is a passive feature of Grym, which causes it to always attack the last creature that struck it.
Desc 2: Grym always attacks the last creature that hit it if possible.

Name: Venomous Revenge
Desc 1: Venomous Revenge is a passive feature that coats the wearer's weapons[note 1] in poison whenever the wearer is healed.
Desc 2: Whenever the wearer is healed, their weapon becomes coated in magic and deals an additional 1d6⁠Poison  damage.

Name: Vicious Dragon Breath
Desc 1: Vicious Dragon Breath is a passive feature that improves the success rate of your breath weapon.
Desc 2: Enemies have  Disadvantage on  Saving throws against your dragonborn breath weapon.

Name: Vital Conduit
Desc 1: Vital Conduit is a passive feature that provides bonus healing when casting a concentration spell.
Desc 2: Grants the wearer  8 temporary hit points when they cast a Spell that requires  Concentration. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

Name: Volatile Fungus
Desc 1: Fungal Resistance is a passive feature affecting Pearlspore Bell. It creates an explosion and lingering cloud of poison upon the affected entity's death.
Desc 2: This Pearlspore Bell will explode when destroyed, dealing damage and leaving a poisonous surface behind.

Name: Volo's Ersatz Eye
Desc 1: Volo's Ersatz Eye is a passive feature which gives a character the condition See Invisibility, after they have undergone surgery from Volo.
Desc 2: The damage wrought upon your ocular nerve during Volo's experiment is undone, allowing you to see  Invisible creatures.

Name: War Caster: Concentration
Desc 1: War Caster Concentration is a passive feature obtainable by the War Caster Feat. Users of this feature have Advantage maintaining a spell with Concentration.
Desc 2: You gain  Advantage on  Saving throws to maintain  Concentration on a Spell.

Name: War Caster: Opportunity Spell
Desc 1: War Caster Opportunity Spell is a Passive feature/Reaction obtainable by the War Caster Feat. Users of this feature are adept at casting  Shocking Grasp at an enemy when they leave your melee range. This can be done instead of the usual Opportunity Attack.
Desc 2: You can also use a Reaction to cast  Shocking Grasp at a target moving out of melee range.

Name: War Magic
Desc 1: War Magic is an Eldritch Knight Fighter passive feature. This allows the Fighter to make an attack after using a Cantrip by using a Bonus Action.
Desc 2: You have honed your body and magic for war. After you cast a cantrip, you can make a weapon attack using a  Bonus Action.

Name: War Priest
Desc 1: War Priest is a War Domain cleric passive feature which allows the cleric to make a limited number of bonus action attacks using War Priest Charges that recharge after a long rest.
Desc 2: When you make an unarmed or weapon attack, you can spend a  War Priest Charge to make an additional attack as a  Bonus Action. At higher levels A War Domain Cleric begins with three  War Priest Charges per long rest. This increases to:

Name: Warding Flare
Desc 1: Warding Flare is a Light Domain Cleric passive feature that allows the cleric to briefly flash an enemy, potentially causing the attack to miss.
Desc 2: Shield yourself with divine light. Use your reaction to impose  Disadvantage on an attacker, possibly causing their attack to miss. An attacker that can't be Blinded is immune to this effect. At higher levels At level 6 Light Domain Clerics get  Improved Warding Flare which enables them to use Warding Flare on allies

Name: Warding Hands
Desc 1: Warding Hands is a passive feature that automatically grants heroism when channeling your oath.
Desc 2: When you use your Channel Oath Charge spells, you gain  Heroism.

Name: Wasteland Wanderer: Cold
Desc 1: Wasteland Wanderer: Cold is a Ranger passive feature of Natural Explorer. As an explorer of the cold winterlands, you gain resistance to Cold.
Desc 2: You have spent endless days surviving desolate tundras. Gain resistance to ⁠Cold damage, taking only half damage from it.

Name: Wasteland Wanderer: Fire
Desc 1: Wasteland Wanderer: Fire is a Ranger passive feature of Natural Explorer.You are well versed in traveling in hot environments, you gain resistance to Fire.
Desc 2: You have spent endless days surviving forbidding deserts. Gain resistance to ⁠Fire, taking only half damage from it.

Name: Wasteland Wanderer: Poison
Desc 1: Wasteland Wanderer: Poison is a Ranger passive feature of Natural Explorer. Swamps are like a second home to you, you gain resistance to Poison.
Desc 2: You have spent endless days surviving fetid swamps. Gain resistance to ⁠Poison, taking only half damage from it.

Name: Watersparks
Desc 1: Watersparks is a passive feature that grants lightning charges when standing on an electrified surface.
Desc 2: If the wearer starts their turn on an  Electrified Water surface, they gain 3  Lightning Charges.

Name: Watery Guidance
Desc 1: Watery Guidance is a passive feature that makes you more likely to hit wet targets.
Desc 2: This weapon has  Advantage against  Wet creatures.

Name: Watery Rejuvenation
Desc 1: Watery Rejuvenation is a passive feature that heals the user when standing in water.
Desc 2: If the wearer is standing in a  Water surface at the start of their turn, they heal 1d4⁠hit points.

Name: Weakened
Desc 1: Weakened is a passive feature found on some Intellect Devourers that lowers many of its stats.
Desc 2: Its journey through hell has severely weakened this creature's defences.

Name: Weakened Constitution
Desc 1: Weakened Constitution is a special passive feature gained when failing a particular saving throw while in the Zaith'isk.
Desc 2: Your Constitution has been reduced by 2 by the Zaith'isk. The githyanki device failed to harm your illithid parasite - perhaps consuming more would mend your broken mind.

Name: Weakened Intelligence
Desc 1: Weakened Intelligence is a special passive feature gained when failing a particular saving throw while in the Zaith'isk. It decreases your intelligence by 2 permanently, until this feature is removed.
Desc 2: Your Intelligence has been reduced by 2 by the Zaith'isk. The githyanki device failed to harm your illithid parasite - perhaps consuming more would mend your broken mind.

Name: Weakened Wisdom
Desc 1: Weakened Wisdom is a special passive feature gained when failing a particular saving throw while in the Zaith'isk. It decreases your wisdom by 2 permanently, until this feature is removed.
Desc 2: Your Wisdom has been reduced by 2 by the Zaith'isk. The githyanki device failed to harm your illithid parasite - perhaps consuming more would mend your broken mind.

Name: Weapon Master
Desc 1: Weapon Master is a passive feature obtainable by the Feat of the same name. Users of this feature are Proficient with additional types of weapons.
Desc 2: Increase your  Strength or  Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Gain Proficiency with four Weapon types of your choice.

Name: Weave Eater
Desc 1: Weave Eater is a passive feature that heals the user whenever they successfully resist a spell.
Desc 2: Whenever the wearer succeeds a  Saving throw against a spell, they regain 1d6⁠hit points.

Name: Web Sense
Desc 1: Web Sense is a passive feature available to Ettercaps that allows them to instantly detect any creature touching its webs.
Desc 2: Knows the exact location of anything that touches its webs.

Name: Web Walker
Desc 1: Web Walker is a passive feature inherent to a number of spider-like creatures in Baldur's Gate 3.
Desc 2: Isn't slowed down by  Web surfaces, and can't be  Enwebbed by them.

Name: Well-Liked and Well-Fortified
Desc 1: Well-Liked and Well-Fortified is a passive feature that continuously grants temporary hp.
Desc 2: At the beginning of the wearer's turn, the robe activates, granting them Temporary Hit Points equal to their Charisma Modifier.

Name: Whispers of the Grave
Desc 1: Whispers of the Grave is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You can cast Speak with Dead without expending a spell slot.
Desc 2: You can cast  Speak with Dead without expending a Warlock spell slot.

Name: Wild Magic
Desc 1: Wild Magic is a passive feature which can trigger a random magical effect when casting a Level 1 or higher Spell. An effect is triggered when rolling a 20 on a  d20 (i.e., a 5% chance).
Desc 2: Unruly magic sparks and fizzes through your veins. Each time you cast a spell of Level 1 or higher, your magic might surge and trigger a random magical effect.

Name: Wild Magic Surge
Desc 1: Wild Magic Surge is a passive feature granted to Wild Magic Barbarians that produces a random magical effect when raging.
Desc 2: A magical energy roils inside of you, ready to erupt. When you enter a  Rage, you trigger a random magical effect.

Name: Wild Strike
Desc 1: Wild Strike is a Druid passive feature that lets you make multiple unarmed attacks while Wildshaped.
Desc 2: You can make an additional attack after making an unarmed strike while in wildshape.

Name: Willing Whip
Desc 1: Willing Whip is a passive feature that grants resistance to Necrotic damage but deals Necrotic damage to every creature nearby.
Desc 2: Grants Resistance to ⁠Necrotic, and deals additional 1d6⁠Necrotic damage to everyone nearby including the wielder.

Name: Winter's Clutches
Desc 1: Winter's Clutches is a passive feature that encrusts targets in frost whenever the user attacks and deals cold damage.
Desc 2: When the wearer deals ⁠Cold damage, inflict 2 turns of  Encrusted with Frost upon the target(s).

Name: Witchbreaker
Desc 1: Witchbreaker is a passive feature that grants advantage against creatures concentrating on spells.
Desc 2: You gain  Advantage on Attack rolls against concentrating creatures.

Name: Withering Cut
Desc 1: Withering Cut is a passive feature that lets the wielder deal extra damage using a reaction.
Desc 2: On a hit with a melee weapon, use a  Reaction to deal additional ⁠Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Name: Wolf Heart
Desc 1: Wolf Heart is a passive feature that grants a Wildheart Barbarian a special version of Rage and another ability.
Desc 2: While  Raging, you can use  Inciting Howl, and your allies have  Advantage on melee Attack rolls against enemies within  2 m / 7 ft of you.

Name: Wound Closure
Desc 1: Wound Closure is a passive feature that automatically stabilises the wearer
Desc 2: When  Downed, automatically stabilise at the start of the turn.

Name: Wrath of the Storm
Actions: Wrath of the Storm: Lightning, Wrath of the Storm: Thunder
Desc 1: Wrath of the Storm is a Tempest Domain Cleric passive feature. It grants the cleric two reactions,  Wrath of the Storm: Lightning and  Wrath of the Storm: Thunder, that can be triggered to retaliate against an attacking creature with ⁠Lightning or ⁠Thunder damage.
Desc 2: As a  Reaction, strike back at an attacking creature, dealing 2d8⁠Lightning or 2d8⁠Thunder damage. The target takes half damage on a successful  Saving throw.

Name: Writhing Dance
Desc 1: Writhing Dance is a passive feature that allows the wearer to avoid opportunity attacks when below half their hit points.
Desc 2: When the wearer has 50% hit points or less, they don't provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

Name: Xyanyde's Fire
Desc 1: Xyanyde's Fire is a passive feature that lights up the wearer's target if they miss, making them easier to hit next turn.
Desc 2: Once per Short Rest, you can encase a target in  Faerie Fire for 2 turns if you miss an attack against it.

Name: Yeenoghu's Gift
Desc 1: Yeenoghu's Gift is a passive feature which requires the wielder continue attacking or go mad.
Desc 2: Hitting an enemy with this weapon heals the wielder for 1d6⁠hit points - but they can go  Mad if they don't continue hitting an enemy each turn. Healing through this item doesn't trigger other passives that react to healing.

Name: Yeenoghu's Hunger
Desc 1: Yeenoghu's Hunger is a passive feature that identifies a creature as harboring Gnoll spawn.
Desc 2: Bloated with the spoils of slaughter, but still hungry - a new gnoll is growing in the hyena's belly.

Name: Zephyr Connection
Desc 1: Zephyr Connection is a passive feature that binds the weapon to the wielder and creates a thunder explosion when thrown.
Desc 2: This weapon will return to your hand when thrown. You cannot be forced to drop the trident. When thrown, the weapon creates an explosion that deals 3d4⁠Thunder damage in a  6 m / 20 ft blast centered on the target.

Name: Giant Killer
Desc 1: Giant Killer is a Hunter ranger passive feature and reaction. This ability allows rangers to retaliate with a melee attack using their reactions when attacked by a large creature.
Desc 2: If a Large or bigger creature attacks you, you can use your reaction to retaliate with a melee attack. You must be able to see the creature, and it must be within 2 m / 7 ft of you.
